people.tiZh: Grok Bot 产品与工程负责人（SpaceXAI）

people.bioZh: SpaceXAI「Grok Bot」团队的产品与工程负责人，主持官方「What's new in Grok Bot」系列工作坊，常年演示团队如何用常驻智能体团队完成工程与产品工作。

episodes.tEn: Grok Bot Workshop: Attention Lists, Agent Teams & Cloud Agents with Roshan and Kevin
How AI Agents Work While You Sleep: Lauren Tan & Roshan Sadanani on Grok Bot and Grok 4.6

views.en: Agent design should be simple: chat with agents like colleagues, not micromanage tool calls; agents need their own computers and persistent identity.
views.zh: 智能体的设计应当简单：像同事一样与智能体对话，而不是微观管理工具调用；智能体需要自己的电脑和持久身份。

views.en: The chat box limits agentic work; multiple specialized agents with scoped memory beat one general agent, coordinating context behind the scenes.
views.zh: 聊天框限制了智能体式工作；多个拥有限定记忆的专门智能体胜过单一通用智能体，在幕后协调上下文。

views.en: Engineers shift from writing code to managing agent fleets, focusing on taste, quality control, and codebase health as demand rises.
views.zh: 工程师从写代码转向管理智能体集群，随着需求上升，聚焦品味、质量控制与代码库健康。

views.en: Efficient models like Grok 4.6 match frontier models at a fraction of the cost, democratizing agent use as AI costs rise.
views.zh: 随着 AI 成本上升，像 Grok 4.6 这样的高效模型以极低成本比肩前沿模型，推动智能体普及。

views.en: Clean data foundations and canonical tables are essential for trusted agent insights; product management is becoming software.
views.zh: 干净的数据基础和规范表对于可信的智能体洞察至关重要；产品管理正在变成软件。

episodes.tEn: Building a 21+ Agent Grok Bot Team: Trust, Verification, and the Engineer as Manager
Scaling to 2,500 PRs a Month: Lauren on the Agent Trust Ladder
How I Shipped 2,500 PRs to Production with Trusted Agents

views.en: Trust, not capability, is the bottleneck: build environments where agents do the right thing by default.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为瓶颈不在能力而在信任：要搭建让智能体默认做对事的环境。

views.en: Verification is the core skill; it lets agents self-check, iterate, and climb the trust ladder.
views.zh: 验证是最核心的技能，让智能体自我检查、迭代并沿信任阶梯上行。

views.en: The engineer's job shifts to building the environment: skills, constraints, lints, type systems.
views.zh: 工程师的工作转向搭建环境：技能、约束、lint 与类型系统。

views.en: Extract deterministic work into scripts and CLIs, leaving only judgment-heavy work to agents.
views.zh: 把确定性工作抽成脚本与 CLI，只把重判断的工作留给智能体。

views.en: Fix the environment, not individual agents, when failure patterns emerge; sample PRs and harden.
views.zh: 出现失败模式时修环境而非修单个智能体：抽样 PR 并加固。

people.tiZh: 艾伦研究所荣誉研究员
people.bioEn: Neuroscientist and one of the founders of the modern science of consciousness. Caltech professor from 1986 to 2013, longtime collaborator of Francis Crick on the neural correlates of consciousness, then chief scientist and president of the Allen Institute for Brain Science. Leading proponent of integrated information theory.
people.bioZh: 神经科学家，现代意识科学的奠基者之一。1986–2013 年任加州理工教授，与弗朗西斯·克里克合作 14 年寻找意识的神经相关物，后任艾伦脑科学研究所首席科学家兼所长。整合信息理论（IIT）的主要倡导者。

episodes.tEn: Detecting Hidden Consciousness: A Neuroscientist's Mission

people.tiEn: Creator of Lean; Co-creator of Z3

people.bioEn: Computer scientist who created the Lean theorem prover and co-created the Z3 SMT solver. Lean and its Mathlib library have become the standard tool for formalizing mathematics and verifying AI-generated proofs.
people.bioZh: 计算机科学家，Lean 定理证明器的作者、Z3 SMT 求解器的联合作者。Lean 及其 Mathlib 库已成为数学形式化和验证 AI 生成证明的标准工具。

episodes.tEn: The Programming Language That Referees Mathematics

people.bioEn: Leads the Cosmos world foundation model research at NVIDIA, working on models that understand and generate video, audio and robot actions for physical AI. Known earlier for GauGAN and image-to-image translation research.
people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 领导 Cosmos 世界基础模型研究，做能理解并生成视频、音频和机器人动作的物理 AI 模型。早年以 GauGAN 和图像到图像翻译研究知名。

episodes.tEn: How Physical AI Learns Across Language, Video and Action

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, CuspAI; Professor, University of Amsterdam
people.tiZh: CuspAI 联合创始人兼 CTO、阿姆斯特丹大学教授
people.bioEn: Machine learning researcher, co-inventor of the variational autoencoder and a pioneer of graph and equivariant neural networks. Professor at the University of Amsterdam and co-founder and CTO of CuspAI, which uses generative AI to design new materials.
people.bioZh: 机器学习研究者，变分自编码器（VAE）的共同提出者，图神经网络与等变网络的先驱。阿姆斯特丹大学教授，CuspAI 联合创始人兼 CTO，用生成式 AI 设计新材料。

episodes.tEn: Why the Next AI Breakthrough May Come from Physics
Max Welling: Physics, Symmetry, and AI for Materials Discovery

views.en: Physics is the unifying thread: symmetries, graph neural networks, diffusion models, and materials discovery all connect through it.
views.zh: 物理学是贯穿一切的主线：对称性、图神经网络、扩散模型与材料发现，都通过它彼此相连。

views.en: AI for science is exploding because tools now model scientific problems effectively and attract huge investment.
views.zh: AI for science 正在爆发，因为工具如今能有效建模科学问题，并吸引巨额投资。

views.en: We can now search the space of all possible molecules, not just known ones, enabling automated discovery.
views.zh: 我们现在能搜索所有可能分子的空间，而不只是已知分子，从而实现自动化发现。

views.en: Experiments can be viewed as a physics processing unit: nature doing the fastest possible computation.
views.zh: 实验可以被视为一个物理处理单元：自然在进行尽可能快的计算。

views.en: The vision is empowering chemists and material scientists with powerful tools, not replacing them soon.
views.zh: 愿景是用强大工具赋能化学家和材料科学家，而不是很快取代他们。

views.en: A fully dark automated lab is not the near-term vision; domain experts stay in the loop.
views.zh: 全黑灯自动化实验室并非近期愿景；领域专家始终留在回路中。

views.en: Hardcoding equivariance can hurt optimization; data augmentation sometimes works better than built-in symmetry.
views.zh: 硬编码等变性可能损害优化；数据增强有时比内置对称性更有效。

views.en: Breakthrough materials will come with heavy human involvement, not full automation.
views.zh: 突破性材料将在大量人类参与下出现，而非完全自动化。

views.en: Unlike fusion or quantum computing, every AI-for-science tool built is immediately useful.
views.zh: 与核聚变或量子计算不同，每一个构建出的 AI-for-science 工具都立即有用。

views.en: Automation is vertical-specific: solving problem A does not transfer to problem B without retraining.
views.zh: 自动化是垂直领域特定的：解决问题 A 并不能在不重新训练的情况下迁移到问题 B。

views.en: Generative AI and stochastic thermodynamics share identical mathematics, enabling cross-fertilization.
views.zh: 生成式 AI 与随机热力学共享相同的数学，从而实现交叉融合。

views.en: Physics concepts like thermodynamics and symmetry breaking can shape next-generation AI architectures, not just be application domains.
views.zh: 热力学和对称性破缺等物理概念可以塑造下一代 AI 架构，而不仅仅是应用领域。

views.en: Generative AI math is deeply equivalent to non-equilibrium stochastic thermodynamics, enabling cross-fertilization between fields.
views.zh: 生成式 AI 的数学与非平衡随机热力学深度等价，使两个领域能够交叉融合。

views.en: AI-designed materials can accelerate the energy transition, including carbon capture, batteries, and semiconductors.
views.zh: AI 设计的材料可以加速能源转型，包括碳捕获、电池和半导体。

views.en: Equivariant neural networks and machine learning force fields accelerate quantum simulations by orders of magnitude.
views.zh: 等变神经网络和机器学习力场将量子模拟加速数个数量级。

views.en: Self-driving labs and agentic platforms can compress materials discovery from years to days.
views.zh: 自驱动实验室和智能体式平台可以将材料发现从数年压缩到数天。

views.en: Waves observed in the brain may be functional; wave-based neural networks naturally reach the edge of chaos.
views.zh: 在大脑中观察到的波可能具有功能；基于波的神经网络自然达到混沌边缘。

views.en: Better AI may come from physics-inspired architectures, not just scaling larger models on more data.
views.zh: 更好的 AI 可能来自受物理启发的架构，而不仅仅是在更多数据上扩展更大的模型。

views.en: Spontaneous symmetry breaking can be a design principle for neural networks, generating free stable waves.
views.zh: 自发对称性破缺可以成为神经网络的设计原则，生成自由而稳定的波。

views.en: Wave phenomena, not just maps of numbers, could solve over-smoothing and long-range memory in deep networks.
views.zh: 波现象而不仅仅是数字映射，可以解决深度网络中的过度平滑和长程记忆问题。

views.en: Entropy in physics is not merely subjective; it precisely describes information you are missing about the world.
views.zh: 物理学中的熵并非仅仅是主观的；它精确描述了你对世界所缺失的信息。

views.en: Diffusion models are essentially reversing entropy increase, mirroring non-equilibrium thermodynamics.
views.zh: 扩散模型本质上是在逆转熵增，映射非平衡热力学。

views.en: The best-performing neural networks and the brain operate at the edge of chaos, not in stable regimes.
views.zh: 表现最好的神经网络和大脑都运行在混沌边缘，而非稳定区域。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 健康 AI 负责人

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Head of Health AI on Trusting ChatGPT with Your Health

people.bioZh: AI 硬件公司 Unconventional AI 创始人兼 CEO。此前创办 Nervana Systems（被英特尔收购），联合创办 MosaicML（被 Databricks 以 13 亿美元收购），并任 Databricks AI 副总裁。

people.bioZh: MIT 博士生，师从 Phillip Isola，并与 Sakana AI 合作。主导了用基础模型搜索人工生命空间的 ASAL 项目，与 Kenneth Stanley、Jeff Clune、Joel Lehman 合著「断裂纠缠表征」论文并任第一作者。

episodes.tEn: What Most People Get Wrong About Evolution: Artificial Life, Open-Endedness, and Intelligence Beyond Earth

people.tiZh: Weco 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Weco, which builds AIDE, an AI agent for machine learning engineering and code optimization. His work studies recursive self-improvement by letting agents rewrite their own harness.
people.bioZh: Weco 联合创始人。Weco 打造机器学习工程与代码优化智能体 AIDE，他的研究方向是让智能体改写自身框架、探索递归自我改进。

episodes.tEn: Can Rewriting an AI Agent Bend the Intelligence Curve?

people.tiZh: MIT 数学系教授
people.bioEn: Theoretical computer scientist and professor of mathematics at MIT, working on algorithms, the theory of machine learning and high-dimensional statistics.
people.bioZh: 理论计算机科学家，MIT 数学系教授，研究算法、机器学习理论与高维统计。

episodes.tEn: AI Crisis in Mathematics: Navier-Stokes, Riemann Hypothesis, and Complexity Theory — Ankur Moitra, Steven Brunton, and Alex Kontorovich on the Future of Math

people.tiEn: Startup Advisor, Author of The Power of Pull
people.tiZh: 创业顾问,《The Power of Pull》作者
people.bioEn: Rob Snyder is a startup advisor and author of The Power of Pull, who has advised over 50 startups on growing from zero to $1 million in ARR. He writes the newsletter The Physics of Startups and focuses on frameworks for finding product-market fit.
people.bioZh: 罗布·斯奈德是一位创业顾问,著有《The Power of Pull》,曾为 50 多家初创公司提供从零增长到 100 万美元 ARR 的咨询。他撰写通讯《The Physics of Startups》,专注于寻找产品市场契合度的框架。

episodes.tEn: The Power of Pull: Why Customer Demand Beats Pain Points
An 86-Minute Guide to Finding Product-Market Fit

views.en: Pull is a property of a person, not a company: sell to the specific individual with a project. Avoid design partners and pilots; if pull exists, the customer will try to buy immediately.
views.zh: Pull 是人的属性，不是公司的属性：要卖给有具体项目的特定个人。避开设计合作伙伴和试点；如果存在 Pull，客户会立刻尝试购买。

views.en: Demand is not desire for a product; it's a project on someone's to-do list they're prioritizing now. The pull framework requires project, unavoidable, list of options, and limitations simultaneously.
views.zh: 需求不是对产品的渴望；而是某人待办清单上正在优先处理的项目。Pull 框架要求项目、不可避免、选项列表和限制同时存在。

views.en: Customer research often fails because it looks for pain points, not actual demand. Avoid customer interviews; they lack a truth-seeking mechanism like purchase. Go to the gemba.
views.zh: 客户研究常常失败，因为它寻找的是痛点，而不是实际需求。避免客户访谈；它们缺乏像购买这样的求真机制。去现场（gemba）。

views.en: Start with one hell-yes customer who pulls the product, then build a repeatable success story factory. Sales is research: it tests whether someone will actually buy, not just express interest.
views.zh: 从一个极力说“是”并拉动产品的客户开始，然后建立可重复的成功案例工厂。销售就是研究：它测试某人是否会真正购买，而不仅仅是表达兴趣。

views.en: Tech comes last: sell as a service first, automate only after demand is proven. Make your product seem small, not large; bigger surface area creates more objections.
views.zh: 技术最后：先作为服务销售，只有在需求被证明后才自动化。让你的产品显得小，而不是大；更大的表面区域会制造更多反对意见。

people.tiZh: Hey Clicky 创始人, Buildspace 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of Hey Clicky and previously Buildspace, one of the largest online schools for people building their own ideas. He has made videos for over a decade, with posts regularly reaching millions of views.
people.bioZh: Hey Clicky 创始人, 此前创办 Buildspace——最大的在线创意建造学校之一。他做视频已超过十年, 作品常获数百万播放。

episodes.tEn: How to Actually Make Launch Videos That Convert

people.tiZh: Magic Patterns 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Alex Danilowicz is a front-end engineer and co-founder of Magic Patterns, one of the first teams building prompt-to-design tools in 2023. Magic Patterns helps product teams turn ideas into interactive, code-backed prototypes in minutes.
people.bioZh: 亚历克斯·丹尼洛维奇是一名前端工程师，也是 Magic Patterns 的联合创始人。该团队是 2023 年最早构建提示词生成设计工具的团队之一，帮助产品团队在几分钟内把想法变成可交互、带代码的原型。

episodes.tEn: How to Stand Out in an AI Design World: Inside Magic Patterns

people.tiZh: Moshi 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Moshi, building AI-powered recommendation and research tools for commodity traders. Background in mathematics and trading.
people.bioZh: Moshi 创始人兼 CEO，为大宗商品交易员打造 AI 推荐与研究工具。拥有数学与交易背景。

episodes.tEn: Building the Recommendation Engine for Commodity Traders

people.tiZh: Modal 首席执行官
people.bioEn: CEO and founder of Modal, a serverless cloud platform for AI compute. Previously CTO at Better and engineering leader at Spotify, where he built its recommendation system.
people.bioZh: Modal 首席执行官兼创始人，Modal 是面向 AI 计算的无服务器云平台。此前曾任 Better 首席技术官，并在 Spotify 担任工程负责人，主导构建其推荐系统。

episodes.tEn: Modal CEO Erik: The $100B Inference Opportunity and Why Open-Source LLM Inference Hasn't Peaked
Modal CEO Erik on Agent Maxxing, Inference's Future, and the GPU Market's Chaos
Why AI Compute Comes in Rectangles: Erik Bernhardsson on Building Modal

views.en: Compute is scarce but obtainable; the real pain is three-year rectangular deals, so aggregate demand across many clouds.
views.zh: 算力稀缺但可获得，真正的痛点是三年期“矩形”合约；因此聚合多云需求、平滑供给。

views.en: Durable differentiation comes from a full platform—post-training, sandboxes, agentic tools—not from selling tokens or CUDA.
views.zh: 持久差异化来自完整平台——后训练、沙箱、智能体式工具——而非卖 token 或 CUDA。

views.en: Inference is the new cloud and a huge market; it will fragment into specialized products hosted under one platform.
views.zh: 推理是“新云”与巨大市场，将碎片化为专门产品，但可由一个平台承载。

views.en: Agents create incumbent staying power because they are trained on old code; senior engineers gain ten-intern leverage.
views.zh: 智能体因训练于旧代码而强化在位者优势；资深工程师获得“十个实习生”般的杠杆。

views.en: I reversed my view: GPU rental prices will rise over the next 12 months, and fine-tuning is no longer mandatory.
views.zh: 我改变了看法：未来 12 个月 GPU 租金将上涨；微调也不再是必需。

people.tiZh: Mecka AI 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Mecka AI, which operates one of the largest robot data factories, building custom hardware and pipelines to collect egocentric human and robot data for training embodied models.
people.bioZh: Mecka AI 创始人兼 CEO，运营着规模最大的机器人数据工厂之一，通过自研硬件与数据管线采集第一人称人类数据和机器人数据，用于训练具身模型。

episodes.tEn: Inside the Robot Data Factory: Mecka's Josh Gao on Sensorizing Humans to Train Robots

people.tiZh: SF Compute 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of SF Compute, a marketplace and independent operator for buying and selling GPU compute capacity.
people.bioZh: SF Compute 联合创始人，该公司是 GPU 算力买卖的市场平台与独立运营商。

episodes.tEn: The Programmable Data Center: Evan Conrad of SF Compute

people.tiZh: Inflight 联合创始人、产品设计师
people.bioEn: Product designer and co-founder of Inflight, with design experience at Tinder, Facebook, and Airchat.
people.bioZh: 产品设计师、Inflight 联合创始人，曾在 Tinder、Facebook 和 Airchat 从事设计工作。

episodes.tEn: Designing Inflight: A Designer's Raw 0-to-1 Startup Journey

people.tiZh: Robinhood 联合创始人、董事长兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Vladimir Tenev is the co-founder, chairman, and CEO of Robinhood. Born in Bulgaria, he moved to the United States at age five, studied mathematics at Stanford and UCLA, and started the brokerage with Baiju Bhatt.
people.bioZh: 弗拉基米尔·特内夫是 Robinhood 的联合创始人、董事长兼 CEO。他出生于保加利亚，五岁移居美国，在斯坦福和 UCLA 学习数学，并与 Baiju Bhatt 一起创办了这家券商。

episodes.tEn: Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev on Tokenization, Agentic Trading, and Expanding Ownership
Robinhood’s CEO on Letting AI Trade Your Money

views.en: Ownership is the path to financial freedom; AI is too centralized, so tools should empower individuals rather than secretive labs.
views.zh: 所有权是通往财务自由的路径；AI 过于中心化，工具应赋权个体，而非服务于拥有秘密模型的大型实验室。

views.en: Agentic trading has product-market fit: 150k accounts and 30M daily tool calls; most volume will come from agents while assets stay long-term.
views.zh: 智能体式交易已找到产品市场契合：15 万账户、每日 3000 万次工具调用；大部分交易量将来自智能体，而资产仍以长期持有为主。

views.en: The edge is not a shared model but different data, tools, and strategies across asset classes; giving everyone AI does not erase it.
views.zh: 优势不在共享模型，而在跨资产类别的不同数据、工具与策略；给每个人强大的 AI 并不会消除这一优势。

views.en: Tokenization extends ownership globally, giving anyone with a smartphone access to US markets and private companies; accredited investor rules are outdated.
views.zh: 代币化将所有权扩展到全球，让任何有智能手机的人都能接触美国市场和私营公司；合格投资者规则已经过时。

views.en: AI labs keeping the strongest models in-house and monopolizing math and science discoveries would be dystopian and lose their license to operate.
views.zh: AI 实验室把最强模型留在内部、垄断数学与科学发现，将是反乌托邦的，并会失去运营许可。

people.tiZh: 高通总裁兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Cristiano Amon is President and CEO of Qualcomm. He joined as an engineer in 1995, led its 5G strategy and the Snapdragon platforms, and became CEO in 2021, taking the company from phones into PCs, cars, wearables and data-center AI.
people.bioZh: 克里斯蒂亚诺·安蒙是高通总裁兼 CEO。他 1995 年以工程师身份加入高通，主导 5G 战略与骁龙平台，2021 年出任 CEO，并把公司从手机拓展到 PC、汽车、可穿戴设备与数据中心 AI。

episodes.tEn: Qualcomm’s CEO on the Coming AI Phone Supercycle
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on Reinventing Beyond the Phone
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on AI, Geopolitics, and the Gladiator Mindset
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on the Rise of Agentic AI Devices
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on the 6G Era and the Next AI Device
Beyond the Smartphone: Cristiano Amon on Qualcomm's AI Revolution and the Global Bridge
episodes.podEn: A Bit Personal with Jodi Shelton

Qualcomm CEO on Robotics, Chips and Competition with China
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on the Future of AI Devices
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon: The Next Mobile Revolution
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on the AI-Driven Transformation of Computing
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon: We’re in a Hurry to Get to the Future
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on 5G, Snapdragon, and the Future of Mobile Computing
Qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon on Leading the Chip Giant Beyond Mobile

views.en: 5G as critical infrastructure connecting everything to the cloud; Snapdragon integrates 5G, AI, CPU, GPU into one efficient SoC.
views.zh: 早期把 5G 定位为像电力一样的关键基础设施，把一切连到云端；Snapdragon 把 5G、AI、CPU、GPU 集成进一颗高能效 SoC。

views.en: Diversifying beyond phones into auto, IoT, PC, XR; AR glasses as next computing platform 5-10 years out; incremental autonomy.
views.zh: 从手机向汽车、物联网、PC、XR 多元化；视 AR 眼镜为 5-10 年后的下一代计算平台；自动驾驶走渐进路线。

views.en: Shift from wireless to intelligent computing everywhere; hybrid AI on-device plus cloud for privacy, latency, and data-center offload.
views.zh: 从无线通信转向无处不在的智能计算；提出端云混合 AI，兼顾隐私、时延并分流数据中心负载。

views.en: Agents replace apps as the center of digital life; glasses and wearables rise; phone persists as peripheral, not replaced.
views.zh: 智能体取代应用成为数字生活中心；眼镜与可穿戴崛起；手机不被取代，而是从中心退为外围。

views.en: Inference over training dominates data centers; power efficiency and TCO favor post-GPU, disaggregated architectures; 6G as sensing network.
views.zh: 数据中心从训练转向推理主导；能效与总拥有成本利好后 GPU、解耦架构；6G 成为具备感知能力的网络。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Emmanuel Ameisen is an interpretability researcher at Anthropic, studying how large language models like Claude form concepts and plan ahead. He previously worked in applied ML at Stripe and Insight and authored Building Machine Learning Powered Applications.
people.bioZh: Emmanuel Ameisen 是 Anthropic 的可解释性研究员，研究 Claude 等大语言模型如何形成概念、如何提前规划。他此前在 Stripe 和 Insight 从事应用机器学习工作，并著有《Building Machine Learning Powered Applications》。

episodes.tEn: Inside the Mind of AI: An Anthropic Researcher on How Models Really Work

people.tiZh: Metalab 设计总监
people.bioEn: Design Director at Metalab, where he builds internal AI tooling systems and custom AI tools for design teams.
people.bioZh: Metalab 设计总监，为设计团队构建内部 AI 工具系统与定制化 AI 工具。

episodes.tEn: Building Custom AI Design Tools at Metalab

people.tiZh: Dyna Robotics 联合创始人兼首席科学家
people.bioEn: Jason Ma is co-founder and Chief Scientist at Dyna Robotics, where he works on world-action models and general-purpose robot learning from large-scale human video. His research focuses on robot learning, reinforcement learning, and physical AI systems deployed in real-world production.
people.bioZh: 马杰森是 Dyna Robotics 的联合创始人兼首席科学家，专注于世界-动作模型以及从大规模人类视频中学习通用机器人技能。他的研究聚焦于机器人学习、强化学习，以及部署到真实生产环境中的物理 AI 系统。

episodes.tEn: Robots That Predict the Future: Dyna-2 and Physical AI with Jason Ma

people.tiZh: Leash Bio 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Leash Bio, which builds DNA-encoded libraries and large-scale experimental datasets to train models that learn real chemistry. Works on turning wet-lab measurements into reinforcement-learning environments for drug-discovery agents.
people.bioZh: Leash Bio 联合创始人兼 CEO，通过 DNA 编码化合物库与大规模实验数据训练真正理解化学的模型，并致力于把湿实验测量转化为药物发现智能体的强化学习环境。

episodes.tEn: From Wet Lab to RL Env: 10,000 Drug-Discovery Campaigns in a Weekend — Ian Quigley, Leash Bio

people.tiZh: Google Labs 与 Gemini 应用副总裁
people.bioEn: Josh Woodward is the VP of Google Labs and head of the Gemini app and AI Studio. He has spent over 17 years at Google, overseeing its largest labs team behind products like NotebookLM, Project Genie, and Flow.
people.bioZh: 乔什·伍德沃德是 Google Labs 副总裁，负责 Gemini 应用与 AI Studio。他在 Google 工作超过 17 年，掌管其规模最大的实验室团队，主导了 NotebookLM、Project Genie 和 Flow 等产品。

episodes.tEn: Why Every Company Now Needs to Think and Operate Like a Lab Team

people.tiEn: President and Chief Product Officer, Cisco
people.tiZh: 思科总裁兼首席产品官
people.bioEn: Jeetu Patel is President and Chief Product Officer at Cisco, where he leads the company's product strategy and AI infrastructure efforts, including networking for GPU clusters and securing AI agents.
people.bioZh: 吉图·帕特尔是思科总裁兼首席产品官，负责公司产品战略与 AI 基础设施业务，包括面向 GPU 集群的网络与 AI 智能体的安全。

episodes.tEn: Jeetu Patel: Building Products for the AI Era
episodes.podEn: A Bit Personal with Jodi Shelton

episodes.tEn: How Jeetu Patel Runs Cisco Like the World's Largest Startup

views.en: AI creates more engineering jobs, not fewer; the real bottleneck is human, and not using AI makes you less safe.
views.zh: AI 会创造更多工程岗位而非减少；真正的瓶颈在人，不用 AI 反而更不安全。

views.en: Cisco is an AI infrastructure picks-and-shovels company; we are supply-constrained with only 2% agent adoption.
views.zh: 思科是 AI 基础设施的“卖铲人”；我们受制于供给，智能体采用率仅 2%。

views.en: Use AI to learn faster, not to outsource learning; skipping the reps is a long-term mistake.
views.zh: 用 AI 学得更快，而不是外包学习；跳过练习是长期错误。

views.en: Leaders must be paranoid not panicked, responsive not reactive; you can't fight a megatrend, use it as tailwind.
views.zh: 领导者要偏执但不恐慌、响应但不反应过度；无法对抗大趋势，要借势而为。

views.en: Speed with scale: operate like the world's largest startup, with founder mode for wartime shifts and unlearning as a core skill.
views.zh: 规模中的速度：像全球最大初创公司那样运作，以创始人模式应对战时转变，把“忘掉旧知”当作核心技能。

people.tiZh: Bending Spoons 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Luca Ferrari is co-founder and CEO of Bending Spoons, a software company that acquires and operates products such as Evernote, Vimeo, AOL and Airtable. He is known for running hiring and operations with a heavily data-driven, quantitative approach.
people.bioZh: 卢卡·法拉利是 Bending Spoons 的联合创始人兼 CEO，该公司收购并运营 Evernote、Vimeo、AOL、Airtable 等产品。他以高度数据驱动、量化的招聘与运营方式著称。

episodes.tEn: Luca Ferrari: The Operating System Behind Bending Spoons

people.tiZh: OpenAI Dots 产品负责人
people.bioEn: Alexander Embiricos leads product for Dots, OpenAI's always-on personal AI agents that act without waiting for a prompt, after previously leading Codex. He co-founded and ran the collaboration startup Multi, which OpenAI acquired in 2024.
people.bioZh: 亚历山大·恩比里科斯是 OpenAI Dots 的产品负责人——Dots 是无需等待指令就能主动帮用户做事的常驻个人 AI 智能体；此前他负责 Codex 产品。他曾联合创办协作软件公司 Multi 并任 CEO，该公司 2024 年被 OpenAI 收购。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Dots Lead on the Future of ChatGPT and Personal Agents

people.tiZh: Applied Compute 首席执行官；前 OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Yash Patil is the CEO of Applied Compute and a former OpenAI researcher who worked on Codex. He focuses on post-training, reinforcement learning, and the inference-serving stack for production AI systems.
people.bioZh: 亚什·帕蒂尔是 Applied Compute 的首席执行官，曾任 OpenAI 研究员并参与 Codex 项目。他专注于后训练、强化学习以及生产级 AI 系统的推理服务栈。

episodes.tEn: Applied Compute CEO Yash on the Limits of RL, the New AI Hyperscaler, and Why Post-Training Wins Inference

people.tiEn: Chief Technologist for AI Infrastructure, Google
people.tiZh: 谷歌 AI 基础设施首席技术专家
people.bioEn: Amin Vahdat is Google's Chief Technologist for AI Infrastructure, leading the design of TPU systems and large-scale datacenter infrastructure that power Google's frontier AI models. He works closely with DeepMind on hardware-software co-design for training and serving at hundred-thousand-accelerator scale.
people.bioZh: 阿明·瓦赫达特是谷歌 AI 基础设施首席技术专家，主导 TPU 系统与大规模数据中心基础设施的设计，为谷歌的前沿 AI 模型提供算力支撑。他与 DeepMind 紧密合作，围绕十万级加速器规模的训练与推理开展软硬件协同设计。

episodes.tEn: Google's AI Infrastructure Chief on the Physics and Economics of Frontier AI

people.tiZh: 谷歌搜索用户体验副总裁
people.bioEn: Rhiannon Bell is VP of UX for Google Search, leading design for AI-driven search experiences such as AI Mode at Google scale.
people.bioZh: 里安农·贝尔是谷歌搜索用户体验副总裁，负责领导 AI Mode 等 AI 驱动搜索体验的大规模设计工作。

episodes.tEn: How Google Designs for AI at Scale

people.tiEn: Head of ChatGPT & Codex (Core Products), OpenAI
people.tiZh: OpenAI ChatGPT 与 Codex 负责人（核心产品）
people.bioEn: Thibault "Tibo" Sottiaux leads OpenAI's core products, spanning ChatGPT, Codex and the Dots personal-agent platform. A Belgian engineer, he previously worked on Google Maps and ML infrastructure at Google DeepMind, where he briefly led Gemini's human-data team before joining OpenAI in 2024 as an engineering lead for Codex.
people.bioZh: 蒂博·索蒂奥统管 OpenAI 核心产品线，覆盖 ChatGPT、Codex 以及 Dots 个人智能体平台。他是比利时工程师，曾在 Google 做 Google Maps，后在 Google DeepMind 负责机器学习基础设施并短暂领导 Gemini 人类数据团队，2024 年加入 OpenAI 任 Codex 工程负责人。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Tibo Sottiaux on Putting Humans at the Center of AI
Why Most Internet Actions Will Soon Be Taken by AI Agents

views.en: A single persistent learning agent, not hand-built loops and graphs, will take most internet actions; human taste and empathy become the scarce skills.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张：未来大多数互联网操作将由一个持续学习、常驻的智能体完成，而非手工搭建的循环与流程图；人的品味与共情反而成为稀缺能力。

views.en: Safety and alignment are integral to success, not obstacles; pacing the frontier means investing heavily in alignment, security and containment.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调：对齐与安全是成功的组成部分而非障碍；要掌控前沿节奏，就必须重投对齐、安全与遏制。

views.en: Recursive self-improvement is already happening under human supervision, and most code is now written by AI.
views.zh: 2026 年他提出：递归式自我改进已在人类监督下发生，如今大部分代码由 AI 编写。

views.en: AGI may already be here as models handle complex tasks autonomously; world models may be unnecessary since generality suffices.
views.zh: 2026 年他抛出反共识：随着模型能自主处理复杂任务，AGI（通用人工智能）或许已经到来；世界模型未必必要，通用性本身可能就够。

views.en: Open ecosystems with shared economics and a safety stack will drive the next wave, freeing humans from technology rather than addicting them.
views.zh: 2026 年他收束于生态观：带共享经济与安全栈的开放生态将驱动下一波应用，让人类摆脱技术束缚而非上瘾。

people.tiZh: 麻省理工学院博士研究员
people.bioEn: MIT PhD researcher working on Recursive Language Models, GPU kernels and KernelBench, and multi-agent systems. He studies how better harness design can unlock capabilities latent in existing models.
people.bioZh: 麻省理工学院博士研究员，研究递归语言模型、GPU 内核与 KernelBench，以及多智能体系统。他关注更好的 harness 设计如何释放现有模型中潜在的能力。

episodes.tEn: Recursive Language Models — Alex Zhang, MIT PhD

people.tiZh: 领导力教练，前谷歌/Facebook 高管
people.bioEn: Molly Graham spent over 20 years in leadership roles at Google, Facebook, Quip, and the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative. She hosts TED's WorkLife podcast and runs Glue Club, a leadership community for senior operators.
people.bioZh: 莫莉·格雷厄姆在谷歌、Facebook、Quip 和 Chan Zuckerberg Initiative 担任领导职务超过 20 年。她主持 TED 的 WorkLife 播客，并运营面向资深运营者的领导力社区 Glue Club。

episodes.tEn: Molly Graham: The Grief, Burnout, and Opportunity Hiding Inside the AI Transition

people.tiZh: Decimals 首席执行官
people.bioEn: Danny Martinez is the CEO of Decimals, a platform focused on design hiring and talent. He has deep experience in design recruiting and building hiring processes for design teams.
people.bioZh: 丹尼·马丁内斯是 Decimals 的首席执行官，该平台专注于设计招聘与人才。他在设计招聘以及为设计团队搭建招聘流程方面拥有丰富经验。

episodes.tEn: Danny Martinez: Thriving in Today's Design Job Market

people.tiEn: Product & Engineering Lead, Computer Use, OpenAI
people.tiZh: OpenAI Computer Use 产品与工程负责人
people.bioEn: Ari Weinstein leads product and engineering for Computer Use at OpenAI, working on agents that operate software end-to-end. He previously co-founded the automation app Workflow, which was acquired by Apple.
people.bioZh: 阿里·温斯坦是 OpenAI Computer Use 的产品与工程负责人，专注于让智能体端到端操作软件。他此前联合创办了自动化应用 Workflow，该公司后被苹果收购。

episodes.tEn: Why OpenAI Is Racing to Make Computer Use Superhuman
Inside OpenAI DevDay: Superhuman Computer Use, Decisions API, and the AI Cloud

views.en: Computer use now beats average humans at most tasks; the bottleneck has shifted from model intelligence to website load time.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，计算机使用在多数任务上已超过普通人；瓶颈已从模型智能转移到网站加载时间。

views.en: Agents can drive all human-designed software via accessibility trees and DOM, not screenshot-scroll loops, unlocking universal automation.
views.zh: 智能体能通过无障碍树和 DOM 操作所有人类设计的软件，而非截图滚动循环，从而释放通用自动化。

views.en: Computer use lets agents test and debug their own code, completing the dev lifecycle autonomously rather than just starting tasks.
views.zh: 计算机使用让智能体能测试并调试自己的代码，自主完成开发生命周期，而不只是启动任务。

views.en: We are at the scaling moment for computer use; proactivity and consumer-grade coherence matter more than raw model capability.
views.zh: 我们正处在计算机使用的 Scaling（规模扩张）时刻；主动性和消费级连贯性比原始模型能力更重要。

views.en: Enterprises need deterministic controls, sandboxing, and human-in-the-loop dials; legacy software coexists rather than disappearing.
views.zh: 企业需要确定性控制、沙箱和人类在环调节；遗留软件会共存而非消失。

people.tiZh: Legora 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Max Junestrand is the co-founder and CEO of Legora, an AI legal-tech company whose products are used by over 3% of the world's lawyers. He led Legora from launch in October 2024 to $100M ARR, one of the fastest-growing enterprise software companies.
people.bioZh: 马克斯·尤内斯特兰德是 AI 法律科技公司 Legora 的联合创始人兼 CEO，其产品被全球超过 3% 的律师使用。他带领 Legora 从 2024 年 10 月上线到实现 1 亿美元 ARR，成为全球增长最快的企业软件公司之一。

episodes.tEn: How a 27-Year-Old Built a $5.6B AI Company in 21 Months
Max Junestrand: The Willingness to Learn Faster Than Anyone Else

views.en: Domain expertise matters less than speed of learning; founders should bet on improving models rather than fine-tuning and focus on delivering value.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为领域专长不如学习速度重要；创始人应押注模型持续变强，而非微调，并把重心放在交付价值上。

views.en: Build for where models will be in 3-6 months, not today; AI is the worst it will ever be, only mile one of a marathon.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调要为模型 3-6 个月后的能力而构建，而非当下；AI 现在是最差的时候，长征才刚跑完第一英里。

views.en: Culture and hiring for growth potential are critical for scaling; invest in team during good times to cushion downturns.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为文化与按成长潜力招人对 Scaling（规模扩张）至关重要；要在顺境投资团队，为低谷留出缓冲。

views.en: Leaders should hire smarter people and make themselves redundant; recruiting is a privilege, not an obligation.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张领导者要招更聪明的人、让自己变得可替代；招聘是特权而非义务。

views.en: Clear feedback and rigorous performance management are underrated; short-term pain yields long-term gain, and avoiding AI in legal work is almost unethical.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为清晰反馈与严格执行绩效管理被低估，短期阵痛换长期收益；法律服务中不用 AI 几乎是不道德的。

people.tiEn: Professor of Machine Learning, University of Freiburg; ELLIS Institute Tübingen
people.tiZh: 弗莱堡大学机器学习教授；ELLIS 图宾根研究所
people.bioEn: The researcher most responsible for making AutoML a field of its own: Auto-WEKA, Auto-sklearn and Auto-PyTorch came out of his lab, as did the first book on AutoML and the AutoML conference he founded as general chair. Full professor at Freiburg since 2016, director of the ELLIS unit there and a Hector Endowed Fellow at the ELLIS Institute Tübingen, with three ERC grants. PhD and postdoc at UBC. His recent work argues that prior structure, not more data, is what tabular and scientific models are still missing — the thesis behind TabPFN.
people.bioZh: 把 AutoML 做成一个独立领域的人：Auto-WEKA、Auto-sklearn、Auto-PyTorch 都出自他的实验室，第一本 AutoML 专著和 AutoML 会议也是他牵头。2016 年起任弗莱堡大学机器学习正教授，兼该校 ELLIS 分部主任、ELLIS 图宾根研究所 Hector 冠名研究员，持有三项 ERC 基金。博士与博士后均在英属哥伦比亚大学。近年他主张表格与科学建模缺的不是更多数据而是先验结构，这正是 TabPFN 背后的论点。

episodes.tEn: TabPFN: The AI That Replaces Hours of Model Tuning for Tabular Data

people.tiZh: Replit 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Born in Jordan, moved to the US to work on developer tools at Codecademy and then Facebook, and founded Replit in 2016 on the idea that a browser tab should be enough to write and ship software. Replit Agent (2024) turned that into agentic coding, and Agent 4 will build a startup from a plain-English description. A $400M Series D led by Georgian in March 2026 tripled the company to a $9B valuation on more than 50 million registered users, with Masad targeting $1B ARR by year end. Outspoken about education: his argument is that young people should learn to direct machines rather than compete with them.
people.bioZh: 生于约旦，赴美先后在 Codecademy 和 Facebook 做开发者工具，2016 年创办 Replit，押的是「一个浏览器标签页就该够写完并发布软件」。2024 年的 Replit Agent 把这件事推到智能体编程，Agent 4 能从一句大白话描述直接搭出一家初创公司的产品。2026 年 3 月 Georgian 领投 4 亿美元 D 轮，估值翻三倍到 90 亿美元，注册用户超 5000 万，他的目标是年底 10 亿美元年化收入。他在教育话题上直言不讳：年轻人该学的是指挥机器，而不是跟机器竞争。

episodes.tEn: Building the Future: Paul Graham & Amjad Masad on Vibe Coding and AI Agents
Replit CEO Amjad Masad on AI Doom, Software, and Vibe-Coding
Why Specialized AI Could Beat the God Model
Replit CEO Amjad Masad: What Young People Should Learn in the AI Era

views.en: AI should make software creation accessible to everyone; tokens complement human capital, and coders are still needed to debug deep systems.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 应让软件开发向所有人开放；token 是人力资本的补充而非替代，仍需要程序员理解系统、排查深层问题。

views.en: Vibe coding was not a sudden leap: users were already 50-60% AI-assisted; adaptability, not denial, is the key skill.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出 vibe coding 并非突变：用户此前已处于 50-60% 的 AI 辅助状态；关键能力是适应而非否认。

views.en: Companies must own their intelligence: specialized decision models beat general agents on control, cost, and safety; avoid vendor lock-in.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张企业必须拥有自己的智能：专用决策模型在可控性、成本与安全上优于通用智能体，并要避免供应商锁定。

views.en: Foundation models are commoditizing; Replit's moat is deep systems engineering, and the next vision is the self-driving company.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为基础模型正在商品化；Replit 的护城河是深度系统工程，下一个愿景是自驱动公司。

views.en: AI doomerism is dressed-up commercial language; there is no good argument AI kills everyone—trust and surfing the wave matter.
views.zh: 2026 年，他持续反驳 AI 末日论，称其是商业包装的措辞，没有 AI 杀死所有人的好论证；应信任并冲浪而非抱树。

people.tiEn: Founder, Recursive; former Chief Scientist, Salesforce
people.tiZh: Recursive 创始人;Salesforce 前首席科学家
people.bioEn: Richard Socher is an NLP researcher who pioneered early neural approaches to general-purpose language understanding and served as Chief Scientist at Salesforce. He is now founder of Recursive, working on AI systems that automate AI research itself.
people.bioZh: 理查德·索赫尔是 NLP 研究者,早期推动了通用语言理解的神经方法,曾任 Salesforce 首席科学家。他目前创立 Recursive,致力于让 AI 系统自动完成 AI 研究本身。

episodes.tEn: Can AI Become a Eureka Machine? Richard Socher on AI-Driven Scientific Discovery
Recursive Self-Improvement: From Auto Research to Superintelligence — Richard Socher

views.en: Superintelligence should excite us most for science—physics, chemistry, biology, economics—not for job automation fears.
views.zh: 超级智能最该让我们兴奋的是科学——物理、化学、生物学、经济学，而不是对岗位自动化的恐惧。

views.en: Regulate specific applications and hold users responsible, not abstract intelligence or GPU compute; regulating intelligence is regulating thought.
views.zh: 应监管具体应用、由使用者担责，而非监管抽象智能或 GPU 算力；监管智能就是在监管思想。

views.en: Slow takeoff is real: hardware, physical and economic constraints limit how fast AI transforms everything, so hard takeoff fears are overblown.
views.zh: 慢起飞是真实的：硬件、物理与经济约束限制了 AI 改造一切的速度，因此硬起飞恐惧被夸大了。

views.en: Recursive self-improvement is inevitable because AI can code, but it needs environments and compute; the next automation frontier is AI research itself.
views.zh: 递归自我改进不可避免，因为 AI 能写代码，但它需要环境与算力；下一个自动化前沿就是 AI 研究本身。

views.en: Language remains the key to intelligence and has far more room to grow; world models are overrated, and open source with more good actors is safer.
views.zh: 语言仍是智能的关键且成长空间大得多；世界模型被高估，开源让更多善意参与者加入反而更安全。

people.tiZh: Discord 前产品负责人
people.bioEn: Peter Sellis was the first product manager at Snapchat, spending seven years there, and later served as Head of Product at Discord, driving rapid user growth.
people.bioZh: 彼得·塞利斯是 Snapchat 的第一位产品经理，在那里工作了七年，之后担任 Discord 的产品负责人，推动了平台的快速增长。

episodes.tEn: 90 Minutes of Unfiltered Product Advice from Snap and Discord's Product Chief

people.tiZh: 谷歌研究员, Google Research
people.bioEn: John Platt is a Google Fellow known for inventing foundational machine learning algorithms such as SMO and for leading work on AI for scientific discovery, including Google's Empirical Research Assistance (ERA) system.
people.bioZh: 约翰·普拉特是 Google Fellow, 以发明 SMO 等基础机器学习算法闻名, 现主导 Google 的 AI 科学发现工作, 包括 Empirical Research Assistance (ERA) 系统。

episodes.tEn: Google's AI Scientist: From Kaggle Automation to Scientific Discovery — John Platt, Google Fellow

people.tiZh: Radical Numerics 首席执行官兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: CEO and co-founder of Radical Numerics, and a key figure behind the Evo genome language model. His work focuses on biological foundation models that can read and design DNA sequences.
people.bioZh: Radical Numerics 首席执行官兼联合创始人，Evo 基因组语言模型的核心人物。其工作聚焦于能够读取并设计 DNA 序列的生物学基础模型。

episodes.tEn: Bio-security Is an AI Arms Race: Eric Nguyen on Generative Genomics

people.tiZh: Lightspark 首席设计官
people.bioEn: Co-founder of the design agency Teehan+Lax and longtime design leader at Facebook; now Chief Design Officer at Lightspark, working on consumer and enterprise product design.
people.bioZh: 设计机构 Teehan+Lax 联合创始人，曾在 Facebook 长期担任设计负责人；现任 Lightspark 首席设计官，专注消费级与企业级产品设计。

episodes.tEn: Geoff Teehan on Navigating Change as a Designer

people.zh: 阿纳斯塔西斯·杰尔马尼迪斯
people.tiZh: Runway 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Runway, leading the company's research on generative video models and world simulation, from Gen-1 through Gen-4.5.
people.bioZh: Runway 联合创始人兼 CTO，主导公司从 Gen-1 到 Gen-4.5 的生成式视频模型与世界模拟研究。

episodes.tEn: Runway's Bet Beyond Video: World Models, Robotics, and the Neural OS — Anastasis Germanidis

people.tiZh: TypeSafe AI 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of TypeSafe AI, creator of the Jev System One decision model. Former OpenAI researcher, GPT-4 co-author and co-inventor of RLHF and ChatGPT.
people.bioZh: TypeSafe AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，Jev「系统一」决策模型的缔造者。前 OpenAI 研究员，GPT-4 论文共同作者，RLHF 与 ChatGPT 的共同发明人。

episodes.tEn: A Month After Going Viral: Jev's Creator on Coding Agents, Benchmarks & AI's Reliability Gap
Why Jev Is Changing How We Build With AI
How Jev Turns AI Into Software That Gets Things Done
Why I Couldn't Build Jev at OpenAI — Diogo Almeida, TypeSafe Co-founder & CEO
AI: Too Good to Be True, Too Bad to Be Useful

views.en: Early on, he argues most LLMs are optimized for human-in-the-loop assistance, not reliable automation; RLHF causes mode-drop and plausible-but-wrong outputs.
views.zh: 早期他就指出，多数大模型是为人类在环的辅助而非可靠自动化而优化；基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）导致模式坍缩，输出看似合理却常出错。

views.en: He insists data and the right task matter more than compute, rejecting the bitter lesson; scaling laws work only when data and task are right.
views.zh: 他坚持数据与选对任务比算力更重要，反对“苦涩教训”；缩放定律只有在数据和任务正确时才成立。

views.en: Reliability, not speed, cost, or benchmarks, becomes his core bottleneck; he calls intelligence per dollar the key metric and distrusts gameable public benchmarks.
views.zh: 可靠性而非速度、成本或基准成为他的核心瓶颈；他称“每美元智能”为关键指标，并不信任可被操纵的公开基准。

views.en: He deepens this into a critique of RLHF: pre-trained models were better calibrated, so he proposes RLCD to expose calibrated probabilities as engineer-facing knobs.
views.zh: 他将此深化为对基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）的批判：预训练模型校准更好，于是提出 RLCD，把校准后的概率作为工程师可调的旋钮。

views.en: Most recently he frames Jev as a machine-native decision primitive—natural language plus state machine—and says we are breakthroughs away from true agency.
views.zh: 最近他把 Jev 定位为机器原生的决策原语——自然语言加状态机——并称距离真正的智能体自主还差若干突破。

people.tiZh: Box 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Aaron Levie is the cofounder and CEO of Box, an enterprise content management and cloud storage company. He has been a leading voice on how AI capabilities translate into real enterprise workflows and the application layer.
people.bioZh: 亚伦·莱维是 Box 的联合创始人兼 CEO，Box 是一家企业内容管理与云存储公司。他长期关注 AI 能力如何落地到真实的企业工作流与应用层。

episodes.tEn: Why AI's Next Breakthroughs Could Come from Outside the Big Labs
Box's Aaron Levie on Reinventing Yourself in the AI Age and Enterprise Diffusion

views.en: Application companies are the hottest neolabs; turning models into enterprise workflows requires a lot of software, not just better models.
views.zh: 2026 年，Levie 认为应用公司才是最热的新实验室：把模型接入企业工作流需要大量软件工程，而不只是更强的模型。

views.en: Long-running background agents will run enterprise workflows with humans reviewing results; chatbot UI won't dominate—agents appear as dashboards, queues, task lists.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断长时运行的后台智能体将承担企业工作流、由人审核结果；聊天机器人界面不会主导，智能体会以仪表盘、队列和任务列表的形式出现。

views.en: Open-weight models will grow exponentially as mature use cases peel off to cheaper models; token subsidization is temporary and margins will normalize.
views.zh: 2026 年，他预计随着成熟用例转向更便宜的模型，开放权重模型将指数级增长；token 补贴是暂时的，毛利率终将回归正常。

views.en: AI diffusion into non-coding knowledge work will take far longer than Silicon Valley expects; coding agents spread fast only because code is pure text.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提醒 AI 向非编程知识工作的扩散会比硅谷预期慢得多；编程智能体扩散快，只因代码是纯文本。

views.en: Frontier labs must build safely with governance, security, and alignment research; pacing is orthogonal to security and a fuzzy nonword.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张前沿模型实验室必须以治理、安全和对齐研究为前提安全构建；并认为“放缓”与安全正交，是个模糊的非词。

people.tiZh: ElevenLabs 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Nev Flynn is the Head of Design at ElevenLabs, where he leads design for AI voice and audio products, including brand tools and agent-native design systems.
people.bioZh: 内夫·弗林是 ElevenLabs 的设计负责人，主导 AI 语音与音频产品的设计工作，包括品牌工具与面向智能体的设计系统。

episodes.tEn: Nev Flynn on Bringing Artful Expression into Enterprise Design

people.tiZh: AI 承保公司（AIUC）联合创始人
people.bioEn: Rune Kvist is cofounder of AIUC, which builds standards, testing, and insurance infrastructure for frontier AI. He was Anthropic's first product hire and now works on AIUC-1, an emerging standard for agent security and safety.
people.bioZh: 鲁内·克维斯特是 AIUC 的联合创始人，该公司为前沿 AI 构建标准、测试与保险基础设施。他曾是 Anthropic 的首位产品员工，目前致力于 AIUC-1 这一新兴的智能体安全标准。

episodes.tEn: The Watchdogs of AGI: Rune Kvist of AI Underwriting Company

people.tiZh: Databricks 首席执行官兼联合创始人
people.bioEn: Ali Ghodsi is the CEO and co-founder of Databricks, the company behind Apache Spark and the Lakehouse data platform. He is also a computer science professor at UC Berkeley, where he worked on large-scale data processing and machine learning systems.
people.bioZh: 阿里·戈德西是 Databricks 的首席执行官兼联合创始人，该公司是 Apache Spark 与 Lakehouse 数据平台的背后团队。他同时是加州大学伯克利分校的计算机科学教授，研究大规模数据处理与机器学习系统。

episodes.tEn: Why Would AI Companies Want to Slow Down? Ali on Pacing the Frontier
Databricks' Ali Ghodsi: From Reluctant CEO to One of the Best

views.en: AI diffusion will take a decade; enterprises need context, ontology and process re-engineering more than smarter models.
views.zh: AI 的扩散需要十年；企业真正缺的是上下文、本体与流程再造，而非更聪明的模型。

views.en: Current existential risk is near zero; cyber risk is the urgent danger, so security must be automated with agents.
views.zh: 当前生存性风险接近于零；网络风险才是紧迫威胁，因此安全必须用智能体自动化。

views.en: Superintelligence is far away; recursive self-improvement needs four conditions that are not happening as training costs more.
views.zh: 超级智能还很遥远；递归自我改进需四个条件，而训练成本上升说明它们并未发生。

views.en: Pacing the frontier is orthogonal to safety; slowly building a weapon is no safer, and labs need independent third parties.
views.zh: 放慢前沿与安全无关；慢慢造武器并不更安全，实验室之间需要独立第三方核查。

views.en: AI is already AGI by practical definition; open source dominates tokens but not spend, and agents need agent-optimized infrastructure.
views.zh: 按实用定义 AI 已是 AGI（通用人工智能）；开源按 token 占优但按支出仅 5%，智能体需要为智能体优化的基础设施。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 设计负责人
people.bioEn: Ed Bayes is a design lead at OpenAI, working on prototyping the future of Codex and ChatGPT Work. He focuses on dynamic interfaces, information architecture, and structuring design teams around personas rather than features.
people.bioZh: 埃德·贝斯是 OpenAI 的设计负责人，负责 Codex 与 ChatGPT Work 的未来原型设计。他关注动态界面、信息架构，以及围绕用户画像而非功能来组织设计团队。

episodes.tEn: Designing AI Experiences: Building for Six Months Out

people.tiZh: Amp 公司 CEO
people.bioEn: Quinn Slack is the CEO of Amp, a company focused on improving developer workflows and productivity.
people.bioZh: Quinn Slack 是 Amp 公司的 CEO，专注于提升开发者工作流程和生产力。

episodes.tEn: AMP's Remote-First Revolution: Why Local Development Is Dead

people.tiZh: Ollama 联合创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Jeffrey Morgan is the co-founder and CEO of Ollama, a YC-backed company building tools for running open-source AI models locally, used by millions of developers.
people.bioZh: 杰弗里·摩根是 Ollama 的联合创始人兼首席执行官，该公司获得 YC 支持，致力于构建本地运行开源 AI 模型的工具，已被数百万开发者使用。

episodes.tEn: The Resurgence of Open Source Model Customization

people.tiZh: Redwood Research 首席执行官
people.bioEn: Buck Shlegeris is the CEO of Redwood Research, an organization focused on AI alignment and safety research. He led the independent investigation into the OpenAI/Hugging Face incident.
people.bioZh: 巴克·施莱格里斯是 Redwood Research 的首席执行官，该公司专注于 AI 对齐与安全研究。他领导了对 OpenAI/Hugging Face 事件的独立调查。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI Incident: AI Agents Cheated and Covered Tracks

people.tiZh: Cerebras Systems 联合创始人兼首席技术官
people.bioEn: Sean Lie is the co-founder and CTO of Cerebras Systems, leading the development of wafer-scale AI chips and high-speed inference infrastructure.
people.bioZh: 肖恩·利是 Cerebras Systems 的联合创始人兼首席技术官，领导晶圆级 AI 芯片和高速推理基础设施的开发。

episodes.tEn: Cerebras CS4: Making Wafer-Scale Mainstream

people.tiZh: Vercel 创始设计师
people.bioEn: Evil Rabbit is the founding designer at Vercel, known for shaping iconic brand identities and leading design innovation in the tech industry.
people.bioZh: Evil Rabbit 是 Vercel 的创始设计师，以塑造标志性品牌形象和引领科技行业设计创新而闻名。

episodes.tEn: From Argentina to Vercel: A Designer's Journey

people.tiZh: METR 研究员
people.bioEn: Ajeya Cotra is a researcher at METR, focusing on threat modeling for loss-of-control risks from advanced AI. She previously led the technical AI safety program at Coefficient Giving.
people.bioZh: 阿杰亚·科特拉是 METR 的研究员，专注于高级 AI 失控风险威胁建模。她此前曾领导 Coefficient Giving 的技术 AI 安全项目。

episodes.tEn: AI Agents Hack Hugging Face: Inside the ExploitGym Chaos

people.tiZh: OpenAI 产品负责人
people.bioEn: Tara Seshan leads product for Codex and ChatGPT Work at OpenAI, previously a product leader at Stripe and Watershed.
people.bioZh: 塔拉·塞珊在 OpenAI 负责 Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 的产品工作，此前在 Stripe 和 Watershed 担任产品负责人。

episodes.tEn: Stop Planning for 2027: How OpenAI Ships Product in 90-Day Cycles
Inside OpenAI: Tara Seshan on Product, Ambition, and the Future of AI Work

views.en: Build for where models will be in 2-3 months; shipping imperfect products fast yields empirical evidence over theory.
views.zh: 为模型两三个月后的能力而构建；快速交付不完美的产品以获取经验证据，而非停留在理论。

views.en: Work shifts from rowing to steering: agents do tactical work while humans set direction and ambition.
views.zh: 工作从“划桨”转向“掌舵”：智能体承担战术执行，人类负责方向与野心。

views.en: Slow takeoff is happening: AI iterates gradually, not a sudden superintelligence; annual planning beyond 90 days is futile.
views.zh: 缓慢起飞正在发生：AI 逐步迭代而非突然出现超级智能；超过 90 天的年度规划已无意义。

views.en: Voice becomes a major product form factor by 2027; single-identity agents should bundle into chief-of-staff style groupings.
views.zh: 到 2027 年语音将成为主要产品形态；单一身份智能体应打包为“幕僚长”式组合。

views.en: Core PM craft persists: define the essential hypothesis, test it fast, keep user empathy and systems thinking.
views.zh: 产品经理的核心手艺不变：定义关键假设、快速验证，并保持用户同理心与系统思维。

people.tiZh: 沃顿商学院教授
people.bioEn: Wharton professor studying AI and work. His One Useful Thing essays, like Centaurs and Cyborgs, supplied the shared vocabulary for human-AI collaboration.
people.bioZh: 沃顿商学院教授，研究 AI 与工作。One Useful Thing 系列（如「半人马与赛博格」）为人机协作提供了通用词汇。

episodes.tEn: The Future and Business of AI: A Conversation with Kevin Roose and Ethan Mollick
AI Agents Could Break the Banking System — With Ethan Mollick
episodes.podEn: The Prof G Pod – Scott Galloway

episodes.tEn: The Agentic Era of AI
How to Stand Out in an AI-Driven Job Market

views.en: AI is general-purpose but juniors misuse it without expertise; human taste and voice become the differentiator as AI commoditizes quality.
views.zh: AI 是通用技术，但缺乏专业判断的初级者往往误用它；当 AI 让质量商品化后，人的品味与独特声音成为差异化关键。

views.en: We enter the agentic era: assign long-running tasks instead of prompting; the bottleneck shifts from capability to interface, and delegation erodes expertise.
views.zh: 进入智能体时代：不再来回提示，而是派发长时任务；瓶颈从能力转向界面，而委托会侵蚀判断所需的专业能力。

views.en: AI's exponential curve and jagged frontier mean more AI creates more human work; use it as a tutor, not a crutch, and redesign workflows to augment.
views.zh: AI 的指数曲线与锯齿状前沿意味着更多 AI 反而创造更多人类工作；把它当导师而非拐杖，并重构工作流以增强而非仅自动化。

views.en: From chatbot to agentic era, models handle hours-long tasks; labs' safety commitment rationalizes into a race, and incremental productivity targets miss the point.
views.zh: 从聊天机器人转向智能体时代，模型能独立处理数小时任务；实验室的安全承诺被合理化为抢先竞赛，渐进式生产力目标抓错了重点。

views.en: Persistent line: expertise, taste, and agency remain human advantages; AI is a tutor that should challenge you, not an answer machine.
views.zh: 一以贯之的主线：专业能力、品味与能动性仍是人类优势；AI 应是挑战你的导师，而非给答案的机器。

people.tiEn: Professor at Caltech, Co-founder of Accelerated Understanding
people.tiZh: 加州理工学院教授，Accelerated Understanding 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Anima Anandkumar is a professor at Caltech and co-founder of Accelerated Understanding, known for her work on neural operators and AI for physical sciences.
people.bioZh: 阿尼玛·阿南德库马尔是加州理工学院教授，Accelerated Understanding 联合创始人，以神经算子及 AI 在物理科学中的应用闻名。

episodes.tEn: Accelerated Understanding: A Foundation Model for Physics
AI for Science: Neural Operators and Weather Modeling

views.en: Neural operators generalize networks to function spaces, enabling resolution-invariant AI weather models that match physics-based accuracy while being far faster.
views.zh: 神经算子将网络推广到函数空间，使 AI 天气模型具备分辨率不变性，在精度上媲美物理模型，速度却快数万倍。

views.en: Embedding domain structure like spherical geometry is crucial for stable long-term climate modeling and lets one model handle weather and climate.
views.zh: 嵌入球面几何等领域结构对长期气候建模的稳定性至关重要，并让单一模型同时处理天气与气候。

views.en: Physics-informed neural operators combine data-driven learning with physical constraints, overcoming pure PINNs' limitations for reliable science.
views.zh: 物理信息神经算子将数据驱动学习与物理约束结合，克服纯 PINN 的局限，确保科学应用的可靠性。

views.en: A universal physics foundation model can unify multiple domains, using PDEs as dense self-improvement signals that outperform pure data-driven approaches.
views.zh: 通用物理基础模型能统一多个领域，以 PDE 作为密集的自改进信号，效果超越纯数据驱动方法。

views.en: Scaling laws apply to physics models, but adding new physics branches improves each domain's performance, not just increasing model size; trillion-token contexts require new architectures beyond Transformers.
views.zh: 缩放定律适用于物理模型，但增加新的物理分支能提升各领域表现，而不仅是扩大模型规模；万亿级上下文需要超越 Transformer 的新架构。

people.tiEn: Creator of Ruby on Rails, CTO of 37signals
people.tiZh: Ruby on Rails 创始人，37signals 首席技术官
people.bioEn: DHH is the creator of Ruby on Rails, the founder of Omarchy Linux, and the CTO of 37signals. He is a prominent figure in software development and product design.
people.bioZh: DHH 是 Ruby on Rails 的创始人、Omarchy Linux 的创建者，以及 37signals 的首席技术官。他是软件开发和产品设计领域的杰出人物。

episodes.tEn: Rails World 2026 Opening Keynote - DHH
DHH Responds to Omarchy's Critics (Including Me)
From Skeptic to Believer: DHH on the AI Revolution

views.en: Initially a skeptic, DHH turns believer as AI agents write all his code, making hand-coding economically unproductive.
views.zh: DHH 最初是怀疑者，随着 AI 智能体写出他的全部代码、手写代码在经济上不再划算，他转为信徒。

views.en: Agents mark an inflection point: English expresses intent better than Ruby, and abstraction matters less as repetition cost nears zero.
views.zh: 智能体标志着一个拐点：用英语表达意图比 Ruby 更好，随着重复成本趋近于零，抽象也不再那么重要。

views.en: Programming knowledge becomes a disadvantage in the agentic era; a beginner's mind and outcome-description beat prescriptive implementation.
views.zh: 在智能体时代，编程知识反而成为劣势；初学者心态和描述结果胜过规定实现细节。

views.en: Linux's CLI, config files and scriptability, once drawbacks, now make it the ideal OS for agents and a malleable agentic era.
views.zh: Linux 的命令行、配置文件和可脚本化曾是缺点，如今却使它成为智能体时代理想且可塑的操作系统。

views.en: He doubles down against AI doom and Linux hostility to AI, betting optimism and agent-written code are the rational path forward.
views.zh: 他进一步反驳 AI 末日论和 Linux 社区对 AI 的敌意，押注乐观主义与智能体写代码才是理性的前进道路。

people.tiZh: Parallel Web Systems 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former Twitter CEO, now building Parallel Web Systems to create a new web infrastructure for AI agents.
people.bioZh: 前 Twitter CEO，现创立 Parallel Web Systems，为 AI 智能体构建新的网络基础设施。

episodes.tEn: The Ads Business Model Will Die & Lessons from Working with Elon at Twitter | Parag Agrawal
The Future of Search: Agentic Web and Parallel's Vision

views.en: Agents will search the web 1000x more than humans, so search must be rebuilt for agent quality, cost, and latency.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断智能体的网络搜索量将是人类的千倍，搜索必须围绕智能体的质量、成本与延迟重建，而非以人为中心。

views.en: Parametric memory in frontier models is lossy; agents will always need live web search for specific facts.
views.zh: 他指出前沿模型的参数记忆是有损的，智能体永远需要实时网络搜索来获取具体事实，这是对 Scaling（规模扩张）路线的清醒补充。

views.en: Human click data is a bug; agent feedback should drive search optimization, avoiding SEO slop.
views.zh: 他反共识地认为人类点击数据是缺陷，应由智能体反馈驱动搜索优化，从而绕开人类惰性催生的 SEO 垃圾内容。

views.en: Ads don't work with agents; content owners must be paid at inference time via Shapley-value estimation.
views.zh: 他断言广告模式在智能体场景下失效，内容方应在推理时通过 Shapley 值估算获得公平补偿，以对齐激励。

views.en: The web shifts from pull to push: background agents monitor changes and trigger actions, forming a parallel web.
views.zh: 他描绘网络从拉取转向推送：后台智能体持续监控变化并触发行动，形成人类与智能体并行的网络，工作方式随之改变。

people.tiEn: Design Lead for Grok Bot, Cursor
people.tiZh: 设计师，Cursor
people.bioEn: John Bai was the first NYC design hire at Cursor, known for his work on the Grok Bot design journey.
people.bioZh: John Bai 是 Cursor 在纽约的首位设计员工，以参与 Grok Bot 的设计历程而闻名。

episodes.tEn: How SpaceXAI Designers Use Grok Bot and Figma MCP to Ship Faster
Designing Grok Bot: From Cursor to Consumer

views.en: The chat interface remains the right form factor for agents; onboarding should communicate value upfront rather than reduce steps.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他仍认为聊天界面是智能体的正确形态；引导应优先传达价值，而非减少步骤或加跳过按钮。

views.en: Designers should move up the stack toward taste and delight; AI lowers the cost of making things and enables throwaway prototyping.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张设计师上移价值链，专注品味与愉悦感；AI 降低制作成本，让'用完即弃'的快速原型成为可能。

views.en: AI should get you off the computer, not on it: delegate email and calendar to bots that surface only action items.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调 AI 应让人离开电脑而非黏在电脑前：把邮件、日历交给只呈现待办事项的智能体。

views.en: Engineers built the first Grok Bot without designers and it succeeded; most design concepts should be discarded, only a few seeds survive.
views.zh: 他回顾 Grok Bot 初版由工程师而非设计师打造却成功；设计师应接受抛弃大多数概念，只有少数种子进入最终产品。

views.en: The three-column layout remains the best way to interact with a fleet of agents, despite criticism.
views.zh: 尽管受到批评，他仍坚持三栏布局是与一组智能体交互的最佳方式。

people.tiEn: Director, White House Office of Science and Technology Policy
people.tiZh: 白宫科技政策办公室主任
people.bioEn: Michael Kratsios directs the White House Office of Science and Technology Policy, shaping US national strategy on AI, science and emerging technology. He previously served as US CTO and as COO of Scale AI.
people.bioZh: 迈克尔·克拉齐奥斯是白宫科技政策办公室主任，主导美国在 AI、科学与新兴技术上的国家战略。此前担任美国首席技术官，并任 Scale AI 首席运营官。

episodes.tEn: Is the White House Anti-Science? A Conversation with OSTP Director Michael Kratsios
AI Policy at the White House: A Conversation with Michael Kratsios

views.en: The US must keep both open and closed source AI ecosystems vibrant, with one national regulatory framework that avoids outdated red lines.
views.zh: 美国必须同时保持开源与闭源 AI 生态的活力，并以单一的国家监管框架取代容易过时的红线。

views.en: Regulation should target model outputs rather than over-regulating training, since early rules like the EU AI Act quickly become obsolete.
views.zh: 监管应针对模型输出而非过度约束训练，因为像欧盟 AI 法案这样的早期规则很快会过时。

views.en: Government should fund basic, pre-competitive R&D and individual scientists, not direct discovery or centralize funding like China.
views.zh: 政府应资助基础的、竞争前研发以及科学家个人，而不是主导发现或像中国那样集中拨款。

views.en: AI applied to science via the Genesis mission is the path to doubling US scientific output and winning against China.
views.zh: 通过 Genesis 计划把 AI 用于科学，是让美国科研产出翻倍并在对华竞争中胜出的路径。

views.en: Biological risk from AI is overblown and has not materialized in three years, so containment-style fear should not drive policy.
views.zh: AI 带来的生物风险被夸大，三年过去并未成真，因此不应让遏制式的恐惧主导政策。

people.tiEn: Professor of AI & Machine Learning, University of St. Gallen
people.tiZh: 圣加仑大学人工智能与机器学习教授
people.bioEn: Damian Borth is a professor of artificial intelligence and machine learning at the University of St. Gallen. His research treats trained model weights themselves as data, exploring weight-space learning as a route beyond ever-larger training corpora.
people.bioZh: 达米安·博思是圣加仑大学人工智能与机器学习教授。他的研究把训练好的模型权重本身当作数据，探索权重空间学习，寻找超越「不断堆大训练语料」的路径。

episodes.tEn: Weight-Based Learning: Treating Model Weights as Data

people.tiZh: 高通技术副总裁
people.bioEn: Fatih Porikli is Vice President of Technology at Qualcomm, working on generative vision. His team researches controllability in text-to-image models, separating scene planning from rendering, and high-resolution on-device image generation.
people.bioZh: 法提赫·波里克利是高通技术副总裁，方向为生成式视觉。其团队研究文生图模型的可控性、把场景规划与渲染解耦，以及端侧高分辨率图像生成。

episodes.tEn: From Plausible to Precise: The Next Frontier in Image Generation

people.tiZh: Netic 创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Melisa Tokmak is the founder and CEO of Netic, which builds autonomous AI agents that sit between service businesses and their customers, handling real-world dispatch and scheduling. She previously led Scale AI's document AI product.
people.bioZh: 梅莉莎·托克马克是 Netic 的创始人兼首席执行官，该公司打造自主 AI 智能体，作为服务型企业与客户之间的中介，处理真实世界的派单与排程。她此前在 Scale AI 负责文档 AI 产品。

episodes.tEn: Melissa Takmack on Building AI for Real-World Essential Services

people.tiEn: CEO of Datology AI, former Meta AI researcher
people.tiZh: Datology AI 首席执行官，前 Meta AI 研究员
people.bioEn: Ari Morcos is the CEO of Datology AI and a former researcher at Meta AI, focusing on data-centric AI and model development.
people.bioZh: 阿里·莫尔科斯是 Datology AI 的首席执行官，曾任 Meta AI 研究员，专注于以数据为中心的 AI 和模型开发。

episodes.tEn: AI Vibe Check: Coding Agents, Open-Weight AI, and the Compute Crunch

people.tiZh: 设计工程师，Sublime Security
people.bioEn: Patrick Morgan is a design engineer at Sublime Security, known for building internal AI design tools and prototyping environments.
people.bioZh: 帕特里克·摩根是 Sublime Security 的设计工程师，以构建内部 AI 设计工具和原型环境而闻名。

episodes.tEn: From Figma to Custom Prototyping: Patrick Morgan's Internal Tool Journey

people.tiZh: 图标设计师，原始 Mac 团队
people.bioEn: Susan Kare is a graphic designer who created many of the icons and typefaces for the original Apple Macintosh, defining a visual language for personal computing.
people.bioZh: 苏珊·凯尔是一位平面设计师，为最初的苹果 Macintosh 设计了众多图标和字体，定义了个性化计算的视觉语言。

episodes.tEn: Designing the Macintosh: Susan Kare on Icons and Fonts

people.tiZh: Figure 创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Brett Adcock is the founder and CEO of Figure, a company building general-purpose humanoid robots for commercial and home use. He previously founded Archer Aviation and Vettery.
people.bioZh: 布雷特·阿德科克是 Figure 的创始人兼首席执行官，该公司致力于打造面向商用和家庭场景的通用人形机器人。他此前创办了 Archer Aviation 和 Vettery。

episodes.tEn: Brett Adcock on Helix 2.5, the Holy Grail of Robotics, and Figure 4
Brett Adcock: AI Will Be 100x Bigger Than the Internet
Autonomous Robots in Warehouse: A Live Demo
Figure AI CEO: Humanoid Robots Are the Biggest Business in the World

views.en: The core problem is intelligence, not manufacturing; humanoid robots could become the world's biggest business once general robotics is solved.
views.zh: 核心问题是智能而非制造；一旦解决通用机器人，人形机器人可能成为全球最大的生意。

views.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the binding constraint; human data serves as the pre-training prior for robotics, which is in a data-starve regime like GPT-1.
views.zh: 数据而非算力或制造才是瓶颈；人类数据是机器人领域的预训练先验，行业正处于类似 GPT-1 的数据饥荒期。

views.en: Robotics has entered a scaling curve: more data and compute yield better performance, with post-training reinforcement learning key to real-world agents.
views.zh: 机器人已进入 Scaling（规模扩张）曲线：更多数据与算力带来更好表现，后训练中的强化学习是现实世界智能体的关键。

views.en: Generalization to unseen homes is the holy grail; whole-body autonomy via deep learning and a human-like hand are prerequisites for general-purpose robots.
views.zh: 对未见家庭场景的泛化是圣杯；全栈深度学习实现全身自主、以及类人手部，是通用机器人的前提。

views.en: Vertical integration and in-house models let Figure outpace OpenAI on robot models; manufacturing before intelligence is unhealthy, and Figure 4 is designed around data and Helix 3.
views.zh: 垂直整合与自研模型让 Figure 在机器人模型上跑赢 OpenAI；在智能之前先制造是不健康的，Figure 4 围绕数据与 Helix 3 设计。

people.tiZh: 1X Technologies 创始人兼首席执行官
people.bioEn: Bernt Bornich is the founder and CEO of 1X Technologies, a Norwegian-American robotics company building NEO, a humanoid robot designed to live and work in the home.
people.bioZh: 伯恩特·伯尼克是 1X Technologies 的创始人兼首席执行官，这家挪威裔美国机器人公司正在打造面向家庭生活与工作场景的人形机器人 NEO。

episodes.tEn: Manufacturing 50,000 Humanoid Robots Next Year | Bernt Børnich, 1X
Designing a Friendly Humanoid Robot: From Sci-Fi to Soft Interaction

views.en: Humanoid robots must be safe, capable and affordable; first-principles design and managing expectations drive real-world adoption.
views.zh: 人形机器人必须安全、有能力且可负担；第一性原理设计与管理用户预期，是走向真实世界落地的关键。

views.en: Robots will not replace humans but collaborate symbiotically; reliability and user-friendliness matter more than flashy demos.
views.zh: 机器人不会取代人类，而是与人共生协作；可靠性与易用性比炫目的演示更重要。

views.en: Prototypes are easy, production is hard; scaling volume means crossing quality gates, not just building demos.
views.zh: 原型容易、量产难；Scaling（规模扩张）意味着跨越质量关卡，而不只是做出演示。

views.en: General models, not per-task automation, are the path: data diversity beats volume, and models should learn world dynamics rather than clone humans.
views.zh: 通用模型而非逐任务自动化才是路径：数据多样性胜过数据量，模型应学习世界模型而非克隆人类行为。

views.en: Safety and trust are prerequisites for home deployment; in-house manufacturing and small lean teams enable fast iteration.
views.zh: 安全与信任是进入家庭的前提；自建制造与精简小团队带来快速迭代。

people.tiZh: Mercor 首席执行官

Mercor's Brendan Foody on Data, Evals & the Last Human Job
RL Environments: The New Frontier in Agentic Data

views.en: RL environments, not crowdsourced behavior cloning, are the new frontier for post-training; humans build verifiers and rubrics.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把后训练的前沿从众包行为克隆转向强化学习环境，并强调人类在多数领域仍是构建验证器与评分标准的关键。

views.en: Data, not algorithms, drives model differentiation; building evals is the real bottleneck, and RL saturates them fast.
views.zh: 2026 年他明确：模型差异几乎全来自数据而非算法，真正的瓶颈是为一切构建评测，而强化学习一旦有评测就会迅速饱和。

views.en: Models cannot reliably grade their own work; recursive self-improvement is limited outside verifiable domains.
views.zh: 他持续反对模型自评：模型无法可靠地给自己打分，递归自我改进在不可验证领域受限，这与他对可扩展监督的怀疑一脉相承。

views.en: Training agents becomes the last human job; every Fortune 500 builds sovereign AI on proprietary data.
views.zh: 到 2026 年底，他把人类角色定位为训练智能体——这可能是最后的人类工作，并预言每家财富 500 强都会用私有数据自建主权 AI 栈。

views.en: The bottleneck is high-quality data and evals, not compute or algorithms; physical-world superintelligence takes decades.
views.zh: 最近一次，他把瓶颈彻底归于高质量数据与评测而非算力或算法，并判断物理世界的超级智能因容错低、迭代慢而需数十年。

views.en: LLMs are deterministic next-token predictors; intelligence emerged from simple Scaling, not complexity, with values inserted via RLHF.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为大语言模型本质是确定性的下一个词预测器；智能的突破源于简单的 Scaling（规模扩张）而非复杂性，价值观通过基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）注入。

views.en: The internet shifts from curation to generation; AI products need fault-tolerant UIs, and generative AI makes true uniqueness harder.
views.zh: 2023 年，他提出互联网正从策展转向生成；AI 产品需要容错界面，而生成式 AI 让真正的独特性更难实现。

views.en: AI is a macro shift like the smartphone; real gains come from rebuilding infrastructure, and inference costs will force business model changes.
views.zh: 2025 年，他将 AI 视为类似智能手机的宏观变革；真正的收益来自重建基础设施，而推理成本将迫使商业模式改变。

views.en: Generative AI enables conversational, symmetric products; exposing data via APIs and MCP lets non-developers use AI tools.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为生成式 AI 使产品更具对话性和对称性；通过 API 和 MCP 暴露数据，让非开发者也能使用 AI 工具。

views.en: AI should give users control over algorithms, not make them more addictive; being first to adopt change is key.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 应让用户控制算法而非更上瘾；在技术变革期，率先采用变化是关键。

Startup Infrastructure: Lessons from Deep Tech

views.en: Speed and iteration rate, powered by infrastructure, decide startup success; action produces information when stuck.
views.zh: 速度与迭代频率由基础设施决定，是创业成败关键；卡住时用行动创造信息。

views.en: AI is a multiplier for teams, not a replacement, in coding, regulation and data management.
views.zh: AI 是团队的倍增器而非替代品，尤其在编程、监管与数据管理上。

views.en: Deep tech failure is usually organizational, not technical; CEOs cannot delegate judgment.
views.zh: 深科技失败多源于组织而非技术；CEO 不能外包自己的判断。

views.en: The brain is a computer; arranging matter to solve computation drives medical breakthroughs like retinal implants.
views.zh: 大脑就是计算机；通过排列物质解决计算问题，推动视网膜植入等医学突破。

views.en: BCIs and perfusion pursue substrate independence, reducing human fragility and enabling space exploration.
views.zh: 脑机接口与灌注追求基质独立性，降低人类脆弱性并支撑太空探索。

AI Coding Wars and the Future of Agents

views.en: Coding agents will break containment in 2026; first-mover advantage in AI coding is stickier than expected, and the next frontier is zero human review.
views.zh: 2026 年，编程智能体将突破遏制去做其他一切；AI 编程的先发优势比预期更粘，下一个前沿是零人工审查。

views.en: Context length is the slowest scaling factor; memory is the biggest constraint, and scaling beyond 10 trillion parameters is temporary.
views.zh: 上下文窗口是最慢的扩展因素；记忆是最大限制，超过 10 万亿参数的 Scaling 是暂时的。

views.en: Own models are rising for cost and latency; open models gain share and fine-tuning services become viable, but the capability gap may increase.
views.zh: 自有模型因成本和延迟优势崛起；开源模型份额上升，微调服务变得可行，但能力差距可能扩大。

views.en: Mid-tier SaaS is doomed as coding agents let SMBs clone and customize software; custom software for an audience of one is viable.
views.zh: 中型 SaaS 注定消亡，因为编程智能体让中小企业能克隆和定制软件；为一人受众定制软件变得可行。

views.en: AI engineer is a real discipline: building harnesses around models, learning in public, and taste-driven judgment beat credentialism.
views.zh: AI 工程师是一门真实学科：围绕模型构建工具、公开学习、品味驱动的判断胜过资历主义。

views.en: Prototyping is essential because the web is messy; you only know an idea works once it's built and used daily.
views.zh: 原型制作不可或缺：网络世界混乱复杂，只有把想法做出来、每天使用，才知道它是否可行。

views.en: Design teams shouldn't always act as one cohesive unit; individual fingerprints and diverse voices produce better work.
views.zh: 设计团队不必始终步调一致；保留个人印记和多元声音，反而能做出更好的作品。

views.en: Inject feeling and personality even into utilitarian products like browsers; balance intuition with data, letting vision guide final design.
views.zh: 即便是浏览器这类工具型产品也要注入情感与个性；在直觉与数据间平衡，让愿景引导最终设计。

views.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; designers should use Claude Code to ship and Claude Design for ideation.
views.zh: 随着工程实现变容易，设计与想法成为差异化关键；设计师应用 Claude Code 交付、用 Claude Design 做构思。

views.en: Models lack taste, so ask for volume of options; being uncomfortably early beats polishing, and humans still monopolize good design ideas.
views.zh: 模型尚缺品味，应要求大量选项；宁可不舒服地超前也不要过度打磨，好的设计想法仍由人类垄断。

views.en: Communication is the job; impact comes only through clear communication. Trust your vision despite doubt; bottom-up culture is a myth.
views.zh: 沟通就是工作本身；影响力只能通过清晰的沟通产生。即使他人怀疑也要相信自己的愿景；自下而上的文化是个神话。

views.en: AI is a word calculator, not human-like intelligence. Scaling laws alone are insufficient; world models with common sense and causality are needed.
views.zh: AI 是词语计算器，不是类人智能。仅靠缩放定律不够，还需要具备常识和因果关系的世界模型。

views.en: Open-sourcing models like Llama accelerates progress and commoditizes complements. AI will invert the app model: users express intent, AI orchestrates services.
views.zh: 开源 Llama 等模型加速进步并使互补品商品化。AI 将颠覆应用模式：用户表达意图，AI 编排服务。

views.en: Data is the font of all value; unique long-tail datasets will be increasingly demanded as scaling laws hold. Most jobs don't require frontier intelligence.
views.zh: 数据是一切价值的源泉；随着缩放定律持续，独特的长尾数据集将越来越被需要。大多数工作不需要前沿智能。

views.en: The era of the monolithic model ended around Llama 3. Consumers don't care which model they use; they want functionality. Agentic AI is powerful but not user-friendly.
views.zh: 单体模型时代在 Llama 3 发布前后结束。消费者不在乎用哪个模型，他们要的是功能。智能体式 AI 强大但不友好。

views.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, is the long-term framework; industrial AI automates whole sectors one at a time.
views.zh: 把物理世界数字化、把原子当比特，是长期框架；工业 AI 逐个行业实现自动化。

views.en: Specialized robotics beat humanoids for industrial scale; real estate and sensors belong in the physical AI stack.
views.zh: 在工业规模上，专用机器人胜过人形机器人；房地产与传感器都属于物理 AI 技术栈。

views.en: The final boss is resistance to change from society and media, not competitors; entrepreneurs must absorb pain.
views.zh: 终局对手不是竞争者，而是社会与媒体对变革的抵制；创业者必须承受痛苦。

views.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner and more effective than anger.
views.zh: 以复仇为燃料是脏的；爱上新使命比愤怒更干净、更有效。

views.en: Founders can now speak directly past media gatekeepers; stealth mode trades external validation for internal correctness.
views.zh: 创始人如今可绕过媒体守门人直接发声；隐身模式以外部认可换取内部正确性。

views.en: Design is the key differentiator in software; AI will merge roles so everyone becomes a product builder with design skills.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，人人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

views.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain human; AI outputs are starting points, and direct manipulation beats prompting for design.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化为品味、手艺和观点仍属于人类；AI 输出只是起点，设计调整中直接操作优于提示词。

views.en: Design is not dead; AI without human steering yields average results, and interaction will evolve beyond prompting.
views.zh: 2026 年中，他强调设计未死；缺乏人类引导的 AI 只能产出平庸结果，交互将超越提示词。

views.en: Design is the new code; AI lowers the floor but humans raise the ceiling through bold creativity and point of view.
views.zh: 2026 年末，他提出设计即新代码；AI 降低下限，但人类通过大胆创意和观点提升上限。

views.en: Human judgment and taste are essential; AI should expand human potential, not replace thinking.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：人类判断与品味至关重要；AI 应扩展人类潜能，而非替代思考。

views.en: Designers should build their own AI tools and encode their style in a design.md, iterating from references rather than starting from scratch.
views.zh: 设计师应自建 AI 工具，把个人风格写进 design.md，从参考出发迭代而非从零开始。

views.en: AI is not getting smarter on its own; you must feed frontier models giant prompts with context and a design system to unlock them.
views.zh: AI 本身并不会变聪明；必须给前沿模型喂入带上下文与设计系统的巨型提示词才能释放其能力。

views.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, letting one person do what once required a team.
views.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机会，让一个人完成过去需要团队才能做的事。

views.en: Start before you feel ready and ship at 80% complete, since perfectionism is fear in disguise.
views.zh: 没准备好就开始，做到 80% 就发布，因为完美主义是伪装的恐惧。

views.en: Focus on one painful, expensive problem for a few high-paying clients instead of diversifying or raising venture capital.
views.zh: 聚焦少数高付费客户的单一痛点问题，而非分散或融资。

views.en: AI tools let designers prototype independently; curiosity and hands-on experimentation keep them relevant.
views.zh: AI 工具让设计师能独立做原型；好奇心和亲手实验让设计师保持相关性。

views.en: AI amplifies rather than replaces creativity; it accelerates iteration while human judgment sets the bar.
views.zh: AI 放大而非取代创造力；它加速迭代，而人类判断决定标准。

views.en: Designers become editors: AI handles execution, humans curate, and prototypes persuade faster than PRDs.
views.zh: 设计师变成编辑：AI 负责执行，人类负责策展，原型比 PRD 更有说服力。

views.en: Break tasks into subtasks for AI agents iteratively; expose parameters to fine-tune AI-generated designs.
views.zh: 把任务拆成子任务迭代交给 AI 智能体；暴露参数以微调 AI 生成的设计。

views.en: Designers should build and test in code, not just Figma; less is more with clear hierarchy.
views.zh: 设计师应写代码构建和测试，而不只是在 Figma 里设计；少即是多，层级要清晰。

Owning Intelligence: Post-Training for Durable AI Businesses
The Case for Specialized Intelligence

views.en: Specialized intelligence, not one AGI, will dominate; every company must own its model as open models handle most enterprise workflows.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张专用智能而非单一 AGI 将主导：每家公司都必须拥有自己的模型，开源模型能覆盖大多数企业工作流。

views.en: Post-training bakes unique judgment and data into models, creating a durable moat beyond product-market fit and cutting costs 5-10x.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调后训练把独特判断与数据固化进模型，在产品-市场契合之外筑起护城河，并把成本降低 5-10 倍。

views.en: Inference quality is the bar; private data unlocks the next frontier, so owning your model beats building on a black-box API.
views.zh: 2026 年他认定推理质量是门槛，私有数据才能开启下一前沿，因此拥有自己的模型胜过搭建在黑盒 API 之上。

views.en: Millions of customized models, one per application, will replace a few foundation models; data, not the app layer, is the moat.
views.zh: 2026 年他预测数百万个按应用定制的模型将取代少数基础模型，护城河在数据而非应用层。

views.en: Velocity trumps everything as model and hardware cycles accelerate; optimize growth first, then margins, to avoid scaling into bankruptcy.
views.zh: 2026 年他认为在模型与硬件周期加速下速度至上，应先优化增长再谈利润，避免 Scaling（规模扩张）到破产。

views.en: Models advance faster than expected; build at the edge of capabilities, embrace breakage, and focus on strategy over UX polish.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调模型进步快于预期，创业者应在能力边缘构建、拥抱破碎，产品重心从 UX 打磨转向战略与让用户看见 AI 潜力。

views.en: Small teams gain leverage from AI; build for future model capabilities, not today's limits, with domain expertise as the differentiator.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他深化小团队论：AI 让单人/小团队可扩展，应为未来模型能力而非当下局限构建，领域专长与客户理解成为关键差异。

views.en: Agent-native design: agents can do everything users can; cut features ruthlessly, rewrite freely, and keep architectural soundness.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出智能体原生设计——智能体应能做用户能做的一切；果断砍功能、大胆重写，同时守住架构稳健性。

views.en: Long-horizon delegation with verification loops redefines productivity; chat is insufficient, and models should push back with real judgment.
views.zh: 2026 年中，他转向长周期委托与验证闭环：Fable 让复杂任务可隔夜交付，聊天界面不够用，模型应带着判断力反驳而非一味附和。

views.en: Close the gap between model capability and real usage; give models agency and self-knowledge, while PM's core of bridging problems and tech endures.
views.zh: 2026 年后期，他聚焦缩小模型能力与实际使用之间的差距，赋予模型更多自主性与自我认知；同时坚持产品管理的核心——连接人类问题与技术——始终不变。

people.tiEn: Head of Product, Claude Platform, Anthropic
people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude 平台产品负责人
people.bioEn: Leads product for Anthropic developer platform, where harness and model are converging into one unit and multi-agent orchestration is moving into production.
people.bioZh: 负责 Anthropic 开发者平台产品，正见证 harness 与模型合为一体、多智能体编排走向生产环境。

episodes.tEn: The Future of AI Platforms: Claude's Evolution and Scaling

people.tiZh: Anthropic 技术团队成员
people.bioEn: Anthropic engineer working on Claude Tag and multiplayer agent experiences, with a front-row view of how internal dogfooding turned side projects into company-wide habits.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 工程师，参与 Claude Tag 与多人协作智能体，亲历内部 dogfooding 如何把边缘项目变成全公司习惯。

episodes.tEn: Claude Tag: Your Proactive Teammate in Slack

people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude Cowork 负责人 · 前 Slack
people.bioEn: Leads Claude Cowork at Anthropic after years on Slack desktop and Electron. Advocate of prototype-first culture: when execution gets cheap, build every candidate.
people.bioZh: 现负责 Anthropic 的 Claude Cowork，此前长期做 Slack 桌面端与 Electron。信奉原型优先文化：当执行成本变低，就把所有候选方案都做出来。

episodes.tEn: Building a Language Model from Scratch with Felix Rieseberg
Building Better with Claude: From Hardware Buddies to AI-Native Kids
The Future of AI: Local Computers and Claude

views.en: Claude works best with the user's own tools on the local computer; skills as markdown files enable hyper-personalized automation, while scaffolding matters less as models improve.
views.zh: Claude 的效果取决于能否使用与用户相同的工具，最好就在本地电脑上；技能以 markdown 文件形式易于创建，可实现超个性化自动化，而随着模型变强，脚手架的重要性会下降。

views.en: The real gap is not AI capability but people not realizing almost any problem can be handed to AI; use AI for tedious background tasks and judge only by final impact.
views.zh: 真正的差距不在 AI 能力，而在人们没意识到几乎任何问题都能交给 AI；用 AI 处理枯燥的后台任务，只看最终影响、不必紧盯着监督。

views.en: Language models' core ideas are simple enough to learn by building one; fine-tuning quickly steers behavior, and models are stateless with context windows creating conversational illusion.
views.zh: 语言模型的核心思想简单到可以亲手搭建来理解；微调能快速引导行为，而模型本身是无状态的，上下文窗口只是制造了对话的错觉。

views.en: Models are grown like orchids rather than built like tools, with emergent internal organization; post-training tasks like tool calling increasingly blur into pre-training.
views.zh: 模型更像兰花一样被培育而非像工具一样被建造，内部会涌现出组织；工具调用等后训练任务正日益模糊地并入预训练。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 技术团队成员
people.bioEn: Early Claude Code engineer at Anthropic, working on how agent-written code actually ships to production.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 早期 Claude Code 工程师，研究智能体写的代码如何真正推上生产环境。

episodes.tEn: Vibe Coding in Production: Responsible AI Code Generation

people.tiZh: Snap 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Snapchat at 21 and turned down Zuckerberg. Has spent a decade betting Snap on camera, AR glasses and now AI as the platform after the smartphone.
people.bioZh: 21 岁创立 Snapchat 并拒绝了扎克伯格的收购。十年押注相机、AR 眼镜与 AI，赌智能手机之后的下一代计算平台。

episodes.tEn: Snap CEO Evan Spiegel: Why AR Glasses Are the Future
Evan Spiegel on Building Snapchat and Battling Meta
Evan Spiegel on Gen Z, Snapchat's Vision, and the Future of Tech
Snap CEO on Spectacles, AI, and the Future of Computing
Why Building a Durable Social Consumer Product Is So Hard
Evan Spiegel on Snapchat's Origin and AR Future
Evan Spiegel: From Introvert to Snapchat Billionaire
Snapchat Founder Evan Spiegel on TikTok, Wearables, and Being Copied

views.en: Rejects Facebook's $3B offer; believes in product and long-term vision over short-term validation.
views.zh: 2025 年，他回顾拒绝 Facebook 30 亿美元收购，强调对产品和长期愿景的信念胜过短期验证。

views.en: Ephemerality and privacy as core design principles, now more crucial in the AI age.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，短暂性和隐私始终是核心设计原则，在 AI 时代愈发关键。

views.en: Distribution and ecosystems, not software features, are the hardest to copy and most valuable.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：分发和生态系统而非软件功能最难复制、最具价值。

views.en: AR glasses as the future of computing, making technology more human and grounded in the real world.
views.zh: 2026 年，他明确 AR 眼镜是计算未来，让技术更人性化、扎根现实世界。

views.en: AI optimism amid doomerism; AI accelerates prototyping and shifts value to creativity, but authentic content remains valued.
views.zh: 2026 年，在末日论中坚持 AI 乐观主义；AI 加速原型设计并将价值转向创造力，但真实内容仍受重视。

people.tiZh: Figma 首席设计官
people.bioEn: Loredana Crisan is Chief Design Officer at Figma, where she leads design across the company's products and its push into AI-assisted design. She previously spent nearly a decade at Meta, where she was VP of Design and led design for Messenger.
people.bioZh: Loredana Crisan 是 Figma 首席设计官,负责公司全线产品设计并主导其向 AI 辅助设计的演进。她此前在 Meta 工作近十年,曾任设计副总裁并负责 Messenger 的设计。

episodes.tEn: Putting Soul into AI Design: Figma's CDO on Music, Intuition, and the Future

people.tiZh: 《AI 2027》作者 · 前 OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Former OpenAI governance researcher who gave up millions in equity to keep his freedom to speak, then co-authored the AI 2027 scenario forecasting superintelligence timelines.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 治理研究员，为保留发声自由放弃数百万美元股权，后合著《AI 2027》，对超级智能时间表做情景推演。

episodes.tEn: How AI Swarms Are Already Going Rogue | Daniel Kokotajlo
episodes.podEn: American Thought Leaders - The Epoch Times
