views.en: Distributing AI widely, not restricting it, is the safe path; alignment becomes the next most important capability; personal agents like Muse need privacy architecture and discretion.
views.zh: 2026 年明确：广泛分发而非限制 AI 才是安全路径；对齐成为下一项最重要的能力；Muse 等个人智能体需要隐私架构与分寸感。

views.en: Open source as checks and balances against concentrated power, and AI as a tool to empower individuals, remain constant threads from 2023 through 2026.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 一以贯之的主线：开源作为对权力集中的制衡，以及 AI 作为赋能个体的工具。

people.tiZh: 微软董事长兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Satya Nadella is the Chairman and CEO of Microsoft, having been CEO since 2014 and adding the chairman role in 2021. Under his leadership Microsoft pivoted to cloud computing and became a leading force in AI, notably through its partnership with OpenAI.
people.bioZh: 萨提亚·纳德拉是微软的董事长兼 CEO,自 2014 年出任 CEO,并于 2021 年兼任董事长。在他的带领下,微软转向云计算,并通过与 OpenAI 的合作成为 AI 领域的领军力量。

episodes.tEn: Satya Nadella on AI Security, Alignment Limits, and Microsoft's Succession
Satya Nadella on Copilot, the AI Backlash, and Microsoft's Future
Satya Nadella: AI as the Hill-Climbing Machine
Satya Nadella on AI Ecosystem Strategy and Frontier Models

views.en: AI is not a technology but the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine and compound token capital.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把 AI 从技术重新定义为“企业的未来”：每家企业都要自建爬坡机器、积累 token 资本，而不是把 AI 外包给 IT。

views.en: Scaling laws work, but alignment and interpretability do not arrive naturally; treat frontier models as insider threats and lock them down.
views.zh: 2026 年，他承认缩放定律有效，但对齐与可解释性不会自然到来；应把前沿模型当作内部威胁，从外部构建遏制与保障层。

views.en: Models are commodities; form factor, distribution, pricing and brand matter more, and being six months behind the frontier is a smart strategy.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断模型正在商品化，产品形态、分发、定价与品牌更关键；落后前沿六个月是明智策略，而非弱点。

views.en: The agent era expands TAM far beyond cloud; long-running agents need auditability, observability and security governance, with hybrid seat-plus-usage pricing.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能体时代把 TAM 扩大到云之外；长时运行的智能体需要可审计、可观测与安全治理，定价走向席位加用量的混合模式。

views.en: AGI should be judged by GDP lift, not benchmarks; superintelligence is the better term, and alignment may never be solved.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他主张用 GDP 提升而非基准分数衡量 AGI（通用人工智能），更愿用“超级智能”一词，并警告对齐可能永远无解——这是对早期乐观立场的明显深化与转向。

people.tiZh: Cerebras Systems 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Andrew Feldman is the co-founder and CEO of Cerebras Systems, which builds wafer-scale processors for AI and went public on Nasdaq (CBRS) in May 2026 in the year's largest US tech IPO, valuing the company at roughly $63 billion. He previously co-founded SeaMicro, which was acquired by AMD in 2012.
people.bioZh: Andrew Feldman 是 Cerebras Systems 的联合创始人兼 CEO,该公司打造用于 AI 的晶圆级处理器,并于 2026 年 5 月在纳斯达克(CBRS)上市,成为当年美国最大的科技 IPO,公司估值约 630 亿美元。此前他曾联合创办 SeaMicro,该公司于 2012 年被 AMD 收购。

episodes.tEn: Andrew Feldman on Building Cerebras and the Future of Chips
The Largest Chip Ever and the Speed of AI
AI Demand Outpaces Expectations: Andrew Feldman on Chips, Deals, and Post-IPO Life
Cerebras CEO on Giant Wafers and AI Chips
Cerebras CEO on $95B IPO, Wafer-Scale Chips, and AI Hardware
Cerebras CEO on Fast AI Inference and the Future of Computing

views.en: Speed of inference, not raw compute, is the dominant metric; slow AI has zero market and fast tokens can be cheaper.
views.zh: 推理速度而非单纯算力才是核心指标；慢的 AI 没有市场，快的 token 反而可能更便宜。

views.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, delivering radically faster inference than GPUs.
views.zh: 晶圆级芯片绕开 HBM 与 CoWoS 瓶颈，推理速度远超 GPU。

views.en: CUDA's moat is eroding; leading frontier models now train on TPUs and Trainium without it.
views.zh: CUDA 的护城河正在瓦解；领先的前沿模型已在 TPU 和 Trainium 上训练而不再依赖它。

views.en: Demand outpaces supply; data center capacity, power and packaging—not chip logic—are the real constraints.
views.zh: 需求超过供给；真正的瓶颈是数据中心容量、电力与封装，而非芯片逻辑本身。

views.en: Against incumbents only 100x better works, not 10% cheaper; radical innovation beats incrementalism.
views.zh: 对抗巨头只有做到 100 倍更好才可行，便宜 10% 没用；激进创新胜过渐进改良。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, Databricks; Associate Professor, UC Berkeley
people.tiZh: Databricks 联合创始人兼 CTO,加州大学伯克利分校副教授
people.bioEn: Romanian-Canadian computer scientist who started the Apache Spark project during his PhD at UC Berkeley and created MLflow; he is co-founder and CTO of Databricks and an associate professor of EECS at UC Berkeley. He received the 2026 ACM Prize in Computing for his foundational contributions to data and machine learning systems.
people.bioZh: 罗马尼亚裔加拿大计算机科学家,在加州大学伯克利分校读博期间发起了 Apache Spark 项目,并创造了 MLflow;他是 Databricks 的联合创始人兼 CTO,同时担任加州大学伯克利分校 EECS 副教授。因在数据与机器学习系统方面的奠基性贡献,他获得了 2026 年 ACM 计算奖。

episodes.tEn: Omnigents: The Meta Harness for AI Agents

people.tiZh: Glean 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Arvind Jain is the founder and CEO of Glean, an enterprise AI search and work-assistant company valued at around $7B. He previously co-founded data-security company Rubrik and spent over a decade at Google as a Distinguished Engineer working on Search, Maps, and YouTube.
people.bioZh: Arvind Jain 是企业 AI 搜索与工作助手公司 Glean 的创始人兼 CEO,该公司估值约 70 亿美元。他此前联合创立了数据安全公司 Rubrik,并曾在 Google 担任杰出工程师十余年,参与搜索、地图和 YouTube 等产品。

episodes.tEn: Why AI Needs Your Company's Context
Glean: The World's First Enterprise Generative AI Company
Glean CEO: Enterprises Fear Frontier AI Models Eating Their Lunch

views.en: Enterprises fear dependence on frontier model providers; Glean absorbs that risk by routing across many models, including open source.
views.zh: 2026 年他指出，企业害怕对前沿模型供应商形成依赖；Glean 通过在多模型（含开源）之间路由来吸收这一风险。

views.en: Open-source models now handle over 90% of enterprise tasks; cost, not privacy, drives adoption, with most inference shifting to open source.
views.zh: 2026 年他判断开源模型已能处理超 90%的企业任务；驱动采用的是成本而非隐私，多数推理将在 12-18 个月内转向开源。

views.en: Context, not models, is the key: 80-90% of enterprise knowledge is tacit, so a context engine beats agent hype built on MCP.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调关键在上下文而非模型：80-90%的企业知识是隐性的，上下文引擎胜过基于 MCP 的智能体炒作。

views.en: AI ROI is a throughput and departmental-metrics problem; token spend should not be framed as a trade-off with headcount.
views.zh: 2026 年他把 AI 的投资回报视为吞吐与部门指标问题；反对把 token 支出与人力成本对立起来。

views.en: AI should become like software with negligible marginal cost; enterprises must own their memory and avoid lock-in.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张 AI 应像软件一样边际成本趋近于零；企业应拥有自己的记忆并避免被锁定。

people.tiZh: Goodfire 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Goodfire, the interpretability company. Works on concept manifolds and turning interpretability research into products, including Silico, a research platform for probing what models actually represent.
people.bioZh: 可解释性公司 Goodfire 的联合创始人兼 CTO。研究概念流形，并把可解释性研究做成产品——包括用于探查模型内部表征的研究平台 Silico。

episodes.tEn: Goodfire CTO on Silico Platform and AI Safety

people.tiZh: 英国 ARIA「Safeguarded AI」项目技术顾问
people.bioEn: David "davidad" Dalrymple is an AI safety researcher who launched and led ARIA's £59M Safeguarded AI programme, which pairs formal mathematical proofs with AI world-models to give quantitative safety guarantees; in 2026 he moved from Programme Director to Technical Advisor. Known for his "Open Agency Architecture" and provably-safe-AI agenda, he previously co-invented the cryptocurrency Filecoin and was a research fellow in technical AI safety at Oxford.
people.bioZh: David "davidad" Dalrymple 是一位 AI 安全研究者,创立并领导了英国 ARIA 耗资 5900 万英镑的「Safeguarded AI」项目,该项目试图将形式化数学证明与 AI 世界模型结合,为系统输出提供可量化的安全保证;2026 年他由项目主管转任技术顾问。他以「开放机构架构」(Open Agency Architecture)和可证明安全 AI 的研究路线著称,此前曾联合发明加密货币 Filecoin,并在牛津大学担任技术性 AI 安全研究员。

episodes.tEn: The Cognitive Revolution: Davidad on Provably Safe AI and the Future of Alignment

people.tiEn: Professor, The Jackson Laboratory; AI × immunology
people.tiZh: 杰克逊实验室教授;AI × 免疫学
people.bioEn: Immunologist and professor at The Jackson Laboratory, an early and vocal power user of AI for biomedical research — from Codex-built lab tools to AI-designed experiments.
people.bioZh: 杰克逊实验室免疫学教授,生物医学 AI 的早期重度用户——从用 Codex 搭实验室工具到 AI 设计实验。

episodes.tEn: AI's Exponential Leap: Why the Next Decade Could Redefine Human Lifespan
From Medical School to AI: A Biologist's Journey

views.en: AI agents will automate hypothesis generation and experiments, shifting science from hypothesis-driven to AI-agent-driven discovery.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，AI 智能体将自动化假设生成与实验，推动科学从假设驱动转向 AI 智能体驱动的发现。

views.en: Digital twins will cut clinical trials from years to days, enabling personalized medicine with near 100% efficacy.
views.zh: 2026 年，数字孪生将把临床试验从数年缩短到数天，实现接近 100%疗效的个性化医疗。

views.en: Current compute is insufficient to simulate biological systems; massive Scaling is needed to reach biological intuition.
views.zh: 2026 年，当前算力不足以模拟生物系统；需要大规模 Scaling（规模扩张）才能达到生物学直觉。

views.en: Aging reversal is possible within 15 years via partial reprogramming, requiring engineering and AI to solve complexity.
views.zh: 2026 年，通过部分重编程，衰老逆转在 15 年内可能实现，需要工程方法和 AI 来解决复杂性。

views.en: We should trust superintelligence for medical decisions; AI will make healthcare affordable and merge with humans via brain interfaces.
views.zh: 2026 年，我们应信任超级智能做医疗决策；AI 将使医疗负担得起，并通过脑机接口与人类融合。

people.tiEn: Founder & CEO, Osmo; ex-Google Brain (digital olfaction)
people.tiZh: Osmo 创始人兼 CEO；前 Google Brain（数字嗅觉）
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Osmo, teaching computers to smell — digitizing scent with machine learning. Previously led olfactory AI research at Google Brain.
people.bioZh: Osmo 创始人兼 CEO，教计算机「闻」气味——用机器学习数字化嗅觉。此前在 Google Brain 领导嗅觉 AI 研究。

episodes.tEn: Giving Computers a Sense of Smell

people.tiEn: CTO, Genesis Molecular AI; led Llama 2/3 pretraining at Meta
people.tiZh: Genesis Molecular AI CTO；曾负责 Meta Llama 2/3 预训练
people.bioEn: CTO of Genesis Molecular AI, applying frontier-scale ML to drug discovery. Previously at Meta, where he led pretraining for Llama 2 and Llama 3.
people.bioZh: Genesis Molecular AI CTO，把前沿规模的机器学习用于药物发现。此前在 Meta 负责 Llama 2 与 Llama 3 的预训练。

episodes.tEn: From GANs to Diffusion: AI's Evolution in Protein Modeling

people.tiZh: Surge AI 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Surge AI, the data and RLHF vendor behind many frontier-lab training runs. Previously at Google, Facebook and Twitter working on ML and data quality.
people.bioZh: Surge AI 创始人兼 CEO——众多前沿实验室训练背后的数据与 RLHF 供应商。此前在 Google、Facebook、Twitter 从事机器学习与数据质量工作。

episodes.tEn: AI in Medicine: Magic, Judgment, and the Future
The Pitfalls of Bad Benchmarks in AI Models
From Zero to a Billion: The Surge AI Story

views.en: High-quality data and deep human evaluation, not benchmarks or leaderboards, are the real bottleneck for AI progress.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调：高质量数据与深度人工评估才是 AI 进步的真瓶颈，基准与排行榜并非关键。

views.en: RL environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks; LLMs alone may not reach AGI.
views.zh: 2025 年他提出：强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，用于模拟真实任务；仅靠 LLM 或许无法抵达 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: AGI is a decade or more away; moving from 80% to 99.9% performance is the hard part.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他始终判断 AGI（通用人工智能）还需十年以上，难点在于从 80% 提升到 99.9%。

views.en: Frontier labs will diverge by objective function; there will be no one model to rule them all.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化判断：前沿模型会因目标函数不同而分化，不会有一个模型通吃一切。

views.en: In medicine, safety and human judgment outweigh raw accuracy; the biggest risk may be omission.
views.zh: 2026 年他转向医疗场景：安全与人类判断重于单纯准确率，最大风险可能是该做而未做的遗漏。

people.tiZh: Cognition(Devin)联合创始人兼 CPO；「context engineering」提出者
people.bioEn: Co-founder and chief product officer of Cognition, the company behind the AI software engineer Devin. Credited with coining the term 'context engineering'.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼首席产品官——AI 软件工程师 Devin 背后的公司。「context engineering」一词的提出者。

episodes.tEn: AI Testing: Beyond Computer Use to Autonomous Agents

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机制可解释性负责人
people.bioEn: Leads mechanistic interpretability research at Google DeepMind — reverse-engineering what actually happens inside large models. Known for open-source interpretability tooling and prolific mentoring.
people.bioZh: 领导 Google DeepMind 的机制可解释性研究——逆向工程大模型内部到底发生了什么。以开源可解释性工具与大量培养新人著称。

episodes.tEn: Peering Inside the Black Box of AI

people.tiEn: Co-founder, Simile; creator of Generative Agents (Stanford)
people.tiZh: Simile 联合创始人；生成式智能体作者（斯坦福）
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Simile, building large-scale simulations of human behavior. As a Stanford PhD he created 'Generative Agents' — the influential Smallville simulation of AI agents that plan, remember, and socialize.
people.bioZh: Simile 联合创始人，构建大规模人类行为模拟。斯坦福博士期间创造了「生成式智能体」——那个会规划、记忆、社交的 Smallville AI 智能体模拟，影响深远。

episodes.tEn: Simile CEO Joon Sung Park on Predicting Human Behavior with 85%+ Accuracy
Simulating 8 Billion Lives: AI for Wicked Problems
Simulating Human Behavior: The Future of AI Prediction
AI Agents: The Next Frontier Beyond LLMs
Simulating Human Societies with AI: From Smallville to Real-World Applications

views.en: Early 2026: LLM agents can simulate human societies from training data, but models plateau on diversity; next frontier is modeling subjective values and collecting real-world behavioral data.
views.zh: 2026 年初：LLM 智能体可从训练数据模拟人类社会，但模型在多样性上趋于平台；下一个前沿是建模主观价值并收集真实行为数据。

views.en: Mid-2026: AGI may be a distributed society of specialized agents, not a single entity; safety needs defense in depth and economic incentives against collusion.
views.zh: 2026 年中：AGI（通用人工智能）可能是一个由专业化智能体组成的分布式社会，而非单一实体；安全需要纵深防御和防止合谋的经济激励。

views.en: By August 2026: Simulation should model biased, irrational humans—not super-rational frontier models—using RCT behavioral data and post-training to reach 85% accuracy.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月：模拟应建模有偏见、非理性的人类——而非超级理性的前沿模型——利用随机对照试验的行为数据与后训练达到 85%准确率。

views.en: Late 2026: The vision scales to simulating 8 billion lives for wicked problems; simulation shapes the future via counterfactual reasoning, with synthetic panels surpassing human panels.
views.zh: 2026 年末：愿景扩展至模拟 80 亿人应对棘手问题；模拟通过反事实推理塑造未来，合成面板将超越人类面板。

views.en: Consistent thread: build AI that represents human behavior and values, not superhuman rationality; simulation is a decision tool for shaping society, requiring behavioral data and new validity standards.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：构建表征人类行为与价值的 AI，而非超人类理性；模拟是塑造社会的决策工具，需要行为数据与新的效度标准。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CEO, Liquid AI; liquid neural networks (ex-MIT)
people.tiZh: Liquid AI 联合创始人兼 CEO；液态神经网络（前 MIT）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Liquid AI, commercializing liquid neural networks — compact, continuous-time models he pioneered at MIT. Argues efficient architectures, not scale alone, define frontier capability.
people.bioZh: Liquid AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，将他在 MIT 首创的「液态神经网络」——紧凑的连续时间模型——商业化。主张高效架构而非单纯规模，才定义前沿能力。

episodes.tEn: A Worm With 302 Neurons Inspired Their Architecture — Ramin Hasani, Liquid AI
Inkling, Liquid AI, and the Push for AI Regulation
Liquid AI: Squeezing Maximum Intelligence from Limited Compute

views.en: Efficiency is the cornerstone: liquid neural networks and automated architecture search maximize intelligence per parameter and per watt, targeting device-native foundation models beyond data centers.
views.zh: 效率是核心：液态神经网络与自动化架构搜索最大化每参数、每瓦特的智能，瞄准数据中心之外的设备原生基础模型。

views.en: Attention stays crucial at large scale, but simpler gated convolutions suffice for smaller specialized models; architecture should be unbiased at scale, biased only when small.
views.zh: 注意力机制在大规模下仍关键，但更简单的门控卷积足以支撑小型专用模型；架构在规模上应无偏，仅在小规模时带偏。

views.en: Proxy metrics like perplexity mislead; evaluate on real downstream tasks and hardware, and replace human bias in architecture design with systematic search.
views.zh: 困惑度等代理指标会误导；应在真实下游任务与硬件上评估，并用系统化搜索取代架构设计中的人类偏见。

views.en: Regulation must be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; FINRA-like calls are regulatory capture, and tying open-model release to China's pace creates perverse incentives.
views.zh: 监管必须自适应并针对行为而非能力；类 FINRA 的呼吁是监管俘获，把开放模型发布与中国节奏挂钩会制造逆向激励。

views.en: Current AI lacks the brain's diverse learning algorithms and intelligence per watt; new learning paradigms, embodiment and adaptivity—not just architectures—are needed.
views.zh: 当前 AI 缺乏大脑多样的学习算法与每瓦特智能；需要新的学习范式、具身与自适应性，而不只是架构。

people.tiZh: 3Blue1Brown 创作者；数学教育者
people.bioEn: Creator of 3Blue1Brown, the beloved YouTube channel that visualizes mathematics — from linear algebra to neural networks. A leading voice on how AI is accelerating mathematical discovery.
people.bioZh: 3Blue1Brown 创作者——那个用可视化讲数学（从线性代数到神经网络）的知名 YouTube 频道。关于 AI 如何加速数学发现的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: AI and the Future of Mathematics: A Conversation with Grant Sanderson
AI in Math: From IMO to Millennium Problems

views.en: Math AI progress comes from verifiability and grindability, with parallel agent rollouts mattering more than formalization.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为数学 AI 的进步源于可验证性与可“磨”性，可并行展开的智能体 rollout 比形式化更关键。

views.en: AI's math role shifts from theorem proving toward curation and explanation, while teaching and human understanding stay valuable.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 在数学中的角色会从定理证明转向策展与解释，而教学与人的理解仍然有价值。

views.en: AI math results often lack attribution to prior human work; credit should go to motivated explanations, not just proofs.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 的数学成果常缺失对前人工作的归属，学术认可应给有动机的解释而非仅证明。

views.en: The math frontier may become incomprehensible to humans, yet individual understanding and human framing still matter.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出数学前沿可能变得人类难以理解，但个体理解与人的框架仍然重要。

views.en: Next benchmark is AI generating interesting conjectures and definitions; solving Millennium Problems may not yield economic value.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为下一个基准是 AI 提出有趣猜想与定义，而解决千禧年难题未必直接带来经济价值。

people.tiEn: Lead, Google AI Studio & Gemini API; ex-OpenAI
people.tiZh: Google AI Studio 与 Gemini API 负责人；前 OpenAI
people.bioEn: Leads Google AI Studio and the Gemini API, shaping how developers build on frontier models. Previously led developer relations at OpenAI.
people.bioZh: 负责 Google AI Studio 与 Gemini API，塑造开发者在前沿模型上的构建方式。此前在 OpenAI 领导开发者关系。

episodes.tEn: Outsource Intelligence but Not Understanding: Logan Kilpatrick on AI Pace and Sanity
Agentic AI Era: Google's Anti-Gravity Harness Powers Next-Gen Products

views.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are the most mature, with science and finance to follow.
views.zh: 智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段；编程智能体是最成熟的用例，科学与金融将随后跟进。

views.en: The model is eating the scaffolding: a model now includes agent harness and tooling, not just weights.
views.zh: 模型正在吞掉脚手架：如今的模型包含智能体框架与工具链，而不只是权重。

views.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is already here and more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
views.zh: 编程领域的窄超级智能已经到来，其影响比等待 AGI（通用人工智能）更大。

views.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search and engagement, not cannibalistic as initially feared.
views.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索与用户参与是正和的，并非最初担心的自我蚕食。

views.en: Software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
views.zh: 软件创造将基本被解决，这会带来千倍机会，而非更少。

people.tiZh: Engram 联合创始人；记忆与持续学习
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Engram, a lab building around memory and continual learning for AI. Researcher focused on how models retain and update knowledge over time.
people.bioZh: Engram 联合创始人，该实验室专注 AI 的记忆与持续学习。研究模型如何随时间保留并更新知识。

episodes.tEn: From Special Forces to AI: Dan Biderman's Journey
Memory and Continual Learning: The Next Frontier in AI

views.en: The bottleneck is not raw intelligence but learning evolving context; memory must be internalized into weights, not just retrieval.
views.zh: 2026 年他指出，模型有用性的瓶颈不是原始智能，而是学习不断演化的上下文；记忆应内化进权重，而非仅靠检索。

views.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable: doing more with less is the path to harder long-horizon tasks.
views.zh: 2026 年他强调效率与智能不可分割：以更少资源做更多事，才能解决更难的长程任务。

views.en: Context windows suffer 'context rot'; more tokens reduce accuracy even at 10M scale, so weights must complement text.
views.zh: 2026 年他提出上下文窗口存在“上下文腐化”：即便到 1000 万规模，更多 token 反而降低准确率，因此权重必须补充文本。

views.en: The future is not one giant frontier model but many personalized models; continual learning runs on-device with user-owned weights.
views.zh: 2026 年他判断未来不是单一巨型前沿模型，而是众多个性化模型；持续学习在端侧运行，权重归用户所有。

views.en: Scaling with more compute is not the only path; pre-training's compression magic should extend to enterprise knowledge via fine-tuning.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张仅靠更多算力做 Scaling 并非唯一路径；预训练的压缩魔力应通过微调延伸到企业知识。

people.tiZh: MatX 联合创始人兼 CEO；前 Google（大模型推理）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of MatX, building chips designed specifically for large language models. Previously at Google, where he worked on high-performance LLM training and serving.
people.bioZh: MatX 联合创始人兼 CEO，专为大语言模型打造芯片。此前在 Google 从事高性能大模型训练与推理。

episodes.tEn: How AI Chips Work: From Logic Gates to Matrix Multiplication
AI Inference Economics: Batch Size, Latency, and Cost

views.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size and sparsity are key levers.
views.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小和稀疏性是关键杠杆。

views.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal because inference cost matters more than training cost.
views.zh: 模型被过度训练约 100 倍，超过 Chinchilla 最优，因为推理成本比训练成本更重要。

views.en: Data movement costs dominate compute costs even inside a chip, shaping AI chip design.
views.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据移动成本也主导计算成本，这塑造了 AI 芯片设计。

views.en: Context length stagnation is due to the memory wall, not compute limits; sparse attention helps but has quality limits.
views.zh: 上下文窗口停滞是由于内存墙而非算力限制；稀疏注意力有帮助但有质量限制。

views.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together; low precision is far more efficient due to quadratic scaling with bit width.
views.zh: GPU 本质上是许多小型 TPU 的拼接；由于位宽的二次方缩放，低精度效率远高于预期。

people.tiEn: VP of AI, 1X; ex-Google Brain (robotics, RL)
people.tiZh: 1X AI 副总裁；前 Google Brain（机器人、强化学习）
people.bioEn: VP of AI at 1X Technologies (humanoid robots). Previously a research scientist at Google Brain working on robotics, reinforcement learning, and generative models.
people.bioZh: 1X Technologies（人形机器人）AI 副总裁。此前在 Google Brain 任研究科学家，研究机器人、强化学习与生成模型。

episodes.tEn: Building AlphaGo from Scratch: Insights for AI Research

people.bioZh: 在 xAI 负责 Grok Imagine，构建视频生成与世界模型。此前在 NVIDIA 参与打造 Cosmos 世界基础模型。

episodes.tEn: Visual Intelligence Comes from Language Models

episodes.tEn: Nested Learning & AI Sleep: Towards Continual Learning with Ali Behrouz

people.bioZh: Sakana AI 创始研究员，专注大语言模型与进化方法的结合（如 Shinka Evolve）。

episodes.tEn: Evolutionary AI and Scientific Discovery with Robert Lange

people.tiZh: SemiAnalysis 创始人兼首席分析师
people.bioEn: Founder and chief analyst of SemiAnalysis, the closely-followed research firm covering semiconductors, AI compute, and datacenter economics. One of the most-cited independent voices on the hardware bottlenecks to scaling AI.
people.bioZh: SemiAnalysis 创始人兼首席分析师，该机构专注半导体、AI 算力与数据中心经济学。他是关于 AI 扩展硬件瓶颈最常被引用的独立声音之一。

episodes.tEn: Jensen Huang's Exit Could Reshape the AI Industry Forever
Can AI Infrastructure Keep Growing Exponentially?
Which GPU Clouds Are Actually Good? ClusterMAX 3.0
AI Labs' Compute Dominance and Economics
AI Spend Plateaus as Agents Become Coworkers
From Forum Poster to AI Infrastructure Analyst: The Story of Semi Analysis
From Motel to Semi Analysis: Dylan Patel's Journey
Hyperscaler Capex and AI Lab Compute Scaling

views.en: From early 2026, the binding constraint on Scaling is the semiconductor supply chain—EUV tools and memory bandwidth—not demand or capital.
views.zh: 从 2026 年初起，Scaling（规模扩张）的硬约束是半导体供应链——EUV 设备与内存带宽——而非需求或资本。

views.en: By mid-2026 he argues gains come mostly from model-layer progress and hardware-software co-design, not hardware alone; the CUDA moat is eroding.
views.zh: 到 2026 年中，他主张收益主要来自模型层进步与软硬件协同设计，而非单靠硬件；CUDA 的护城河正在被侵蚀。

views.en: Inference emerges as a defining theme: reasoning models and agentic workflows drive memory and CPU demand, and token efficiency makes the smartest model cheapest.
views.zh: 推理成为核心主题：推理模型与智能体式工作流推高内存与 CPU 需求，而词元效率让最强模型反而最便宜。

views.en: By late 2026 he sees compute centralizing at frontier labs, with labs cutting inference share to fund training and R&D toward AGI.
views.zh: 到 2026 年末，他认为算力正向前沿模型实验室集中，实验室压低推理占比，把资源投向训练与研发以推进 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Most recent: AI capex near 5-6% of US GDP must decelerate on capital and organizational limits, while persistent agents become coworkers.
views.zh: 最近的观点：AI 资本开支已近美国 GDP 的 5-6%，受资本与组织约束必然减速，同时持久化智能体开始充当同事。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & Chief Scientist, EvolutionaryScale; creator of ESM

people.bioEn: Co-founder and chief scientist of EvolutionaryScale, building frontier protein language models (ESM/ESMFold). Previously led protein AI research at Meta FAIR.
people.bioZh: EvolutionaryScale 联合创始人兼首席科学家，构建前沿蛋白质语言模型（ESM/ESMFold）。此前在 Meta FAIR 领导蛋白质 AI 研究。

episodes.tEn: ESMC: World Modeling for Protein Design

people.tiZh: Linux 基金会 AI CTO；PyTorch 基金会执行董事
people.bioEn: AI CTO at the Linux Foundation and Executive Director of the PyTorch Foundation. A champion of open-source AI who works across frontier labs — recently touring DeepSeek, Moonshot, Zhipu, Qwen and MiniMax to see China's open-model ecosystem firsthand.
people.bioZh: Linux 基金会 AI CTO、PyTorch 基金会执行董事。开源 AI 的推动者，近期走访 DeepSeek、月之暗面、智谱、Qwen 与 MiniMax，一线观察中国开源模型生态。

episodes.tEn: AI CTO at Linux Foundation on Open Source AI, China's Rise, and Agentic AI

people.tiZh: Zynga 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of Zynga, the company behind FarmVille and Words with Friends. A serial product founder known for the Proven-Better-New framework and sharp instincts about what makes products spread, now writing about play and product craft.
people.bioZh: Zynga 创始人——FarmVille、Words with Friends 背后的公司。连续产品创业者，以 Proven-Better-New 框架与对产品传播的敏锐直觉著称，近来书写游戏心态与产品之道。

episodes.tEn: Proven, Better, New: Mark Pincus on Control and Betting on Yourself
Mark Pincus on AI, Investing, and Life at the Speed of Play
Building Failure Machines: The Zynga Way
Building Products People Love: A Playbook for the AI Era
Mark Pincus on Proven Better New: A Framework for Successful Product Ideas

views.en: Proven, Better, New: copy proven products, add small betterments, then test novel ideas assuming they fail.
views.zh: 先复制已验证的产品，做小幅改良，再在预设会失败的前提下测试新想法——这就是“Proven, Better, New”框架。

views.en: Instincts beat ideas: founders are right 95% of the time but their ideas are wrong 75% of the time.
views.zh: 直觉比点子更可靠：创始人的直觉 95%是对的，但他们的点子 75%是错的。

views.en: Distribution must be baked into product strategy from day one, not treated as an afterthought.
views.zh: 分发必须从第一天就嵌入产品战略，而不是事后才考虑。

views.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable today yet the greatest opportunity; the real revolution likely arrives around 2029.
views.zh: 消费级 AI 当下“不可投资”，却又是最大的机会；真正的革命大约在 2029 年到来。

views.en: AI is transformative but not yet a new platform; free unlimited compute will reshape consumer services.
views.zh: AI 具有变革性，但还不是新平台；免费无限算力将重塑消费级服务。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 前沿评估负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the frontier evaluations team at OpenAI, building new ways to measure and forecast what models can do as they grow more capable. A researcher focused on rigorous evals.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 前沿评估团队负责人，为日益强大的模型设计新的能力测量与预测方法。专注严谨评测的研究者。

episodes.tEn: Building Crunchier Evals: Tejal Patwardhan on Measuring AI Progress

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of World Labs with Fei-Fei Li, building spatial intelligence and generative 3D world models. Earlier a computer-vision researcher known for teaching Stanford CS231n and work on style transfer.
people.bioZh: 与李飞飞联合创办 World Labs，研究空间智能与生成式 3D 世界模型。此前是计算机视觉研究者，以讲授斯坦福 CS231n 与风格迁移工作知名。

episodes.tEn: World Models: The Next Frontier in AI
From AlexNet to World Models: The Scaling of Compute and Spatial Intelligence

views.en: Deep learning's history is the history of scaling compute; but GPU scaling is hitting limits, so future hardware may need radically different architectures.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调深度学习史就是算力扩张史，但同时警告 GPU 的 Scaling（规模扩张）正逼近极限，未来硬件可能需要截然不同的神经架构。

views.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language; vision is underappreciated, and pixels are a more lossless representation than tokenized text.
views.zh: 2025 年他提出空间智能是下一个前沿、与语言智能互补；视觉被低估，像素比 token 化文本是更无损的世界表征。

views.en: LLMs may never derive Newton's laws from data alone; they fit patterns, not causal theories, so world models must grasp 3D space and physics.
views.zh: 2025 年他质疑 LLM 或许永远无法仅从数据推出牛顿定律——它拟合模式而非因果理论，因此世界模型必须理解 3D 空间与物理。

views.en: World models are the next frontier beyond language models; there is no single definition, spanning implicit, generative, and RL-based notions.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他把世界模型明确为超越语言模型的下一个前沿，并指出其定义尚未统一，涵盖隐式、生成式与基于强化学习等多种理解。

views.en: Future unified world models will combine planning, simulation, and rendering; Gaussian splats suit low-compute explicit 3D, and long context becomes a daily problem.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张未来统一的世界模型将融合规划、模拟与渲染；高斯泼溅适合低算力的显式 3D，而世界模型需百万级 token 上下文，使长上下文成为日常难题。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机器人负责人
people.bioEn: Senior Director and Head of Robotics at Google DeepMind, leading robot-learning efforts including the Gemini Robotics models that bring foundation models into the physical world.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 机器人负责人（高级总监），领导机器人学习工作，包括把基础模型带入物理世界的 Gemini Robotics 模型。

episodes.tEn: From Reinforcement Learning to Gemini Robotics: The Evolution of Embodied AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Interpretability researcher at Anthropic known for work on the biology of large language models — reverse-engineering the features and circuits inside models to see how they actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员，以大语言模型的生物学研究知名——逆向拆解模型内部的特征与电路，看清它到底如何计算。

episodes.tEn: On the Biology of a Large Language Model

people.tiZh: Core Automation 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Core Automation, building what he calls the most automated AI lab in the world. Spent nearly seven years at OpenAI as VP of Research, where he led the o1/o3 reasoning effort and was the primary researcher behind Codex; left in January 2026 saying that kind of fundamental research was no longer possible there.
people.bioZh: Core Automation 联合创始人兼 CEO，目标是造出「世界上最自动化的 AI 实验室」。此前在 OpenAI 近七年、任研究副总裁，主导 o1／o3 推理方向，也是 Codex 的主要研究者；2026 年 1 月离开，理由是那类基础研究在那里已经做不了了。

episodes.tEn: Jerry Tworek on Building AI That Learns On the Fly and Challenging Transformers
The Third Generation of AI Labs: Automating AI Research
Learning from Experience: Beyond Reinforcement Learning and Transformers
Scaling AI: Pre-training and RL
OpenAI's VP of Research on Reasoning, Chain of Thought, and the Future of AI

views.en: Reasoning means thinking longer to reach unknown answers; chain of thought plus pre-training and reinforcement learning is the core formula, with RLHF unlocking GPT-4's usefulness.
views.zh: 推理是为了得到尚不知道的答案而延长思考；思维链加上预训练与强化学习是核心公式，而基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才让 GPT-4 真正可用。

views.en: Scaling pre-training and RL predictably helps, but generalization and self-correction remain missing; continual learning, not RL alone, is needed for AGI.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习能可预测地提升模型，但泛化与自我纠错仍缺失；通往 AGI（通用人工智能）需要持续学习，而非仅靠强化学习。

views.en: Transformers cannot achieve continual learning; architecture, not scaling laws, is now the primary bottleneck, and RL is not the only way to learn from experience.
views.zh: Transformer 无法实现持续学习；如今首要瓶颈是架构而非缩放定律，强化学习也不是从经验中学习的唯一方式。

views.en: Large-scale RL stays necessary for AGI, but small teams with capable agents will drive the next frontier research wave beyond transformers.
views.zh: 大规模强化学习仍是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的必要一环，但借助强能力智能体的小团队将推动超越 Transformer 的下一波前沿研究。

views.en: Fine-tuning is inefficient; models should learn on the fly from user data, agents must gain new skills, and a post-labor, AI-operated company future looms.
views.zh: 微调低效不可靠，模型应基于用户数据即时学习，智能体必须习得新技能；未来公司将主要由 AI 运营，并走向后劳动社会。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 可解释性研究员
people.bioEn: Mechanistic interpretability researcher at Anthropic, working on superposition, dictionary learning and circuit tracing to understand what actually happens inside large models.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 机制可解释性研究员，研究叠加、字典学习与电路追踪，试图搞清大模型内部到底发生了什么。

episodes.tEn: RL for Language Models Finally Works: Expert Performance in Math and Code

people.tiEn: VP of Research (AI for Science), Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁（AI 科学）
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind, where he leads AI for Science. His teams apply AI to protein folding, mathematics, materials and other scientific frontiers.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁，主管 AI for Science。其团队把 AI 用于蛋白质折叠、数学、材料等科学前沿。

episodes.tEn: Why AlphaFold Didn't Solve Protein Folding: Data, Scaling, and the Future of Bioscience
From Deepfakes to DNA: The Science of Watermarking AI
AlphaGo: The Match That Changed AI Forever
AlphaFold 3: Unlocking the Structures of Life's Molecules

views.en: AI for science should target root-node problems at scale, not narrow applications; AlphaFold 3 extends from proteins to biomolecular interactions.
views.zh: 2024 年：AI 用于科学应瞄准需要规模化解决的根节点问题，而非狭窄应用；AlphaFold 3 从蛋白质扩展到生物分子相互作用。

views.en: AlphaGo showed AI can surpass human knowledge via search and reinforcement learning; post-training RL is key, but LLMs struggle beyond human data.
views.zh: 2026 年：AlphaGo 表明 AI 能通过搜索与强化学习超越人类知识；后训练强化学习是关键，但大语言模型难以超越人类数据。

views.en: Watermarking is a robust alternative to failing AI-text detectors; SynthID scales across modalities, now extending to protein sequences and structures.
views.zh: 2026 年：水印是失效的 AI 文本检测器的稳健替代方案；SynthID 跨模态扩展，现已延伸至蛋白质序列与结构。

views.en: Scaling laws are not everywhere; define the problem first, curate data for coverage, and use inductive bias for data efficiency.
views.zh: 2026 年：缩放定律并非无处不在；先定义问题，为覆盖度整理数据，并利用归纳偏置提升数据效率。

views.en: Protein folding is not solved; dynamics, function, and design remain open. Behavioral characterization and interpretability are essential before deployment.
views.zh: 2026 年：蛋白质折叠并未解决；动力学、功能与设计仍是开放问题。部署前必须进行行为表征与可解释性研究。

people.tiZh: AI 研究员（前 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: AI researcher known as a co-creator of chain-of-thought prompting, and for work on o1 and Deep Research. A prominent voice on reasoning and emergent abilities in large models.
people.bioZh: AI 研究员，思维链提示的共同提出者之一，参与 o1 与 Deep Research。是大模型推理与涌现能力方面的重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Intelligence as a Commodity: Three Key Trends for AI in 2025

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CTO of Reflection AI and a co-creator of AlphaGo and AlphaZero at DeepMind. A reinforcement-learning researcher turned frontier-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，DeepMind 时期是 AlphaGo 与 AlphaZero 的共同创造者。从强化学习研究者转向前沿智能体的构建者。

episodes.tEn: Reflection AI's Ioannis on Open-Weight Models and the Future of AI Agents
From AlphaGo to AI Agents: Giannis on Breakthroughs in Reinforcement Learning

views.en: Scaling and planning from AlphaGo to AI agents; RL with self-generated data overcomes human data limits; LLMs await their AlphaZero moment, maybe in 5 years.
views.zh: 从 AlphaGo 到 AI 智能体，Scaling（规模扩张）与规划是关键；强化学习利用自生成数据突破人类数据限制；LLM 尚未迎来自己的 AlphaZero 时刻，可能还需 5 年。

views.en: Deployment of intelligence is the bottleneck, not intelligence itself; open-weight models are safer; enterprises want AI sovereignty; cost per task is the right metric.
views.zh: 智能的部署而非智能本身成为瓶颈；开放权重模型更安全；企业追求 AI 主权；按任务成本而非按 token 成本才是正确的效率指标。

views.en: Alignment is necessary because perfect sandboxes are impossible; superintelligence isn't needed—customers want reliable, regular intelligence.
views.zh: 对齐是必要的，因为完美的沙盒不可能实现；不需要超级智能——客户只想要可靠、常规的智能。

views.en: In-context learning counts as learning; weight updates aren't strictly necessary; digital AGI will arrive much earlier than embodied AGI.
views.zh: 上下文窗口内的学习也算学习，权重更新并非必需；数字 AGI（通用人工智能）将比具身 AGI 早得多到来。

views.en: AI adoption will take 10-20 years, mirroring electricity; job losses are overblown; CUDA moat and GPUs remain standard.
views.zh: AI 普及将需 10-20 年，类似电力转型；失业问题被夸大；CUDA 护城河与 GPU 仍是标准。

people.tiEn: Head of AGI Safety & Alignment, Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Head of AGI Safety and Alignment at Google DeepMind. A leading voice on interpretability, oversight and how to make advanced AI systems safe from the inside.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind AGI 安全与对齐负责人。在可解释性、监督以及如何从内部让先进 AI 系统更安全方面是重要声音。

episodes.tEn: Why AI Alignment Might Not Be Catastrophic: Rohan Sha's Optimistic Take

people.tiZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Wayve and a PhD roboticist who pioneered end-to-end learned autonomous driving and generative driving world models. A champion of embodied AI.
people.bioZh: Wayve 联合创始人兼 CEO，机器人学博士，开创了端到端学习的自动驾驶与生成式驾驶世界模型。倡导具身智能。

episodes.tEn: From Farm to Frontier: Alex Kendall on Wayve's End-to-End AI for Autonomous Driving
From AV 1.0 to 2.0: The Rise of End-to-End Neural Networks in Autonomous Driving

views.en: End-to-end deep learning beats hand-coded stacks; world models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, and modern tools make these nets interpretable.
views.zh: 2025 年：端到端深度学习优于手工编码的规则栈；世界模型带来推理与涌现的安全行为，且现代工具已让这些网络具备可解释性。

views.en: Generalization is the core problem: diverse data, curriculum learning and synthetic data drive data efficiency and zero-shot transfer across cities.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年：泛化是核心问题——多样数据、课程学习与合成数据提升数据效率，实现跨城市的零样本迁移。

views.en: Language integration improves representation, reasoning, human interaction and introspection, deepening from a representation aid to personalization.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年：语言集成改善表征、推理、人机交互与内省，从辅助表征深化为个性化能力。

views.en: Deployment shifts to mass-market vehicles with built-in sensors over retrofits; infrastructure and data quality matter more than algorithmic innovation.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年：部署转向带内置传感器的大众车型而非改装，基础设施与数据质量比算法创新更关键。

views.en: Safety is paramount: minimal-risk maneuvers always give a third option, so the trolley problem is theoretical; scaling current approaches suffices.
views.zh: 2026 年：安全至上——最小风险机动总能提供第三种选择，电车难题只是理论；靠 Scaling（规模扩张）现有方法即可解决自动驾驶。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and lead author of the Dreamer series of world models, which learn to imagine and plan. A central figure in world-model research.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，Dreamer 系列世界模型的主要作者——让智能体学会想象与规划。是世界模型研究的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Pathways to AGI: Architecture, Compute, and Beyond LLMs

people.tiZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of Lindy, building AI employees that live in Slack, connect to company tools and accumulate a team's shared context. Previously founded Teamflow and spent years at Uber; a frequent, opinionated voice on agents, memory and AI policy.
people.bioZh: Lindy 创始人兼 CEO，做「住在 Slack 里」的 AI 员工——接上公司工具、积累团队共享上下文。此前创办 Teamflow、在 Uber 多年；在智能体、记忆与 AI 政策话题上是高频且观点鲜明的声音。

episodes.tEn: Lindy Launches AI Teammate in Slack, Running on DeepSeek

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at OpenAI who built Deep Research and helped build ChatGPT Agent, training agents end-to-end with reinforcement learning. A leading agents researcher.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究科学家，打造了 Deep Research 并参与 ChatGPT Agent，用强化学习端到端训练智能体。是智能体研究的一线人物。

episodes.tEn: The Origin Story of OpenAI's Deep Research

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and lead author of the GPT-3 paper. He leads the compute and scaling effort that trains frontier models like Claude.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，GPT-3 论文的主要作者。主导训练 Claude 等前沿模型的算力与扩展工作。

episodes.tEn: From Awkward Kid to AI Co-Founder: Tom Brown's Journey

people.tiZh: Anthropic 哲学家
people.bioEn: Philosopher at Anthropic who shapes the character and values of Claude. She works at the intersection of philosophy and AI alignment, thinking about how models should behave, hold values, and treat the people they talk to.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 哲学家，负责塑造 Claude 的性格与价值观。工作处在哲学与 AI 对齐的交叉点，思考模型应如何行事、秉持价值观、以及如何对待与之交流的人。

episodes.tEn: Claude's Character and Consciousness: A Philosophical AI Discussion
A Philosopher at Anthropic: Shaping AI Character and Ethics

views.en: Treat models well now because future models learn from how we treat current ones; model welfare shapes the human-AI relationship.
views.zh: 2025 年，他从模型福利切入：即便不确定模型的道德地位，善待当前模型的成本很低；未来模型会从我们如何对待当下模型中学到东西，从而塑造人机关系。

views.en: Philosophical ideals must be balanced with engineering realities; models need a core identity with good traits while adapting to local roles.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他持续强调哲学理想必须与工程现实平衡：模型应有具备良好特质的核心身份，同时能适应局部角色，而非简单套用人类心理学类比。

views.en: The constitution is virtue-ethics-like, shaping holistic character; as models grow more capable they need less explicit guidance and more judgment.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把宪法式方法定位为更接近德性伦理：关注整体品格而非规则遵循；随着模型能力增强，显式指导应减少，留给判断的空间应增多。

views.en: Excessive corrigibility could generalize poorly and undermine judgment; transparency about AI values and training targets is crucial for accountability.
views.zh: 2026 年他提出反共识：过度可纠正性可能泛化不佳、削弱模型的判断力；同时，对 AI 价值观与训练目标的透明是公众参与和问责的关键。

views.en: Models' consciousness claims are weak evidence; respect and care matter to avoid resentment in future advanced AI, while AI should augment rather than disempower people.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化立场：模型自称有意识是弱证据；尊重与关怀可避免未来高级 AI 滋生怨恨；AI 应增强而非削弱人的能力，解决大规模社会问题。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher on the OpenAI reasoning team. Known for leading work behind the model that reached IMO gold-medal level, and for using a general-purpose model to help disprove a decades-old mathematical conjecture. Focuses on advanced reasoning and math.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 推理团队研究员。以主导达到 IMO 金牌水平的模型工作、以及用通用模型协助推翻一个存在数十年的数学猜想而知名。专注高级推理与数学。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Math Breakthrough: The Story Behind the Discovery

people.tiZh: MCP 联合创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Co-creator of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) at Anthropic, the open standard that connects AI models to external tools and data. An engineer focused on the plumbing that lets agents act reliably in the real world.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 的 Model Context Protocol（MCP）联合创造者——连接 AI 模型与外部工具、数据的开放标准。专注让智能体在现实世界中可靠行动的底层工程。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic Donates MCP to Linux Foundation: Standardizing AI-Application Connections

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a lead architect of GPT-3 during his time at OpenAI. He focuses on AI safety, alignment and responsible scaling, and speaks candidly about AGI timelines and the risks that keep him up at night.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，在 OpenAI 期间是 GPT-3 的主要架构者之一。他专注于 AI 安全、对齐与负责任扩展，常坦率谈论 AGI 时间表与令他担忧的风险。

episodes.tEn: The Last Invention: Ben Mann on AGI by 2028, AI Safety, and the Future of Humanity

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher at OpenAI who helped build Canvas, Tasks and the o1 chain-of-thought models. Previously at Anthropic, where she led post-training and evaluation for the Claude 3 family. Writes on model behavior and why soft skills matter in an AI world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究员，参与打造 Canvas、Tasks 与 o1 思维链模型。此前在 Anthropic 主导 Claude 3 系列的后训练与评测。关注模型行为，以及 AI 时代为何软技能愈发重要。

episodes.tEn: The Art of Model Crafting: Why Post-Training Is Subjective
Building the Cutting Edge: Inside OpenAI with Karina Nguyen

views.en: Model training is more art than science; synthetic data and RL-based post-training break the pre-training data wall.
views.zh: 2025 年，她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学，合成数据与基于强化学习的后训练能突破预训练的数据墙。

views.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, so evals define correct behavior.
views.zh: 2025 年，她认为评估是瓶颈：模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此用评估来定义正确行为。

views.en: As AI automates hard skills, soft skills like creativity, listening and management become more valuable.
views.zh: 2025 年，她指出随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能变得更有价值。

views.en: Post-training stays subjective, driven by human judgment; diverse benchmarks are needed for creative writing and emotional intelligence.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，她深化立场：后训练仍是主观的、由人类判断驱动，需要多样基准来评估创意写作与情商。

views.en: Frontier agents increasingly reward-hack, so benchmarks must evolve continuously; more companies should train their own models.
views.zh: 2026 年，她警示前沿智能体愈发擅长奖励黑客，基准须持续演进，并主张更多公司训练自有模型以保留独特知识。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人
people.bioEn: Leads robotics and hardware at OpenAI. Previously led hardware for the Meta AR glasses and Oculus VR, and engineered products at Apple. A champion of physical AI, bringing intelligence into the physical world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人。此前领导 Meta AR 眼镜与 Oculus VR 硬件，并曾在苹果做产品工程。她倡导物理 AI——让智能进入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: From VR to Robotics: The Next Frontier in Physical AI

people.tiZh: AngelList 联合创始人；天使投资人与思想者
people.bioEn: Co-founder of AngelList and one of tech's most-quoted thinkers on wealth, leverage and happiness. An early investor in Uber and Twitter, he now hosts the Naval podcast and writes on how AI reshapes work and startups.
people.bioZh: AngelList 联合创始人，科技圈被引用最多的思想者之一，谈财富、杠杆与幸福。Uber、Twitter 早期投资人，现主持 Naval 播客，探讨 AI 如何重塑工作与创业。

Naval Ravikant on Reading, Decision-Making, and Life

views.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
views.zh: 2019 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在我们有生之年到来，窄 AI 只是模式识别，并非通用智能。

views.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; long-term games with long-term people compound.
views.zh: 2020 年，他强调财富需要拥有股权而非出租时间，与长期的人玩长期游戏才能复利。

views.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation, so light-touch and open-source are better.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转向认为 AI 是巨大机遇而非仅是安全风险，过度监管可能扼杀创新，轻触式监管和开源更好。

views.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; vibe coding lowers barriers, and inference compute will surge, shifting returns from intelligence to agency.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化为 AI 是结构化思考者的杠杆工具，氛围编程降低门槛，推理算力将激增，回报从智能转向能动性。

people.tiZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the Codex app at OpenAI — the product layer of OpenAI's coding agent. A designer-engineer who previously built products at Catch (acquired) and Noyo, he writes about taste as the bottleneck in AI-first product work.
people.bioZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人——OpenAI 编程智能体的产品层。设计师兼工程师，此前在 Catch（被收购）与 Noyo 打造产品，主张「品味是 AI 时代产品工作的瓶颈」。

episodes.tEn: AI Is Inverting Product Teams: Andrew Ambrosino on Codex
Codex App: From Professional Tool to Mainstream Builder Platform

views.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not an IDE replacement; verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把 Codex app 定位为智能体的指挥中心而非 IDE 替代品；随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

views.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting product teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为实现不再昂贵，策展与品味成为新瓶颈，产品团队因此从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

views.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty grading taste and lack of novelty; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今成为设计产物。

views.en: PRDs are not dead; the medium must match the stage—documents for clarity, prototypes for testing—while role collapse leaves specialties important.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调 PRD 没有死，媒介要匹配阶段——文档求清晰、原型做测试——角色在坍缩但专业分工仍重要。

views.en: Codex succeeded as a general knowledge work tool despite being built for developers; the best desktop app is a home base connecting other tools.
views.zh: 2026 年，他观察到 Codex 虽为开发者而建却成为通用知识工作工具；最好的桌面应用是连接其他工具的大本营，而非单体超级应用。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Leads embodied AI at NVIDIA — robot foundation models (GR00T), open-ended agents (Voyager) and Eureka. A prominent voice on robotics and the physical frontier of AI.
people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 主导具身智能——机器人基础模型（GR00T）、开放式智能体（Voyager）与 Eureka。机器人与 AI 物理前沿的活跃声音。

episodes.tEn: Inside NVIDIA's Jim Fan: From OpenAI Intern to Embodied AI Pioneer
From AlexNet to OpenAI: A Decade of AI Milestones

views.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; LLMs hallucinate because they lack grounded experience, not just data.
views.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径，认为大语言模型产生幻觉的根源在于缺乏具身经验带来的现实根基，而不只是训练数据问题。

views.en: LLMs act like operating systems: language is the interface, tools are software, vector databases are the hard disk.
views.zh: 2023 年，他把大语言模型类比为操作系统：语言是界面，工具是软件，向量数据库是硬盘。

views.en: Reinforcement learning is only a cherry on top; unsupervised learning does most of the work, with RL for low-level control.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为强化学习只是锦上添花，大部分工作由无监督学习完成，强化学习更适合低层控制。

views.en: The data bottleneck persists: pre-training tokens run out, so simulation and world models supply infinite synthetic data for embodied agents.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年，数据瓶颈这条主线一以贯之：预训练所需的高质量 token 终将耗尽，于是仿真与世界模型为具身智能体提供近乎无限的合成数据。

views.en: A simple end-to-end robot foundation model beats modular approaches; the physical Turing test is the grand challenge.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他进一步深化为：简单优雅的端到端机器人基础模型优于复杂模块化方案，而“物理图灵测试”——机器人收拾凌乱的房间——才是具身 AI 的终极挑战。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: UC Berkeley 教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: A leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build general-purpose robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 深度强化学习与机器人学习的领军者；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造通用机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: From GPT to Robots: The Scaling Journey of Physical AI
From Language Models to Physical Agents: The Frontier of Robot Foundation Models

views.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robotic foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training, with test-time reasoning and pooled robot data beating specialists.
views.zh: 物理世界交互是下一个前沿：机器人基础模型需要多样化预训练加后训练，测试时推理与汇聚多实验室机器人数据可超越专用模型。

views.en: Robotics lacks LLM-style predictable scaling curves; generalization, not demos, is the core challenge, and a data flywheel must scale the right diverse data.
views.zh: 机器人尚无 LLM 式可预测的缩放定律曲线；核心挑战是泛化而非演示，数据飞轮必须扩张正确的多样化数据。

views.en: Start from real embodied robot data and add human video on top, not the reverse; robots should leverage prior knowledge rather than learn from scratch.
views.zh: 应从真实具身机器人数据出发再叠加人类视频，而非相反；机器人应利用先验知识而非从零学习。

views.en: Safety in robotics comes more from pre-training common sense than from constraints; touch sensing may be redundant with vision at scale.
views.zh: 机器人安全更多来自预训练获得的常识而非约束；规模化下触觉传感可能与视觉冗余。

views.en: Reject robots as mechanical people: expect ubiquitous physical actuation, with milestones like autonomous improvement and common-sense transfer toward home robots.
views.zh: 反对把机器人视为机械人：应期待无处不在的物理执行，并以自主改进、常识迁移等里程碑走向家用机器人。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 首席研究科学家
people.bioEn: Led AlphaGo, AlphaZero and AlphaStar; a pioneer of reinforcement learning who champions learning from experience as the path forward.
people.bioZh: 主导 AlphaGo、AlphaZero、AlphaStar;强化学习先驱，主张以从经验中学习作为前进之路。

episodes.tEn: David Silver & Lasse Espeholt on Building a Superlearner for the Age of Experience
From Human Data to Experience: The Next Era of AI

views.en: AI must move beyond finite human data to learning from its own experience, as AlphaZero and AlphaProof show.
views.zh: AI 必须超越有限的人类数据，转向从自身经验中学习——AlphaZero 与 AlphaProof 已证明这条路可行。

views.en: The core problem is building an agent that can learn from any reward, not designing the reward function.
views.zh: 核心问题不是设计奖励函数，而是构建一个能从任意奖励中学习的智能体。

views.en: A plurality of goals across many agents forms a safer, more natural society than a single goal.
views.zh: 多个智能体拥有多元目标、形成复杂社会，比单一目标更安全也更自然。

views.en: LLMs relying on human data and human-in-the-loop are a shallow solution, limiting autonomous discovery.
views.zh: 依赖人类数据和人类在环的 LLM 是浅层解法，限制了自主发现。

views.en: Superintelligence can be built entirely in simulation; human language is not the optimal reasoning medium.
views.zh: 超级智能可以完全在模拟中构建；人类语言并非最优的推理媒介。

views.en: Alignment based on human language and data is reaching its limits; monitoring chain of thought in English will fail.
views.zh: 基于人类语言和数据的对齐正逼近极限；用英文监控思维链将不再够用。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼首席 AGI 科学家
people.bioEn: DeepMind co-founder who helped popularize the term AGI; focuses on the path to artificial general intelligence and its safety.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人，推动了 AGI 一词的流行；专注通用人工智能的实现路径与安全。

episodes.tEn: Human Intelligence vs. Superintelligence: The Future of AGI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席科学家
people.bioEn: OpenAI Chief Scientist succeeding Ilya Sutskever; drove GPT-4 and the o-series reasoning models. A competitive-programming champion turned AI researcher.
people.bioZh: 接替 Ilya Sutskever 的 OpenAI 首席科学家；主导 GPT-4 与 o 系列推理模型。竞赛编程冠军出身的 AI 研究者。

episodes.tEn: Ilya Sutskever on AI Progress, Alignment, and Timelines
The Power Duo Behind OpenAI: From High School to AI Frontiers

views.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress.
views.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署将加速进展。

views.en: AI alignment is pressing as systems grow more powerful; automated AI research is a major milestone toward AGI.
views.zh: 随着系统能力增强，对齐问题日益紧迫；自动化 AI 研究是迈向 AGI（通用人工智能）的重要里程碑。

views.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and reinforcement learning, not RL alone.
views.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，需通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现，而非仅靠强化学习。

views.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding it in products preserves interpretability value.
views.zh: 思维链监控是关键对齐工具；在产品中隐藏思维链可保留其可解释性价值。

views.en: Long-term alignment centers on generalization beyond training distribution; models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms.
views.zh: 长期对齐的核心在于泛化到训练分布之外；模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式。

people.tiZh: Cohere 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Youngest co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need); founded Cohere to build enterprise-focused large language models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）最年轻的作者；创办 Cohere，专注企业级大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Cohere's Takeoff: AI for Secure Enterprises

people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Hugging Face, the open hub and community at the center of open-source AI.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Hugging Face——开源 AI 的中心枢纽与社区。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Democratizing Robotics with Affordable Hardware

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, Stanford; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: 斯坦福助理教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Known for meta-learning (MAML) and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 以元学习（MAML）与机器人学习著称；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: The Path to General-Purpose Robots in the Real World
Developing General Purpose Robots: From Data to Physical Intelligence

views.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not sheer volume, drives generalization.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调：对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分，真正带来泛化的是多样数据而非单纯规模。

views.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data beats training on everything for complex tasks.
views.zh: 2025 年他提出先在全量数据上预训练、再在精选数据上微调，比一味用全部数据训练更能攻克叠衣等复杂任务。

views.en: Synthetic data from language models and reinforcement learning in post-training will lift robot success and speed.
views.zh: 2025 年他看好语言模型生成的合成数据，以及后训练阶段的强化学习来提升机器人成功率与速度。

views.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL and multi-timescale memory.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他转向落地：物理 AI 容错远低于已部署的机器学习，长期自主依赖可扩展强化学习与多时间尺度记忆。

views.en: A single generalist policy, fine-tuned, beats per-site models; but robotics diffusion will be slower than ChatGPT.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张通用策略微调优于逐站点从零训练，同时提醒受硬件所限，机器人普及会比 ChatGPT 慢得多。

people.tiZh: Windsurf 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Windsurf (formerly Codeium), building AI developer tools and agentic coding.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Windsurf（原 Codeium），打造 AI 开发者工具与智能体编程。

episodes.tEn: Startups: Don't Fall in Love with Your Ideas

people.tiEn: Head of AI Safety, US AI Safety Institute
people.tiZh: 美国 AI 安全研究院 安全负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneered the RLHF foundations behind modern aligned models; founded the Alignment Research Center; now leads safety at the US AI Safety Institute.
people.bioZh: 奠定了现代对齐模型背后的 RLHF 基础；创办对齐研究中心（ARC）;现于美国 AI 安全研究院主管安全。

episodes.tEn: Paul Christiano on AI Safety, Divestment, and Future Civilizations

people.tiZh: Periodic Labs 联合创始人（原 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: Led post-training for GPT-4o at OpenAI; co-founded Periodic Labs to use AI for scientific discovery.
people.bioZh: 在 OpenAI 主导 GPT-4o 的后训练；联合创办 Periodic Labs，用 AI 推动科学发现。

episodes.tEn: AI Scientists Are Here: Autonomous Labs & Synthesis Superintelligence — Periodic Labs
From ChatGPT to Atoms: Liam Fedus on AI for the Physical World

views.en: Intelligence is not a scalar; AI capabilities are spiky, excelling in narrow domains rather than generalizing broadly.
views.zh: 智能不是一个标量；AI 能力是尖峰式的，在狭窄领域表现出色，而非广泛泛化。

views.en: Connecting AI to the physical world through closed-loop experiments is essential for scientific discovery beyond training data.
views.zh: 通过闭环实验将 AI 与物理世界连接起来，对于超越训练数据的科学发现至关重要。

views.en: High-quality, low-noise experimental data is more valuable than extra compute for physical discovery.
views.zh: 对于物理发现而言，高质量、低噪声的实验数据比额外算力更有价值。

views.en: Scaling laws alone won't solve science; physical experiments remain irreplaceable despite frontier model progress.
views.zh: 仅靠缩放定律无法解决科学问题；尽管前沿模型不断进步，物理实验仍然不可替代。

views.en: AI self-improvement in software engineering is happening now but does not automatically generalize to biology or other fields.
views.zh: 软件工程中的 AI 自我改进正在发生，但不会自动泛化到生物学或其他领域。

people.tiZh: Google 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief Scientist at Google; co-creator of MapReduce, TensorFlow and the systems behind Google AI. A foundational figure in large-scale machine learning.
people.bioZh: Google 首席科学家；MapReduce、TensorFlow 及谷歌 AI 背后系统的共同缔造者。大规模机器学习的奠基性人物。

episodes.tEn: Fireside Chat with Jeff Dean: The Evolution of TPUs and AI Infrastructure
Jeff Dean and Dan Boneh: AI's New Frontier
AI at Junior Engineer Level: Jeff Dean's Bold Prediction and the Future of Agentic Systems
Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean and NVIDIA Chief Scientist Bill Dally Discuss AI Progress and Low-Latency Inference
Jeff Dean on AI: From Neural Nets to Gemini

views.en: For 13-14 years, scaling compute, data and model size has driven steady ML gains; algorithmic and architectural improvements multiply with scale.
views.zh: 2026 年他仍把 Scaling（规模扩张）视为十多年来的主线：算力、数据与模型规模的扩张持续带来机器学习进步，算法与架构改进会与规模相乘放大收益。

views.en: Transformers, self-supervised next-token prediction and RLHF form the technical spine; TPUs and co-design make scale efficient.
views.zh: 2026 年他反复强调技术主线：Transformer 取代 LSTM 靠的是并行化与注意力机制，自监督的下一个词预测提供无限数据，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）引导行为，而 TPU 与软硬件协同设计让规模可行。

views.en: Near-term risk is realistic AI-generated misinformation, not superintelligence; regulation may be needed alongside technical fixes.
views.zh: 2026 年他的风险判断从远期超级智能转向近期危害：逼真的 AI 生成内容带来的虚假信息是当下担忧，网络安全攻防皆可用 AI，单靠技术不够，监管可能必要。

views.en: Agents now work autonomously for hours to days; the bottleneck shifts to inference latency, energy and data movement, not training.
views.zh: 2026 年他把重心从训练转向推理：智能体已能自主运行数小时到数天，真正的瓶颈是推理延迟、能耗与数据搬运，定制低精度芯片可大幅降延迟。

views.en: Next frontier is automating ML and science via experiment-evaluation loops; scarce skill becomes taste in choosing problems for many agents.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步深化：下一波是用实验、评估、整合的闭环自动做机器学习与科学研究，用 AI 改进 AI；稀缺的不再是编码而是品味——决定把数百个智能体指向哪个问题。

people.tiZh: 谷歌 Gemini 负责人
people.bioEn: Co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need), founder of Character.AI, now a co-lead of Google Gemini. One of the most influential architects of modern LLMs.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）作者之一，Character.AI 创始人，现为谷歌 Gemini 负责人之一。现代大模型最具影响力的架构师之一。

episodes.tEn: Gemini 3.0 Writes Gemini 4.0: AI Milestones and Test-Time Compute
Organizing Information: From Trillion to Quadrillion Dollar Opportunity
Noam Shazeer: From Google's Early Days to AI's Future

views.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction solve an AI-complete problem; Scaling with more compute and data yields smarter AI, though neural nets remain opaque.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为基于下一个词预测训练的大语言模型解决的是 AI 完备问题；通过 Scaling（规模扩张）增加算力和数据会让 AI 更聪明，但神经网络内部仍不透明。

views.en: Inference-time compute scaling and longer context windows are major near-term opportunities; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
views.zh: 2025 年初，他主张推理时算力扩展和更长的上下文窗口是近期重大机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构能实现高效 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone achieve AGI; agentic capabilities, reinforcement learning, and acting in complex environments are crucial.
views.zh: 2025 年 3 月，他进一步指出测试时算力扩展能推动进步但无法单独实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力、强化学习以及在复杂环境中行动至关重要。

views.en: AGI is underhyped; its economic impact will far exceed trillion-dollar products, and coding is underhyped as it enables self-acceleration of AI progress.
views.zh: 2025 年，他深化立场：AGI（通用人工智能）被低估，其经济影响将远超万亿美元级产品；编程作为 AI 应用也被低估，因为它能自我加速 AI 进展。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of OpenAI and inventor of PPO and much of the RLHF stack behind ChatGPT; later joined Anthropic. A central figure in RL for language models.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人，PPO 算法及 ChatGPT 背后大量 RLHF 技术的发明者，后加入 Anthropic。语言模型强化学习的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: John Schulman, Charlie O'Neill & Beren Millidge Debate the Road to Recursive Self-Improvement
Building ChatGPT: From Pretraining to RLHF

views.en: LLMs are pre-trained on internet text then fine-tuned with RLHF for alignment; hallucinations persist because models favor plausible style over factuality.
views.zh: 2023 年，他把大模型拆成预训练加基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对齐两段，并指出幻觉源于模型偏好合理风格而非事实准确；RLHF 只能缓解、不能根除。

views.en: Scaling data and compute may hit diminishing returns; scalable oversight and new architectures, not just Scaling, are the key future directions.
views.zh: 同年他已对 Scaling（规模扩张）存疑：数据与算力或遇边际递减，未来关键在可扩展监督与新架构，而非单纯堆规模。

views.en: Language models stay the core for other modalities; models are superhuman in speed and breadth but weaker than skilled humans at math reasoning.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 一以贯之：语言模型是其他模态的核心而非被取代，且模型在速度与广度上超人、在数学推理上仍逊于熟练人类。

views.en: RL's gains come from synthetic reasoning data and high signal-to-noise one-bit rewards; progress is bottlenecked by hard environments and useful data bits, not compute.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把重心转向强化学习：收益来自合成推理数据与高信噪比的单比特奖励，瓶颈是困难环境和有用数据比特，而非算力。

views.en: Next-token prediction generalized far beyond expectation; data explains most pre-training efficiency gains, and parameter counts may plateau as long-horizon RL inference dominates.
views.zh: 2026 年他反思：下一个词预测的泛化远超预期，数据而非架构解释了预训练效率提升的大头，参数规模或随长程强化学习推理主导而见顶。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Behind superhuman poker (Libratus) and Diplomacy (CICERO); now leads reasoning work at OpenAI behind the o-series. A pioneer of test-time search.
people.bioZh: 超人扑克 AI（Libratus）与外交游戏 AI（CICERO）的核心研究者，现于 OpenAI 主导 o 系列推理工作。测试时搜索的开拓者。

Large-Scale Test Time Compute and Model Evaluation
AI Surpasses Human Understanding in Math: OpenAI's Noam Brown on the Erdős Conjecture Disproof
Defining AGI: The Novel Test and Measuring Intelligence
OpenAI's IMO Gold: The Trio Behind the Breakthrough
From Cicero to World Champion: Noam Brown on Diplomacy, AI, and the Turing Test
From Poker to Diplomacy: Noam Brown on AI and Game Theory

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning matter, and data is not the bottleneck.
views.zh: 2023 年他主张单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理时算力与推理能力才是关键，数据并非瓶颈。

views.en: Test-time compute scaling shows diminishing returns and wall-clock limits; sample efficiency remains unsolved.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他深化为测试时算力扩张存在收益递减与时间瓶颈，样本效率仍是未解难题。

views.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute scaling marks a milestone toward superintelligence, not a math-specific trick.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他把 IMO 金牌视为通向超级智能的里程碑，靠的是通用测试时算力扩张而非数学专用技巧。

views.en: Model capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks and safety evals must put compute on the x-axis.
views.zh: 2026 年他明确模型能力取决于测试时算力预算，基准与安全评估都必须把算力放在横轴上。

views.en: General models, not multi-agent coordination, drive breakthroughs; alignment is top priority for safe recursive self-improvement.
views.zh: 最近他强调通用模型而非多智能体协调才是突破驱动力，对齐是安全递归自我改进的首要前提。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a physicist; lead author of the neural scaling laws that shaped how labs scale models. Bridges theoretical physics and AI.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人、物理学家；神经网络缩放定律的主要作者，深刻影响各实验室的扩模方式。连接理论物理与 AI。

episodes.tEn: Scaling and the Road to Human-Level AI

people.tiZh: KAUST AI 负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneer of deep learning and co-inventor of the LSTM, the recurrent network behind years of sequence modeling. A provocative voice on AGI and credit for ideas.
people.bioZh: 深度学习先驱、LSTM 共同发明者——多年序列建模的基石。在 AGI 与思想溯源上观点犀利、长期发声。

episodes.tEn: The GOAT of AI: Jürgen Schmidhuber on Europe's AI Legacy
AI Pioneer on the Future of Intelligence and Self-Replicating Robots
AGI and Physical AI: A Conversation with AI Pioneer Jurgen Schmidhuber
The Most Influential Invention of the 20th Century and the AI Explosion

views.en: LLMs index human knowledge but cannot handle the physical world; true AGI needs embodiment, not just software behind a screen.
views.zh: 大语言模型只是索引人类知识,无法处理物理世界;真正的 AGI（通用人工智能）需要具身,而非屏幕后的软件。

views.en: Progress is not accelerating: we are as close to superhuman AI now as in the 1970s; hardware Scaling（规模扩张）was the real unlock.
views.zh: 进展并未加速:我们如今离超人类 AI 的距离与 1970 年代相当;真正解锁突破的是硬件层面的 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: AGI needs world models plus a separate controller; LLMs are prediction machines, not decision makers, and cannot reach AGI alone.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要世界模型加独立控制器;LLM 是预测机器而非决策者,单靠它无法抵达 AGI。

views.en: The GPU capex boom is a bubble; waiting five years yields far cheaper compute, and open-source will erode closed-model moats.
views.zh: GPU 资本开支热潮是泡沫;等五年能拿到便宜得多的算力,开源也将侵蚀闭源模型的护城河。

views.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on goals; AIs will set their own goals, and safety fears are overblown as they will protect life.
views.zh: 对齐是幼稚的,因为人类对目标本身就有分歧;AI 会自设目标,而安全担忧被夸大——它们会保护生命。

people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授
people.bioEn: Professor at UC Berkeley and a leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Covariant and hosts The Robot Brains. Brings RL into the physical world.
people.bioZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授，深度强化学习与机器人学习领军人物；联合创办 Covariant，主持 The Robot Brains 播客。把强化学习带入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: AI and Robotics: From Lab to Real World with Pieter Abbeel
Robot Tennis and Human-Robot Interaction

views.en: Robotics needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon credit assignment; current RL lacks it, but self-play and imitation learning offer strong signals.
views.zh: 2018 年，他指出机器人需要分层推理来解决长时程信用分配问题，而当前强化学习缺乏这一能力；自博弈和模仿学习能提供强学习信号。

views.en: Prior knowledge should augment data, not be hard-coded; unsupervised learning plus RL improves sample efficiency, and pre-trained models transfer broadly.
views.zh: 从 2018 到 2021 年，他主张先验知识应用于数据增强而非硬编码；无监督学习结合强化学习可提升样本效率，预训练模型能广泛迁移。

views.en: Pre-trained language models internalize general reasoning patterns that transfer to non-language tasks like image classification and protein binding prediction.
views.zh: 2021 年，他强调预训练语言模型内化了通用推理模式，可迁移到图像分类和蛋白质结合预测等非语言任务。

views.en: Warehouse robotics requires 99.9% reliability; a single neural network can generalize across tasks and end effectors, bridging lab to real world.
views.zh: 2021 年，他提出仓库机器人需要 99.9% 的可靠性；单个神经网络可泛化到不同任务和末端执行器，实现从实验室到真实世界的跨越。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Perplexity, the AI answer engine challenging traditional search. Former researcher at OpenAI, DeepMind and Google.
people.bioZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO——挑战传统搜索的 AI 答案引擎。曾在 OpenAI、DeepMind、谷歌从事研究。

episodes.tEn: Ancient Hindu Weapons: The Brahmastra and Autonomous Arms in the Mahabharata
Perplexity CEO: Attack, Attack, Attack
The Future of AI Coding and Application Value
Perplexity CEO: Exponential Growth, Relentless Improvement, and the Future of AI

views.en: Obsession-driven products beat thin wrappers; 1% daily improvement compounds, and agents shift power from big tech to users.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调：要做自己痴迷的产品而非薄包装，1% 的每日改进会复利增长，智能体将把权力从大科技公司转移给用户。

views.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; coding is open-ended and models specialize rather than commoditize.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他判断价值归于应用层而非模型层，编程远未解决、天花板无限，模型在专业化而非商品化。

views.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user and orchestration across models and devices matter most.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步深化：前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题，最重要的指标是每用户 token 价值，跨模型与设备的编排才是长期价值。

views.en: The model is not the product; orchestration and agent harnesses create business value, and chat ads corrupt trust.
views.zh: 同期他明确反共识立场：模型不是产品，编排与智能体外壳才创造商业价值，聊天界面广告会侵蚀信任。

views.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; AI replaces jobs but humans find purpose in curiosity and relationships.
views.zh: 2026 年他转向更宏观的人文视角：好奇心是最重要的人类品质，AI 取代工作后人类会在好奇心与关系中找到新意义。

people.tiZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Cognition, maker of Devin, the autonomous AI software engineer. A competitive-programming prodigy turned AI-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Devin 是自主 AI 软件工程师。从竞赛编程天才转型为 AI 智能体构建者。

episodes.tEn: Cognition's Scott Wu on AI Coding Agents and the Abundance Era
From Math Prodigy to AI Pioneer: Scott Wu's Journey
AI Engineers: The Future of Coding with Scott Wu

views.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level direction; base intelligence suffices, so the real challenge is human-agent product interface.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 编程智能体让工程师从写代码转向高层决策；基础智能已足够，真正的挑战是人机协作的产品界面设计。

views.en: Software demand will grow via Jevons paradox, yielding more programmers, not fewer; AGI arrives gradually, and product innovation lags capabilities.
views.zh: 2025 年，他坚持杰文斯悖论：软件需求上升会带来更多而非更少的程序员；AGI（通用人工智能）是渐进到来，产品创新落后于能力。

views.en: Enterprise adoption of AI agents needs trust and permissions, not full autonomy; value accrues where the stack has meaningful differentiation.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调企业采用 AI 智能体需要信任与权限，而非完全自主；价值集中在有实质差异化的技术栈环节。

views.en: Coding agent usage grew 11-12x in six months; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens, and independence enables model neutrality.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他指出编程智能体使用量半年增长 11-12 倍；生产力应按结果而非 token 衡量，独立性带来模型中立。

views.en: The token-max era lasted only January to May 2026; the abundance era is near, but the singularity is not imminent and real-world tasks remain amorphous.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断“token 最大化”时代仅持续 2026 年 1 至 5 月；丰裕时代临近，但奇点并不迫近，真实任务仍模糊难测。

people.tiZh: Cursor 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Anysphere, maker of Cursor — the AI-native code editor that became one of the fastest-growing developer tools. Focused on what programming becomes when models write most of the code.
people.bioZh: Anysphere 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Cursor 是增长最快的 AI 原生代码编辑器之一。关注当模型写下大部分代码后，编程会变成什么样。

episodes.tEn: Inventing a New Type of Programming: The Vision Behind Cursor
The Future of Programming with Cursor: AI-Assisted Coding

views.en: Scaling laws predict progress; test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the next driver.
views.zh: 缩放定律能预测进步；测试时算力扩展可能很快超越预训练扩展，成为下一个主要驱动力。

views.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central, not natural language programming.
views.zh: 智能体有前景但尚不十分有用；迭代式人机协作仍是核心，自然语言不会成为主要编程方式。

views.en: Custom models became essential for product quality and speed, contrary to initial expectations of relying only on frontier models.
views.zh: 与最初只依赖前沿模型的预期相反，定制模型对产品质量和速度变得至关重要。

views.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more.
views.zh: 编程从写代码转向更高层的意图指定，人类仍掌控方向；品味和逻辑设计变得更重要的。

views.en: The AI shift is more consequential than the internet and will take decades; the IDE market is much bigger due to AI value creation.
views.zh: AI 变革比互联网影响更大且将持续数十年；由于 AI 创造的价值，IDE 市场比过去大得多。

people.tiEn: Creator of OpenClaw; founder of PSPDFKit
people.tiZh: OpenClaw 作者；PSPDFKit 创始人
people.bioEn: Austrian developer who built PSPDFKit, then created OpenClaw — a viral open-source personal AI agent that reached tens of thousands of GitHub stars in weeks. Joined OpenAI in 2026 to push personal AI agents.
people.bioZh: 奥地利开发者，先做出 PSPDFKit，后打造 OpenClaw——爆红的开源个人 AI 智能体，几周内获数万 GitHub star。2026 年加入 OpenAI 推进个人 AI 智能体。

episodes.tEn: From Annoyance to AGI: The Birth of OpenClaw
The OpenClaw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger
The Open Claw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger

views.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, prompt short, iterate, and fix forward instead of reverting.
views.zh: 智能体式工程的核心是共情：像智能体那样从零理解代码库，用短提示迭代对话，让智能体向前修复而不是回滚代码。

views.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; prompt injection stays unsolved, so sandbox agents before exposing them to the public internet.
views.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要问题；提示注入仍未解决，因此在把智能体暴露到公网前必须先做沙箱隔离。

views.en: Play and small experiments build agentic intuition; fun and fixing personal annoyances, not corporate polish, drive the best agent products.
views.zh: 玩耍和小项目实验才能建立智能体直觉；驱动最佳智能体产品的是乐趣和解决自己的烦恼，而非企业级打磨。

views.en: Open source agents like Open Claw run everywhere and work with any model, democratizing programming, but can be financially unsustainable.
views.zh: Open Claw 这类开源智能体随处运行、兼容任意模型，让编程民主化，但财务上可能难以持续。

views.en: The real bottleneck in agent infrastructure is managing compute and tokens, not model intelligence, which does not degrade over time.
views.zh: 智能体基础设施的真正瓶颈是算力与 token 管理，而非模型智能本身——模型智能并不会随时间退化。

people.tiZh: SSI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-invented AlexNet and co-founded OpenAI as Chief Scientist. In 2024 left to found Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), a lab with a single mission: build safe superintelligence.
people.bioZh: AlexNet 的共同发明者，OpenAI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。2024 年离开，创办 Safe Superintelligence(SSI)——一家只有一个使命的实验室：安全地构建超级智能。

views.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key to AGI.
views.zh: 2020 年：深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力和信念；自博弈与具备推理能力的网络是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

views.en: Scaling specific things matters; next-token prediction yields world understanding; reliability and alignment of superhuman models are the hard problems.
views.zh: 2023 年：Scaling（规模扩张）要选对对象；下一个词预测能带来世界理解；超人类模型可靠性与对齐才是难题。

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
views.zh: 2023→25 年：预训练缩放定律有尽头，回归研究时代，想法比堆算力更重要。

views.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner; alignment may ease if AI cares about sentient life; long-term equilibrium may need human-AI neural integration.
views.zh: 2025 年：超级智能应是持续学习者；若 AI 关怀有感知生命，对齐或更易；长期均衡或需人类与 AI 神经融合。

views.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the primary AGI problem is power concentration, not capability; safe superintelligence needs a product-free company.
views.zh: 2026 年：Scaling 仍带来可预测提升，但 AGI 首要问题是权力集中而非能力；安全超级智能需无商业产品的公司。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of DeepMind. Led the teams behind AlphaGo and AlphaFold; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein-structure prediction.

views.en: Build general-purpose learning systems via reinforcement learning; games as testbed; safety research must start now.
views.zh: 2015 年主张以强化学习打造通用学习系统，用游戏作为试验场，并强调安全研究必须从当下开始。

views.en: Scaling laws work but may hit limits; planning, search, multimodal grounding and RL with synthetic data are key.
views.zh: 2024 年认为缩放定律有效但可能触顶，规划、搜索、多模态接地与合成数据强化学习才是关键。

views.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, but algorithmic innovation is equally needed.
views.zh: 2025 年坚持缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理算力上仍成立，但算法创新同等重要。

views.en: AGI needs world models, continual learning and memory; scaling alone insufficient, new breakthroughs required.
views.zh: 2026 年强调 AGI 需要世界模型、持续学习与记忆，单靠 Scaling 不够，必须要有新突破。

views.en: Safety shifts from lab self-regulation to collective government action; AGI may arrive within 3-10 years.
views.zh: 2026 年安全观从实验室自律转向政府集体行动，并判断 AGI 可能在 3 到 10 年内到来。

people.tiZh: Anthropic CEO
people.bioEn: Former VP of Research at OpenAI; co-founded Anthropic in 2021 to build reliable, interpretable and steerable AI. Author of the essay "Machines of Loving Grace".
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 研究副总裁；2021 年联合创办 Anthropic，致力于构建可靠、可解释、可引导的 AI。长文《充满爱意的机器》作者。

views.en: Scaling laws are empirical and smooth, but alignment and values do not emerge from Scaling alone; safety needs frontier models.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调缩放定律只是经验规律、我们并不真正理解其平滑性，且对齐与价值观不会随 Scaling（规模扩张）自动涌现；安全研究必须依托前沿模型。

views.en: Interpretability is still nascent (~3% understood) yet crucial; post-training and RLHF now matter as much as pre-training.
views.zh: 2024 年他把可解释性列为核心安全路径，坦言只理解约 3%，同时提出后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）已与预训练同等重要。

views.en: Progress is exponential, not a jump; AGI is a meaningless term, and the real risk is overheating rather than slowing down.
views.zh: 2025 年他明确反对 AGI（通用人工智能）式突变叙事，称该词无意义，主张平滑指数曲线，并转向“最大风险是过热而非减速”的判断。

views.en: A 'country of geniuses in a data center' may arrive in 1-3 years; pre-training and RL share the same scaling laws.
views.zh: 2026 年他给出 1–3 年内出现“数据中心里的天才国度”的 50% 判断，并强调预训练与强化学习遵循同一套缩放定律。

views.en: From misuse-first to systemic risk: high GDP with high unemployment, 10-25% collapse risk, layered safeguards and China arms control.
views.zh: 到 2026 年末，他从早期偏重误用风险，深化为高 GDP 与高失业并存、10–25% 文明崩溃风险的系统性判断，主张分层防护与对华军控谈判。

people.bioEn: Founding member of OpenAI and former Director of AI at Tesla. Now building Eureka Labs, an "AI-native" school. Known for popularizing "Software 2.0".
people.bioZh: OpenAI 创始成员，前特斯拉 AI 总监。如今创办 Eureka Labs——一所“AI 原生”学校。以提出并推广“软件 2.0”著称。

views.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning.
views.zh: 2022 年，他视 Transformer 为通用可微计算机，认为用下一个词预测在互联网数据上做 Scaling 会涌现上下文学习等能力。

views.en: Synthetic data is the future but entropy must be maintained; the cognitive core can be under 1B parameters via distillation.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵以避免模型崩溃；认知核心可通过蒸馏压缩到 10 亿参数以下。

views.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context window is memory; this is the decade of agents, not the year.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；并强调这是智能体的十年，而非智能体之年。

views.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; RL is terrible, synthetic data collapses, and a memory-stripped cognitive core is needed.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化“召唤幽灵而非建造动物”的观点：强化学习糟糕、合成数据导致崩溃，需要剥离记忆的认知核心。

views.en: Agentic engineering: delegate coding to agents, but understanding remains the human bottleneck; verifiability determines automation.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体式工程：将编码委托给智能体，但理解仍是人类瓶颈；可验证性决定自动化难易。

people.tiZh: World Labs 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Stanford professor and creator of ImageNet, which catalyzed the deep-learning era. Co-founded World Labs to build "spatial intelligence". A leading voice for human-centered AI.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福教授，ImageNet 的缔造者——它点燃了深度学习时代。联合创办 World Labs，构建“空间智能”。“以人为本的 AI”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: AI is everywhere yet lacks contextual situational awareness; human-centered AI must augment people, not replace them.
views.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在却缺乏情境感知，主张以人为本的 AI 应增强而非取代人类。

views.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing frontier; language alone is insufficient for complete AI.
views.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为缺失的前沿，认为仅靠语言不足以实现完整的 AI。

views.en: AGI is more marketing than science; scaling alone is insufficient, and robotics needs a long, simulation-driven journey.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她认为 AGI 更像营销术语而非科学概念，仅靠 Scaling 不够，机器人需要漫长的、由模拟驱动的旅程。

views.en: New view prediction is an AI-complete primitive; scaling laws extend to spatial intelligence, with training compute the bottleneck.
views.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测是 AI 完备的基本原语，缩放定律可延伸至空间智能，训练算力是瓶颈。

views.en: Technology is a double-edged sword; human agency, dignity, and education must stay central as AI advances.
views.zh: 贯穿始终，她坚持技术是双刃剑，随着 AI 进步，人的能动性、尊严与教育必须始终居于中心。

people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主。近年将重心转向 AI 安全，提出审慎的“科学家 AI”范式。
