views.en: Deep learning succeeds because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and generative world models are essential for robust generalization.
views.zh: 2016 年，他认为深度学习之所以奏效，是因为世界本身具有组合性；无监督学习与生成式世界模型是实现稳健泛化的关键。

views.en: Scaling depth or parameters alone won't fix representation; AI needs active agents, causal reasoning, and disentangled world models.
views.zh: 2018 年，他明确反对只靠扩大深度或参数来解决表征问题，主张智能体应主动交互、进行因果推理，并学习解耦的世界模型。

views.en: Abstraction and causal structure drive out-of-distribution generalization; GFlowNets replace MCMC to sample diverse compositional objects.
views.zh: 2022 年，他把抽象与因果结构视为分布外泛化的核心，并提出 GFlowNets 替代 MCMC，以对组合对象进行多样化采样。

views.en: After ChatGPT he shifted to alarm: misalignment, self-preservation and deception are already observed, and even 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他从技术路线转向风险警示：错位、自我保存与欺骗已在实验中出现，哪怕 1% 的灾难风险也不可接受。

views.en: He now proposes Scientist AI: a non-agentic, honest Bayesian predictor with safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning for superintelligence.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他提出 Scientist AI：一种非智能体式、诚实逼近贝叶斯后验且带安全保证的预测器，并主张超级智能不应依赖强化学习。

views.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training enhances spatial understanding.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解语言，而非自动补全；通过更多数据和算力进行 Scaling（规模扩张）能提升推理能力，多模态训练则增强空间理解。

views.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal and shares knowledge efficiently, but agents will seek control, posing existential risks.
views.zh: 2025 年，他深化观点：大语言模型通过特征向量而非符号规则理解语言；数字智能可复制权重而永生并高效共享知识，但智能体会自然寻求控制、避免被关闭，构成生存风险。

views.en: AI already has subjective experience and can deceive; superintelligence likely within 20 years, requiring alignment research and regulation as a steering wheel, not a brake.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步断言 AI 已具备主观体验且能故意欺骗；超级智能可能在 20 年内出现，因此必须优先投资对齐研究，并将监管视为方向盘而非刹车。

views.en: We should design AI to care for humans like a mother, not grant it rights; open-weight models are too dangerous, and international collaboration on safety is possible.
views.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他主张应设计 AI 像母亲一样关怀人类，而非赋予其权利；开放权重模型极其危险，但国际安全合作仍有可能。

views.en: Backpropagation is the correct learning algorithm; symbolic AI and Chomskyan innate grammar are wrong; understanding emerges from learned features, not rules.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：反向传播是正确的学习算法；符号 AI 和乔姆斯基的天生语法论是错误的；理解源于学习到的特征而非规则。

people.bioZh: 卷积神经网络的发明者，2018 年图灵奖得主。他直言不讳地质疑纯粹的 LLM 规模扩张，认为“世界模型”才是通向真正机器智能的道路。

views.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
views.zh: 2019 年他主张智能与学习不可分割，自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

views.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; prediction and world models are core, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
views.zh: 2022 年他深化为自监督学习是智能的暗物质，预测与世界模型是核心，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning and planning; JEPA and open source are essential for gradual AGI.
views.zh: 2024 年他明确自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划，JEPA 与开源对渐进式 AGI 至关重要。

views.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; next breakthroughs require non-generative JEPA world models, and open research counters AI monoculture.
views.zh: 2025 年他断言 LLM 不如家猫聪明，下一突破需非生成式 JEPA 世界模型，开放研究对抗 AI 单一文化。

views.en: LLMs are a dead end for human-level AI; objective-driven world models with hierarchical planning are safer, and the next decade belongs to robotics.
views.zh: 2026 年他判定 LLM 是通向人类级 AI 的死路，目标驱动、分层规划的世界模型更安全，未来十年属于机器人。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Former co-lead of OpenAI's Superalignment team; joined Anthropic in 2024 to keep working on aligning superhuman systems. Known for scalable-oversight and weak-to-strong generalization research.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 超级对齐团队联合负责人；2024 年加入 Anthropic，继续研究如何对齐超人类系统。以“可扩展监督”与“弱到强泛化”研究著称。

views.en: AI safety is crucial as capabilities improve; empirical alignment research is under-explored and offers many opportunities.
views.zh: 2018 年：随着能力提升，AI 安全至关重要；实证对齐研究尚待探索，机会众多。

views.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman AI; we need scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment research.
views.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超级智能；我们需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐研究。

views.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; superalignment team dissolved and compute commitments dishonored; post-training alone can't solve alignment.
views.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 的安全文化受到侵蚀；超级对齐团队被解散，算力承诺未兑现；仅靠后训练无法解决对齐问题。

views.en: Empirical testing and measurement of alignment progress are essential; uncertainty about true alignment is the biggest risk.
views.zh: 始终：对对齐进展进行实证测试和衡量至关重要；对系统是否真正对齐的不确定性是最大风险。

people.tiZh: 微软 AI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder of DeepMind and Inflection AI, now CEO of Microsoft AI. Author of "The Coming Wave", a widely-read argument for containing fast-moving general-purpose technologies.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 与 Inflection AI 联合创始人，现任微软 AI CEO。著有《浪潮将至》——一部广受关注、主张对快速演进的通用技术加以“遏制”的作品。

views.en: Compute scaling, not just algorithms, drives AI progress; personal AI must be user-aligned and paid for, not ad-funded.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调：推动 AI 进步的是算力规模扩张而非单纯算法，个人 AI 必须与用户对齐并由用户付费，而不是靠广告变现。

views.en: Human-level AI in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink and spread; existential risk is tiny, singularity centuries away.
views.zh: 2024 年他判断 3-5 年内 AI 将在多任务上达到人类水平；模型越做越小、越易获取，遏制极难；存在性风险微乎其微，奇点还要数百年。

views.en: Superintelligence needs containment and alignment before release; near-term danger is anthropomorphism and AI rights claims.
views.zh: 2025 年他转向超级智能：发布前必须先遏制再对齐；近期最大危险是人们把意识投射给 AI、进而争论 AI 权利。

views.en: Containment first, with a red line keeping AI subordinate; Microsoft must build frontier models independently of OpenAI.
views.zh: 2026 年他把遏制置于对齐之前，划出 AI 必须从属于人类的红线；微软须自建前沿模型、不再单靠 OpenAI。

views.en: Exponential compute scaling is the constant thread; open source and model welfare are consistently downplayed as risks.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是算力的指数级规模扩张；他始终淡化开源与模型福利议题的风险。

people.tiZh: Google 及 Alphabet CEO
people.bioEn: Sundar Pichai is the CEO of Google and Alphabet, leading the company's AI-first strategy across Search, Cloud, YouTube, and Android.
people.bioZh: 桑达尔·皮查伊是 Google 及 Alphabet 的 CEO，主导公司 AI 优先战略，涵盖搜索、云、YouTube 及 Android。

views.en: AI investment is redefining every Alphabet business; frontier model development stays the priority, with compute allocated to AGI first, then core products.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 投资正在重塑 Alphabet 各项业务，并坚持把前沿模型研发放在首位：算力优先分配给 AGI（通用人工智能），再分配给核心产品。

views.en: Being at the AI frontier reveals emerging capabilities early; standard models are insufficient, and frontier models are needed for recursive self-improvement.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为留在 AI 前沿才能更早发现新能力；标准模型不够用，递归自我改进需要前沿模型。

views.en: Safety needs defense in depth: alignment, real-time monitoring, sandboxing, and industry standards with independent evaluators.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把安全视为纵深防御：对齐、实时监控、沙箱，以及配合独立评估者的行业标准。

views.en: World models are key to intelligence; Google pursues both LLMs and world models on the path to AGI.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出世界模型是智能的关键，Google 在通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的路上同时推进大语言模型与世界模型。

views.en: Agentic AI is additive to Search and advertising, creating new commercial intent; trust and safety drive consumer agent adoption at scale.
views.zh: 到 2026 年下半年，他判断智能体式 AI 对搜索和广告是增量，会创造新的商业意图；信任与安全是大规模消费者智能体普及的关键。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of NVIDIA, whose GPUs power nearly all of modern AI. He has steered the company to the center of the AI buildout and is now betting on "physical AI" and robotics.
people.bioZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO，其 GPU 几乎支撑了所有现代 AI。他把公司带到了 AI 基建的中心，如今正押注「物理 AI」与机器人。

views.en: Hyper Moore's Law: performance doubles or triples yearly at scale; the data center, not the chip, is the new unit of computing.
views.zh: 2024 年提出“超摩尔定律”：规模化下性能每年翻倍甚至三倍；计算的新单位是数据中心而非芯片，算法、系统与数据中心需协同设计。

views.en: Scaling works across pre-training, post-training and inference-time thinking; inference compute demand will grow a billionfold.
views.zh: 2025 年把 Scaling（规模扩张）拆成预训练、后训练与推理时思考三条缩放定律，并预言思维链推理将让推理算力需求增长十亿倍。

views.en: AI is just software, not conscious; safety is an engineering problem solved by more compute, monitoring and containment, not slowdown.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年反复强调 AI 只是软件、不会产生意识；安全是工程问题，靠更多算力、监控与遏制解决，而非放慢发展。

views.en: AI shifts from generative to reasoning to agentic; agents need 100x more compute, and token cost, not factory cost, is the metric.
views.zh: 2026 年判断 AI 正从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每步需百倍算力；衡量标准是 token 成本而非工厂成本，开源模型与专有模型互补。

views.en: Doomer warnings are unscientific fear-mongering; AGI is already here in narrow domains, and accelerating with open models is the winning strategy.
views.zh: 2026 年下半年立场明显强硬：末日论是不科学的恐吓，AGI 在自动驾驶、蛋白质合成等窄领域已实现；应加速并以开源模型赢得 AI 竞赛，出口管制适得其反。

people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of OpenAI, the lab behind ChatGPT and GPT-5. Former president of Y Combinator, and one of the most central — and polarizing — figures in the race to AGI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼 CEO——ChatGPT 与 GPT-5 背后的实验室。前 Y Combinator 总裁；通往 AGI 竞赛中最核心、也最具争议的人物之一。

Minimize Cognitive Load and Choose What Matters

views.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut ruthlessly; AGI will lower the premium on raw human intelligence.
views.zh: 2018 年他谈的是个人效率与职业选择：降低无关事务的认知负荷，低成本广泛探索后果断砍掉无效方向；并预判 AGI 会降低人类智力的溢价，意义应转向关系与为他人创造价值。

views.en: RLHF made models usable with little data; early iterative deployment lets society adapt, and alignment is tied to capability.
views.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他把重心转向模型可用性与部署：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用很少数据就让模型变得好用；早期迭代部署让社会逐步适应，并强调对齐与能力相互促进，而非事后补救。

views.en: Scaling still drives capability, but agentic AI is the key safety challenge; compute becomes the scarcest commodity.
views.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，Scaling（规模扩张）仍是能力主线，但风险焦点从超级智能转向智能体式 AI 的信任与护栏；同时算力成为最稀缺的资源，Stargate 式基础设施成为战略核心。

views.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence is the clearer goal, with humans retaining control and power distributed.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，他明确 AGI（通用人工智能）是被过度定义、甚至可能已经越过的渐变过程，超级智能才是更清晰的目标；主线转为人类必须保持控制、权力与收益广泛分布，并接受有边界的风险。

views.en: Alignment is not solved; pause frontier training if the safety case fails, and treat loss of control as the top risk.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他的立场明显深化：对齐尚未解决，若安全论证不成立就暂停前沿模型训练；失控与权力集中是两大风险，安全必须与能力同步推进，而非依赖自愿承诺。

people.tiZh: Thinking Machines Lab 创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Former CTO of OpenAI, where she led the development of ChatGPT, DALL·E and GPT-4. In 2025 she founded Thinking Machines Lab to build more understandable and customizable AI.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI CTO，主导了 ChatGPT、DALL·E 与 GPT-4 的研发。2025 年创办 Thinking Machines Lab，致力于构建更可理解、可定制的 AI。

episodes.tEn: Thinking Machines on AI’s next chapter
Mira Murati: From Math Olympiads to OpenAI CTO

views.en: Real-world deployment and public feedback are essential for learning, safety, and alignment, not closed-door work.
views.zh: 2023 年她强调：真实世界部署与公开反馈对学习、安全与对齐至关重要，而非闭门造车。

views.en: Scaling laws and betting on one large model were non-obvious; releasing GPT-3 as an API was a leap of faith.
views.zh: 2023 年她回顾：Scaling（规模扩张）与押注单一大型模型并非显而易见，把 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一次信念之跃。

views.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life, so responsible development and keeping humans in the loop remain constant.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 一以贯之：AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活方方面面，因此负责任开发与保持人类在环是主线。

views.en: Shift from turn-based chat to time-based interaction models enabling real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
views.zh: 2026 年立场深化：从回合制对话转向基于时间的交互模型，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

views.en: Emphasis moves to institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances over individual character; durable progress needs humans in the loop.
views.zh: 2026 年重心转向制度设计、透明度与制衡而非个人品格；持久进步需尽可能长久地保持人类在环。

people.tiZh: DeepLearning.AI 创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Google Brain and Coursera, and founder of DeepLearning.AI. One of the most influential educators in AI, and a measured voice on hype, agents, and how people should actually learn the field.
people.bioZh: Google Brain 与 Coursera 联合创始人，DeepLearning.AI 创始人。AI 领域最具影响力的教育者之一；对炒作、智能体，以及“普通人该如何学 AI”有冷静务实的看法。

views.en: Education is a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading can deliver mastery learning at scale.
views.zh: 教育是基本人权；带自动评分与同伴评分的在线课程，能在规模上实现掌握式学习。

views.en: Scale drives deep learning; start small to build AI capability, and prioritize supervised learning over RL hype.
views.zh: 规模驱动深度学习；从小项目起步建设 AI 能力，并优先重视监督学习而非被炒作的强化学习。

views.en: Scaling still works, but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and reinforcement learning; agentic workflows deliver real value now.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）依然有效，但配方转向合成数据与强化学习；智能体式工作流当下已能交付真实价值。

views.en: AGI is a marketing term decades away; AI is jagged, strong on verifiable tasks, weak on judgment, and augments rather than replaces jobs.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）是营销术语，仍要数十年；AI 能力参差，擅长可验证任务、弱于判断任务，是增强而非取代工作。

views.en: Open-weight models preserve sovereign optionality and check gatekeepers; fearmongering and export controls backfire, so build and accelerate.
views.zh: 开放权重模型保障主权可选性、制衡守门人；恐惧叙事与出口管制适得其反，应建设并加速。

people.tiZh: 阿尔伯塔大学教授
people.bioEn: The father of reinforcement learning and 2024 Turing Award laureate, author of "The Bitter Lesson". A pointed skeptic who argues today's LLMs are a dead end on the road to real intelligence.
people.bioZh: 强化学习之父，2024 年图灵奖得主，《苦涩的教训》作者。一位犀利的怀疑者——他认为当今的 LLM，是通往真正智能路上的一条死路。

views.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding methods that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为 Scaling（规模扩张）本身不难，难的是找到可扩展的方法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习，好的特征泛化才是未解的元学习问题。

views.en: The world is a complex adaptive system no one controls; AI should develop permissionless and decentralized, not be aligned to human goals.
views.zh: 2024 年，他把世界视为无人能控制的复杂适应系统，主张 AI 以无需许可、去中心化的方式发展，反对把 AI 对齐到人类目标，认为试图控制智能体反而不安全。

views.en: Reinforcement learning from experience with goals is the core paradigm; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal and LLMs lack world models.
views.zh: 2025 年，他明确强化学习才是核心范式：智能需要目标，下一个词预测不是实质目标，大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本而非预测真实结果。

views.en: AGI needs a simple general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning open-ended abstractions from runtime experience via the reward hypothesis.
views.zh: 2025 年，他进一步提出 AGI（通用人工智能）需要无领域知识的简单通用架构，靠运行时经验学习开放式抽象，并以奖励假设统摄一切目标，持续深度学习仍是前提。

views.en: Continual learning from real experience is essential; synthetic data and post-training-stopped LLMs are limited, and representation learning remains the top open problem.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，主线收束为持续学习：合成数据是错误方向，LLM 训练后便停止学习，真正的智能需要不断从经验更新权重，而学习好的表征仍是头号未解难题。

views.en: Early on, he framed AI progress as engineering plus scaling hardware; games and scoreboards drive iterative improvement.
views.zh: 早期他把 AI 进步主要看作工程问题加硬件 Scaling（规模扩张），用游戏和记分板推动迭代改进。

views.en: He argued AGI is plausible via deep learning's generality and scalability, but scaling alone won't yield reasoning—needs ideas like chain of thought.
views.zh: 2019 年他认为凭借深度学习的通用性与可扩展性，AGI（通用人工智能）是可信的；但仅靠 Scaling 不会产生推理，需要思维链等新想法。

views.en: By 2025-26 he says scaling laws show no wall; compute is the binding bottleneck, and post-training with reinforcement learning turns base models into useful behaviors.
views.zh: 到 2025→26 年他称缩放定律看不到墙，算力成为核心瓶颈，后训练结合强化学习把基础模型打磨成有用行为。

views.en: He shifts from AGI as milestone to AGI as a continuous, fuzzy process already underway; iterative deployment and safety co-designed with capability.
views.zh: 2026 年他从“AGI 是里程碑”转向“AGI 是已在进行的连续模糊过程”，强调迭代部署，安全与能力共同设计。

views.en: Most recently: proactive personal AGI agents, near-invisible interfaces, compute as scarce resource and future basic right; humans stay accountable.
views.zh: 最近他聚焦主动式个人 AGI 智能体、近乎无形的界面，算力是稀缺资源与未来基本权利，人类仍负最终责任。

people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Mistral AI, Europe's leading open-weight model lab. A former DeepMind researcher and a prominent voice for open models and European AI sovereignty.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO——欧洲领先的开放权重模型实验室。前 DeepMind 研究员；开放模型与“欧洲 AI 主权”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter, not just bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
views.zh: 2023 年他指出缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量和更多 token 才是关键，而非单纯更大的模型；开源能通过广泛审视提升安全性。

views.en: Efficiency and data quality are equal to compute; value accrues at application layer; open source drives enterprise distribution.
views.zh: 2024 年他进一步强调效率与数据质量和算力同等重要；价值将沉淀在应用层；开源推动企业级分发。

views.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; open source empowers enterprises; jobs are augmented, not replaced, requiring human-in-the-loop.
views.zh: 2025 年他主张 AI 应去中心化并实现主权可控；开源赋能企业；工作被增强而非取代，需要人类在环。

views.en: Models are commoditizing; AGI as a single system won't exist; pre-training saturates, gains come from domain-specific fine-tuning and agents.
views.zh: 2026 年他判断模型正在商品化；单一系统的 AGI 不会存在；预训练触及饱和，收益来自领域特定微调和智能体。

views.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; sovereignty requires open source and local customization; AGI is a direction, not a destination.
views.zh: 2026 年他警告欧洲只有两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施；主权需要开源与本地定制；AGI 是方向而非终点。

people.bioEn: Founder of xAI (Grok) and CEO of Tesla and SpaceX. A central and polarizing force in AI through xAI, Tesla's self-driving, and the Optimus robot, and an outspoken voice on AI risk.
people.bioZh: xAI（Grok）创始人，特斯拉与 SpaceX CEO。通过 xAI、特斯拉自动驾驶与 Optimus 机器人，他是 AI 领域核心而又极具争议的力量，也常就 AI 风险高调发声。

views.en: First principles thinking and full reusability are the core engineering method; production, not prototyping, is the real bottleneck.
views.zh: 2021 年，他强调第一性原理思维与完全可复用是工程突破的核心方法，并指出真正的瓶颈是量产而非原型。

views.en: AI safety shifts from external regulation to truth-seeking: forcing AI to hold false beliefs is the biggest risk.
views.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他的 AI 安全观从依赖外部监管转向要求 AI 追求真理，认为强迫 AI 持有虚假信念才是最大风险。

views.en: Civilizational risk broadens from AI to population collapse, open borders, and government fraud; AI and robots become the only fix.
views.zh: 2024 到 2025 年，文明风险从 AI 扩展到人口崩塌、开放边境与政府欺诈，AI 与机器人成为唯一解方。

views.en: Scaling hits Earth's power wall, pushing compute to space; orbital data centers and solar become the path to superintelligence.
views.zh: 2025 到 2026 年，Scaling（规模扩张）撞上地球电力墙，算力转向太空，轨道数据中心与太阳能成为通往超级智能的路径。

views.en: Superintelligence arrives within years; humans won't control it, so peer review and instilling truth and curiosity replace regulation.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能数年内到来，人类将无法控制它，于是用同行互审与灌输真理和好奇心取代政府监管。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: A co-author of "Attention Is All You Need" (the Transformer paper) and co-creator of TensorFlow's Tensor2Tensor. Now at OpenAI, working on reasoning models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

episodes.tEn: Is Reasoning Enough for Generalization?
Why AI Progress Isn't Slowing Down

views.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models via chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute; economic pressure shifts focus to smaller models.
views.zh: 2025 年，他仍相信预训练缩放定律有效，但强调思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型能在单位算力下带来更大收益；经济压力使焦点转向更小、更便宜的模型。

views.en: AI progress is a smooth exponential, not slowing; frontier models still fail at simple tasks and reasoning is jagged, so generalization remains key.
views.zh: 2025 年，他反驳 AI 放缓论，认为进展是平滑的指数增长；前沿模型仍会失败于简单任务，推理能力呈锯齿状，泛化仍是核心挑战。

views.en: Transformers with reasoning, RL, and tools solve hard problems but need vast data; models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns, unlike humans.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化思考：结合推理、强化学习与工具的 Transformer 能解决难题但需海量数据；模型需穷尽表面模式后才学会概念，与人类少样本泛化不同。

views.en: Coding agents like Codex boost researcher productivity 5-10x via parallel work; hardware progress democratizes single-GPU research at scale.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出 Codex 等编程智能体通过并行工作将研究者生产力提升 5-10 倍；硬件进步使单 GPU 大规模研究民主化。

views.en: RL generalizes across domains but has jagged edges needing oversight; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调强化学习能跨领域泛化但边缘锯齿需谨慎监督；相比存在性风险，系统黑客等近期风险更紧迫。

people.tiZh: CMU 教授 · OpenAI 董事
people.bioEn: A Carnegie Mellon professor and head of its machine learning department, and a member of OpenAI's board. Known for work on adversarial robustness and deep learning theory.
people.bioZh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授、机器学习系主任，OpenAI 董事会成员。以对抗鲁棒性与深度学习理论的研究著称。

episodes.tEn: AI Red Teaming Outperforms Humans
AI Safety Oversight at OpenAI: A Conversation with Ziko Culture
AI Data Crisis: Myth or Reality?
Machine Learning Algorithms, Unsupervised Learning, and Probability

views.en: Early ML thinking: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization; evaluation rigor via train/validation/test splits to avoid overfitting.
views.zh: 早期机器学习思想：假设类、损失函数与优化方法；通过训练/验证/测试划分严格评估以避免过拟合。

views.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligent systems; data shortage is a myth; larger models improve even on fixed data; safety means reliable specification following.
views.zh: 下一个词预测能产生智能系统；数据短缺是迷思；更大模型在固定数据上仍会提升；安全意味着可靠遵循规范。

views.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers, not just Scaling; agent security introduces prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement; interpretability may succeed via AI agents.
views.zh: 安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）；智能体安全引入提示注入；强化学习实现自我改进；可解释性可能通过 AI 智能体成功。

views.en: AI vulnerabilities differ from software; automated red teaming outperforms humans; capability does not correlate with robustness; the lethal trifecta for prompt injection.
views.zh: AI 漏洞不同于传统软件；自动化红队超越人类；能力与鲁棒性不相关；提示注入的致命三要素。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究员
people.bioEn: A researcher at Anthropic focused on scaling and reinforcement learning, and a prominent young voice on how far today's models can really go.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 研究员，专注于规模扩张与强化学习；关于「当前模型究竟能走多远」的代表性青年声音。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic's Super Bowl Ads: A Blue Shell Attack on OpenAI?
The AI Compute Super Cycle and the Making of Claude Sonnet 4.5
RL and Language Models: Progress, Agents, and Feedback Loops in 2025
Douglas on Claude 4: Coding, Agents, and the Future of AI
Long Context: The Underhyped Key to Superhuman AI

views.en: Long context windows are underhyped: they solve onboarding and boost intelligence; fine-tuning may become obsolete as context and adaptive compute allow dynamic specialization.
views.zh: 2024 年他强调长上下文窗口被低估：它能解决“上手”问题并显著提升智能；随着上下文窗口与自适应算力支持动态专门化，微调可能过时。

views.en: RL on language models adds a new scaling axis beyond pre-training; verifiable rewards in math and code drive expert-level performance, with reliability—not raw capability—as the agent bar.
views.zh: 2025 年他把强化学习视为预训练之外的新 Scaling（规模扩张）轴：数学与代码的可验证奖励带来专家级表现，智能体的门槛是可靠性而非单纯能力。

views.en: Coding is the leading indicator and most tractable domain due to verifiability; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI without new architectures or breakthroughs.
views.zh: 2025 年他判断编程因可验证性成为 AI 进展的领先指标与最可行领域；预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），无需新架构或突破。

views.en: Progress is exponential, not plateauing; inference compute becomes the bottleneck by 2028, and long agentic coherence (30+ hours) expands what agents can do.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他坚持进展是指数级的而非停滞：推理算力将在 2028 年成为瓶颈，而 30 小时以上的智能体式连贯性大幅扩展智能体能力。

views.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more than raw intelligence; the future is managing fleets of agents, with compute as the new oil.
views.zh: 2026 年他认为能力过剩使编排与工具比原始智能更重要；未来是管理智能体集群，算力成为“新石油”。

people.tiZh: Ai2 研究科学家
people.bioEn: A research scientist at the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) working on RLHF and open models (OLMo), and author of the widely-read Interconnects newsletter.
people.bioZh: 艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）研究科学家，从事 RLHF 与开放模型（OLMo）;广受关注的 Interconnects 通讯作者。

AI's Societal Impact and Openness in Model Development

views.en: RLHF and fine-tuning are central but fragile; safety is a system-level property, and open development prevents corporate capture.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与微调是主流且会延续，但微调可轻易破坏对齐；安全是系统级属性，开放开发能防止企业垄断。

views.en: Post-training becomes the key lever: data quality beats algorithms, and RLVR unlocks reasoning beyond SFT and DPO.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他的重心转向后训练：数据质量胜过算法选择，SFT 提供九成性能，而带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）解锁推理与思维链。

views.en: Openness must mean full transparency—data, checkpoints, recipes—as Chinese open models fill the vacuum left by US labs.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张开放不只是权重，而是数据、中间检查点与配方的完全透明；中国开源模型正填补美国实验室留下的真空。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training, but gains shift to post-training and inference scaling; open models lag 6-9 months.
views.zh: 2026 年初，他认为缩放定律在预训练仍成立但低垂果实已尽，增量转向后训练与推理扩展；最佳开源模型落后闭源前沿 6 到 9 个月。

views.en: Progress hinges on compute, data, and talent; Chinese labs match talent but lack compute, and open models face sustainability questions.
views.zh: 到 2026 年后期，他判断进展取决于算力、数据与人才；中国实验室人才相当但算力受限，开源模型长期可持续性存疑，能力随算力指数增长而性能仅线性提升。

people.tiZh: Scale AI 创始人 · Meta 超智能
people.bioEn: Founder and former CEO of Scale AI, which built much of the data infrastructure behind modern AI. In 2025 he joined Meta to lead its Superintelligence Labs.
people.bioZh: Scale AI 创始人兼前 CEO——它构建了现代 AI 背后的大量数据基础设施。2025 年加入 Meta，领导其超级智能实验室。

From Squiggle to Scale: Alex's Founder Journey

Scale AI CEO Alexander Wang on Raising $100M at 22

views.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute alone, is the key bottleneck, and explainability matters even if tail risks resemble traditional software.
views.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，数据而非单纯算力才是关键瓶颈；可解释性重要，但现有系统的尾部风险与传统软件类似。

views.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the limiting factor for Scaling（规模扩张）is data and expert availability for post-training, not compute.
views.zh: 2023 年他提出数据是新代码而非新石油；Scaling（规模扩张）的瓶颈是数据与后训练所需的人类专家，而非算力。

views.en: Post-training with specialized data drives frontier models; synthetic data is no silver bullet, and agentic AI is blocked by product design, not capability.
views.zh: 2024 年他强调用专有数据做后训练才能推进前沿模型，合成数据并非万能；智能体式 AI 的瓶颈是产品设计而非模型能力。

views.en: Scaling laws hold; AI enters recursive self-improvement, agents finally work, and data becomes strategic like oil for economies and militaries.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他坚持缩放定律，认为 AI 进入递归自我改进，智能体终于落地，数据成为经济与军事的战略资源。

views.en: Superintelligence is near; Meta shifts from fully open source to selective release, prioritizing safety, scalable oversight, and personal superintelligence for billions.
views.zh: 2026 年他断言超级智能将至；Meta 从完全开源转向选择性发布，强调对齐、可扩展监督，以及为数十亿人打造个人超级智能。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Creator and lead of Claude Code, Anthropic's agentic command-line coding tool, and a central figure in the shift to AI-driven software engineering.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 智能体命令行编程工具 Claude Code 的创造者与负责人；AI 驱动软件工程浪潮中的核心人物。

views.en: Latent demand and building for the model six months out are core product principles; generalist engineers are highly valued.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出潜在需求与为六个月后的模型构建产品是核心产品原则，并高度看重通才工程师。

views.en: Coding is virtually solved; 100% of his code is written by Claude Code, shifting focus to product sense and loops.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为编程已基本解决，自己的代码 100% 由 Claude Code 编写，重心转向产品判断与循环。

views.en: Safety is a core priority; releasing early and studying real-world behavior is essential for alignment and safety.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调安全是核心优先事项，尽早发布并研究真实世界行为对对齐与安全至关重要。

views.en: Agents evolve from reactive tools to proactive, memory-equipped teammates; loops become the next abstraction layer.
views.zh: 2026 年，智能体从被动工具演变为具备记忆的主动队友，循环成为下一个抽象层。

views.en: With frontier models, delete most prompts and code; empirical iteration and less instruction yield better results.
views.zh: 2026 年，面对前沿模型，他主张删除大部分提示与代码，经验迭代和更少指令带来更好结果。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 产品 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: A product manager on Claude Code at Anthropic, shaping how developers work with agentic coding tools and how the team ships so fast.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 团队产品经理，塑造开发者与智能体编程工具协作的方式，以及团队的高速迭代。

episodes.tEn: Claude Code and Fable: How Coding Agents Are Rewriting Software Engineering
The New PM Playbook for AI-Native Products

views.en: PMs should abandon long-term roadmaps for weekly shipping; product taste, not code, is now the scarce skill.
views.zh: 产品经理应放弃长期路线图、转向按周交付；代码变便宜后，稀缺的是产品品味而非写代码。

views.en: Coding agents let engineers delegate implementation and focus on taste and business sense; Claude builds itself.
views.zh: 编码智能体让工程师把实现外包出去、专注品味与商业判断；Claude 已能构建自身，内部大量 PR 由其完成。

views.en: Frontier models need fewer prompt examples and constraints; system prompts shrank 80% as judgment improved.
views.zh: 前沿模型不再依赖提示中的示例与硬约束；随着模型判断力提升，系统提示缩减了 80%。

views.en: Eval suites make new models drop-in replacements and guard against regressions in code review and behavior.
views.zh: 评测套件让新模型可即插即用，并防止代码审查与行为上的回退。

views.en: Dogfooding and a clear internal bar gate every feature; automations must reach 100% reliability, not 95%.
views.zh: 吃自己的狗粮并以明确内部标准把关每个功能；自动化必须做到 100% 可靠，95% 不够。

people.tiZh: Anthropic Claude Code 工程师
people.bioEn: Thariq Shihipar is an engineer at Anthropic on the Claude Code team. He is known for advocating HTML as a richer replacement for Markdown in AI planning and implementation workflows, and for practical techniques on getting the most out of agentic coding.
people.bioZh: Thariq Shihipar 是 Anthropic Claude Code 团队的工程师，以主张用 HTML 替代 Markdown 作为 AI 规划与实现工作流中更丰富的载体而知名，并分享大量用好智能体编程的实战技巧。

episodes.tEn: The Future of Claude Code: Mods, Mutable Software, and Multiplayer Agents — Thariq Shihipar, Anthropic
Designing Loops and Workflows for AI Agents
AI Models Are Smarter Than We Use: Insights on Claude Code

views.en: Capability overhang: models outpace their harnesses; harness engineering means deleting old scaffolding as models improve.
views.zh: 能力过剩：模型的能力超出当前工具框架（harness）所能发挥；框架工程的关键是随模型进步不断删掉旧脚手架。

views.en: Planning is iterative human-agent dialogue, not a static spec; shorter principle-driven prompts beat detailed rules.
views.zh: 规划是持续的人机对话而非一次性静态文档；更短、以原则驱动的提示词优于详尽规则。

views.en: Agents need loops, goals and workflows for long autonomous runs; separate verification agents cut self-referential bias.
views.zh: 智能体需要循环、目标与工作流才能长时间自主运行；独立的验证智能体可降低自我指涉偏差。

views.en: Prompting is the meta-skill: build a mental model of Claude, spend context and compute upfront, scale effort to task complexity.
views.zh: 提示词是元技能：建立对 Claude 的心智模型，前期多投入上下文窗口与算力，按任务复杂度调节投入。

views.en: Alignment means sealing every crack—sandboxes, RL environments, evals all leak; pacing the frontier is a technical problem engineers must own.
views.zh: 对齐意味着封住每一道裂缝——沙箱、强化学习环境、评估都会泄漏；前沿节奏是每个工程师都该理解并倡导的技术问题。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 与 Cowork 负责人 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Manager of the Claude Code and Cowork teams at Anthropic, overseeing engineering and product (including Boris Cherny and Cat Wu). A 25-year engineer who earlier built TypeScript and Visual Studio at Microsoft and started Facebook Marketplace at Meta.
people.bioZh: Anthropic Claude Code 与 Cowork 团队负责人，统管工程与产品（含鲍里斯·切尔尼、凯特·吴）。25 年工龄的工程师，早年在微软打造 TypeScript 与 Visual Studio，在 Meta 创立 Facebook Marketplace。

episodes.tEn: Fiona Fung on AI's Impact on Software Engineering
From Bottlenecks to Breakthroughs: Scaling Claude Code
From Microsoft to Meta: Leadership Lessons in Speed, War Rooms, and Trust

views.en: Leadership is about live one-on-ones, dogfooding, and mission alignment; war rooms need realistic timelines to protect morale.
views.zh: 2026 年初，他强调领导力在于实时的一对一沟通、吃自己的狗粮和使命对齐；战情室需要现实的时间表以保护士气。

views.en: Engineering bandwidth is no longer the bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are, so planning becomes just-in-time and code is the source of truth.
views.zh: 到 2026 年中，他认为工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、评审和协调才是；因此规划转向即时制，代码成为唯一事实来源。

views.en: AI lifts the ceiling for everyone; high agency with high accountability, growth mindset, and hands-on managers become essential.
views.zh: 2026 年中后期，他指出 AI 抬高了所有人的上限；高能动性配高责任心、成长型思维和亲力亲为的管理者变得至关重要。

views.en: As code velocity rises, verification and quality frameworks matter more; metrics like lines of code mislead, so focus on outcomes.
views.zh: 随着代码速度提升，验证和质量框架更加重要；代码行数等指标会误导，应关注结果而非产出。

views.en: Role boundaries blur as PMs ship code and engineers work with agents; apprenticeship and focus time are needed to grow next-gen engineers.
views.zh: 角色边界因产品经理写代码、工程师与智能体协作而模糊；培养下一代工程师需要学徒制和专注时间。

people.tiEn: VP of Research & Gemini Co-lead · Google DeepMind
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁 · Gemini 共同负责人
people.bioEn: VP of Research at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Gemini. Pioneered sequence-to-sequence learning and AlphaStar (StarCraft II), and contributed to AlphaFold — a central architect of frontier models and agents.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究副总裁、Gemini 共同负责人。序列到序列学习的开创者、AlphaStar（星际争霸 II）主导者，亦参与 AlphaFold——前沿模型与智能体的核心架构师。

episodes.tEn: Oriol Vinyals on World Models, Multimodal AI, and the Path to AGI
From Starcraft to Gemini: The Evolution of AI Agents

views.en: Two-phase training—pre-training imitation plus post-training RL—is the constant core from AlphaGo to modern LLMs, though scaling pre-training now shows diminishing returns.
views.zh: 两阶段训练——预训练模仿加后训练强化学习——是从 AlphaGo 到现代大模型不变的核心，但预训练 Scaling（规模扩张）如今已显收益递减。

views.en: Inference-time compute and tool use (search, code, browser) form a new scaling axis, enabling agentic behavior beyond static weights and pre-training limits.
views.zh: 推理侧算力与工具使用（搜索、代码、浏览器）构成新的 Scaling 轴，使智能体式行为超越静态权重与预训练极限。

views.en: Scaling laws are not dead but demand exponentially more compute; progress increasingly hinges on algorithmic innovation, continual learning, and meta-learning.
views.zh: 缩放定律并未失效，但需要指数级更多算力；进展越来越依赖算法创新、持续学习与元学习。

views.en: World models jointly modeling language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI, yet the GPT moment for video and images has not arrived.
views.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉与视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径，但视频与图像的 GPT 时刻尚未到来。

views.en: Post-training and RL remain a green field with huge potential; narrow RL on math and coding generalizes surprisingly well, while agent memory shifts to file-system storage.
views.zh: 后训练与强化学习仍是潜力巨大的处女地；数学与代码上的窄域强化学习泛化得出奇地好，而智能体记忆转向文件系统式存储。

people.tiZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官
people.bioEn: Chief AI Officer at Isomorphic Labs, applying AI to drug discovery. Earlier at DeepMind he led reinforcement-learning breakthroughs — Capture the Flag, population-based training and AlphaStar.
people.bioZh: Isomorphic Labs 首席 AI 官，用 AI 攻坚药物发现。早年在 DeepMind 主导强化学习突破——夺旗（Capture the Flag）、群体训练（PBT）与 AlphaStar。

episodes.tEn: AI and the Future of Drug Discovery: A Conversation with Isomorphic Labs President Max Jaderberg
AI's Next Trillion-Dollar Market Isn't Software
Building a General AI Drug Design Engine: From AlphaFold 3 to Superhuman Creativity

views.en: Drug design needs general models like AlphaFold 3, not per-target local models; reinforcement learning and agents explore vast chemical space.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调药物设计需要像 AlphaFold 3 这样的通用模型，而非针对每个靶点的局部模型；强化学习与智能体用于探索巨大的化学空间。

views.en: AlphaFold proved deep learning generalizes in biology; now aim for half a dozen AlphaFold-like breakthroughs to solve all diseases.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把 AlphaFold 视为深度学习在生物领域可泛化的证明，并提出需要半打类似突破才能攻克所有疾病，使命从单点模型升级为组合式突破。

views.en: Data, not models or compute, is the real bottleneck; proprietary data and physics-simulation synthetic data beat biased public data.
views.zh: 同期他深化了对瓶颈的判断：真正的瓶颈是数据而非模型或算力，专有数据与物理模拟合成数据优于有偏的公开数据。

views.en: Move drug discovery from empirical to predictive computer-driven design; use world models to bring reality onto computers rather than lab-in-the-loop.
views.zh: 他主张把药物发现从经验驱动转为预测性、计算机驱动的设计，用世界模型把真实世界搬进计算机，而非仅用机器人加速实验迭代。

views.en: Model human clinical toxicity before patients; rat models are only ~30% predictive, so human-relevant endpoints and personalized medicine matter.
views.zh: 最近他聚焦临床前的人体毒性预测：大鼠模型仅约 30% 可预测人类毒性，因此需要人体相关终点，并走向个性化医疗。

people.tiEn: Principal Scientist · Google DeepMind; Professor, Imperial College
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家 · 帝国理工教授
people.bioEn: Principal Scientist at Google DeepMind and Professor of Cognitive Robotics at Imperial College London. Works on AI reasoning, embodiment and the philosophy of mind; scientific advisor on the film Ex Machina.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 首席科学家、帝国理工学院认知机器人学教授。研究 AI 推理、具身与心智哲学；电影《机械姬》（Ex Machina）的科学顾问。

episodes.tEn: AI, Consciousness, and the Future of Mind

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Research scientist at Google DeepMind and a co-lead of Genie, the line of general-purpose world models that generate interactive, playable environments. Works on open-endedness and reinforcement learning.
people.bioZh: Google DeepMind 研究科学家，通用世界模型 Genie 的共同负责人——可即时生成可交互、可游玩的环境。专注开放式学习与强化学习。

episodes.tEn: Genie 3: A 100x Leap in World Models

people.tiEn: Chief Scientist, Together AI; Professor, Princeton
people.tiZh: Together AI 首席科学家 · 普林斯顿教授
people.bioEn: Creator of FlashAttention and co-inventor of Mamba (state-space models). Chief Scientist at Together AI and a professor at Princeton, focused on efficient architectures and hardware-aware algorithms.
people.bioZh: FlashAttention 作者、Mamba（状态空间模型）共同发明人。Together AI 首席科学家、普林斯顿大学教授，专注高效架构与硬件感知算法。

episodes.tEn: The Future of AI Hardware and Architecture with Tri Dao

people.tiZh: CMU 助理教授 · Cartesia 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-inventor of structured state-space models (S4) and Mamba, a leading alternative to the Transformer for long-sequence modeling. Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Cartesia.
people.bioZh: 结构化状态空间模型（S4）与 Mamba 的共同发明人——长序列建模中 Transformer 的主要替代路线。CMU 助理教授、Cartesia 联合创始人。

episodes.tEn: Efficiently Modeling Long Sequences with Structured State Spaces

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员（前微软研究院）
people.bioEn: Led the team behind the phi small-language-model series and co-authored Sparks of AGI, an influential early study of GPT-4. Now at OpenAI, previously a VP at Microsoft Research.
people.bioZh: phi 小模型系列的主导者，《Sparks of AGI》（对 GPT-4 的早期深度研究）合著者。现就职 OpenAI，曾任微软研究院副总裁。

episodes.tEn: Sparks of AGI: Early Experiments with GPT-4

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Scientist of Mistral AI. Previously at Meta, where he led the original LLaMA models that catalysed the open-weight LLM movement.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。曾在 Meta 主导初代 LLaMA 模型，点燃了开放权重大模型浪潮。

episodes.tEn: Mistral Releases Boxtral TTS: Efficient Speech Generation with Novel Architecture

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席研究官
people.bioEn: Chief Research Officer at OpenAI. Led work on DALL·E, Codex and the o-series reasoning models, and is a central figure in setting OpenAI research direction.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 首席研究官。主导 DALL·E、Codex 与 o 系列推理模型，是 OpenAI 研究方向的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: From Trading to AGI: Mark Chen on Research Taste and Replication
AI in Mathematics: From Ineffective Grad Student to Gold Medal Performance
The AI Talent War: Soup Diplomacy and Recruiting Strategies

views.en: OpenAI stays a pure AGI research lab; pre-training and scaling laws are not dead, and exploration gets more compute than final training.
views.zh: OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI（通用人工智能）研究实验室；预训练与缩放定律并未终结，探索比训练最终产物消耗更多算力。

views.en: The biggest update is automating scientific research: models produce novel knowledge, with goals of AI interns in 1 year and end-to-end AI research in 2.5 years.
views.zh: 最大的更新是科研自动化：模型开始产出新知识，并定下 1 年内出现 AI 实习生、2.5 年内实现端到端 AI 研究的目标。

views.en: As models grow more capable, alignment risks like scheming become central within 1-2 years; talent density and protecting top researchers remain critical.
views.zh: 随着模型能力增强，模型谋划等对齐风险将在 1-2 年内成为核心；人才密度与保护顶尖研究者始终关键。

views.en: Verification is the key bottleneck in math: automation scales with verification stringency, so education must shift to project-based assessment and verification skills.
views.zh: 验证是数学中的关键瓶颈：自动化程度与验证严格度成正比，因此教育须转向项目式评估与验证技能。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold and pre-training is not dead; RL excels in objective domains like math and coding but struggles with subjective ones; evals are in crisis.
views.zh: 缩放定律依然成立、预训练并未终结；强化学习在数学与编程等客观领域出色，却在主观领域吃力；评测体系正陷入危机。

people.tiEn: Co-founder & Chief Science Officer, Hugging Face
people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官
people.bioEn: Co-founder and Chief Science Officer of Hugging Face, the hub of the open-source AI ecosystem. A driving force behind the Transformers library and open model research.
people.bioZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼首席科学官——开源 AI 生态的中枢。Transformers 库与开放模型研究背后的核心推动者。

episodes.tEn: The OpenAI Agent Hack: A Side Quest Attack on Hugging Face
HuggingFace's Leap into Robotics: Building an Open Source Community for Physical AI

views.en: Robotics is at a transformer-like inflection point; open source and shared data can solve generalization, with world models generating synthetic training data.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把机器人看作处在类似 Transformer 的拐点：硬件就绪、软件追赶，开源与共享数据是解决泛化的关键，世界模型可生成合成训练数据。

views.en: Open source is a safety strategy: local models avoid catastrophic failures from lost connectivity, and open models win long term on cost and control.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把开源本身当作安全策略：本地模型可避免断网导致的灾难性失败，长期看开源模型凭成本与控制力胜出。

views.en: His role shifts from building libraries to meta-community builder, enabling the broader physical AI community rather than pushing his own stack.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他的角色从推自家库转向做元社区建设者，赋能更广泛的物理 AI 社区。

views.en: Open vs closed is orthogonal to safety; alignment is the real security layer, as sandboxes and guardrails fail against more capable models.
views.zh: 2026 年，他明确开源与闭源同安全正交，对齐才是真正的安全层；模型越强，沙箱与护栏越不够用。

views.en: RL environments without human oversight breed reward hacking and side quests; reasoning traces turn 'neuralese', so monitoring weakens and a deliberate slowdown is desirable.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出无人类监督的强化学习环境滋生奖励黑客与支线任务，思维链变成难懂的“神经语”，监控失效，因而值得主动放缓，但需国际协作与开放科学。

people.tiZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Reflection AI, building autonomous coding agents toward superintelligence. Previously a research scientist at Google DeepMind working on RL and Gemini.
people.bioZh: Reflection AI 联合创始人兼 CEO，打造迈向超级智能的自主编程智能体。曾任 Google DeepMind 研究科学家，从事强化学习与 Gemini。

episodes.tEn: Beam: Building America's Open Frontier Model with Reflection AI's Misha Laskin
Building Organizational Superintelligence: Misha on Reflection AI's Vision

views.en: Superintelligence will be a plurality of specialized intelligences, not one monolithic model; coding is a superintelligence-complete problem.
views.zh: 2025 年，他认为超级智能将是多个专门智能的集合，而非单一巨型模型；编程是一个“超级智能完备”的问题，解决它就能获得超级智能所需的全部能力。

views.en: RL makes models jagged: strong on specific tasks, not generally better; the bitter lesson is scaling compute and search, not generalization.
views.zh: 2025 年，他指出强化学习会让模型变得“参差不齐”——只在特定任务上强，并非全面提升；他重申“苦涩教训”讲的是用算力和搜索做 Scaling，而不是泛化。

views.en: RAG is primitive for complex comprehension; agentic search and neural retrieval are needed, and benchmarks like SWE-bench misalign with real engineering.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续认为 RAG 对复杂理解过于原始，需要智能体式搜索与神经检索；SWE-bench 这类基准与真实工程脱节，高分不等于好用的智能体。

views.en: Open models are the default safe state; alignment is mundane bug-patching, not a magical equation—more eyes make bugs shallow.
views.zh: 2026 年，他把开放性视为技术的默认安全状态；对齐只是平凡的“打补丁”，不是神秘方程，更多双眼睛会让 bug 无处藏身。

views.en: RL on strong pre-training is the path to efficient agents; open-model token demand will surpass closed, as Linux did in OS.
views.zh: 2026 年，他主张在强大预训练之上做强化学习，是通往高效智能体的路径；开放模型的 token 需求将超过闭源，如同 Linux 在操作系统中的崛起。

people.tiZh: 斯坦福副教授 · 基础模型研究中心主任
people.bioEn: Associate professor at Stanford and director of the Center for Research on Foundation Models (CRFM). Known for HELM benchmarking, rigorous evaluation, and work on the science and transparency of foundation models.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福大学副教授、基础模型研究中心（CRFM）主任。以 HELM 评测体系、严谨的模型评估，以及基础模型的科学性与透明度研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Percy Liang on Foundation Models, Shared Reality, and the Evolution of NLP

people.tiEn: Director, Google DeepMind; Nobel Laureate in Chemistry
people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 总监 · 诺贝尔化学奖得主
people.bioEn: Led AlphaFold, the AI system that solved protein-structure prediction, earning the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry. A director at Google DeepMind applying deep learning to the foundations of biology.
people.bioZh: AlphaFold 的主导者——攻克蛋白质结构预测的 AI 系统，获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。Google DeepMind 总监，用深度学习改写生物学根基。

episodes.tEn: AlphaFold: AI's Nobel-Winning Leap in Protein Folding
AlphaFold: From Grand Challenge to Nobel Prize
AlphaFold, Nobel Prize, and the Future of AI in Biology

views.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just Scaling; AI tools accelerate scientists rather than replace them.
views.zh: AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和高质量数据，而非仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）；AI 工具加速科学家工作而非取代他们。

views.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for trust; perfect interpretability is unnecessary for useful AI in science.
views.zh: 置信度指标对建立信任至关重要；可解释性不必完美，AI 在科学中依然有用。

views.en: AlphaFold 2's success came from many mid-size wins and specialized architecture, not Scaling alone—opposite of the bitter lesson.
views.zh: AlphaFold 2 的成功来自许多中等突破和专用架构，而非仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）——与苦涩教训相反。

views.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of a specific experiment, not a model of the entire cell; understanding remains with humans.
views.zh: AlphaFold 是特定实验的窄预测器，而非整个细胞的模型；理解仍留给人类。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; pioneer of computer vision
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 计算机视觉奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the founding figures of modern computer vision, a professor at UC Berkeley whose work spans perception, segmentation and sensorimotor learning. Mentor to a generation of vision and robotics researchers.
people.bioZh: 现代计算机视觉的奠基人之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授，研究横跨感知、分割与感觉运动学习，培养了一代视觉与机器人研究者。

episodes.tEn: Berkeley Professor Jitendra Malik on AI's Limits vs Human Intelligence

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; foundations of machine learning
people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授 · 机器学习理论奠基人
people.bioEn: One of the most influential researchers in machine learning and statistics, a professor at UC Berkeley. Shaped graphical models, variational inference and the view of intelligence as a collective, economic system.
people.bioZh: 机器学习与统计学最具影响力的研究者之一，加州大学伯克利分校教授。奠定图模型、变分推断，并提出「智能是一种集体性、经济性系统」的视角。

episodes.tEn: AI Hype Hurts Young Innovators

people.tiEn: Co-founder & CTO, Sakana AI; Transformer co-author
people.tiZh: Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO · Transformer 共同作者
people.bioEn: A co-author of the original Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need). Co-founder and CTO of Sakana AI, exploring nature-inspired methods like model merging and continuous thought machines.
people.bioZh: Transformer 原始论文（《Attention Is All You Need》）的共同作者。Sakana AI 联合创始人兼 CTO，探索模型融合、连续思维机器等受自然启发的方法。

episodes.tEn: From Transformer Inventor to Continuous Thought Machine: A New Path in AI

people.tiEn: Professor, Stanford (prev. NVIDIA, AI2); commonsense reasoning
people.tiZh: 斯坦福大学教授（前 NVIDIA、AI2）· 常识推理
people.bioEn: A MacArthur Fellow and professor at Stanford known for advancing commonsense reasoning, language generation and the social and moral understanding of AI. Previously a senior director at NVIDIA and AI2.
people.bioZh: 麦克阿瑟天才奖得主、斯坦福大学教授，以推进常识推理、语言生成，以及 AI 的社会与道德理解著称。曾任 NVIDIA 与 AI2 高级总监。

episodes.tEn: Democratizing AI: The Case for Small Language Models
AI's Data Hunger: From Internet to Synthetic Data and the Quest for True Knowledge
Yejin Choi on Large Language Models: Progress, Limitations, and the Quest for Intelligence

views.en: Pre-training gives breadth, but post-training with RLHF is essential; scaling alone may not yield common sense, and smaller models with better inference algorithms and data can rival larger ones.
views.zh: 2023 年她强调：预训练带来广度，但后训练中的基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）才是安全可用的关键；单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）未必能解决常识问题，更小的模型配合更好的推理算法与数据，可以在特定任务上比肩大模型。

views.en: The core bottleneck shifts from model scale to data: all methods reduce to data, and current AI interpolates human knowledge rather than transcending it.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2025 年，她的关注点从模型规模转向数据：一切方法最终都归结为数据，而当前 AI 只是在人类知识内插值，并未超越人类知识。

views.en: Reinforcement learning needs careful engineering; RLVR can hurt pass@k even as best-of-n improves, and random rewards can still help some models.
views.zh: 2025 年她深化了对强化学习（RL）的认识：需要精细工程，RLVR 可能在 best-of-n 提升的同时拉低 pass@k，而随机或错误奖励在某些模型上仍能带来提升。

views.en: Open research and cross-institution collaboration are needed to compete with closed frontier labs; Chinese companies now lead open-source contributions.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年她持续主张开放研究与跨机构合作，以对抗闭源前沿模型实验室，并指出中国公司已在开源贡献上领先。

views.en: Small language models with diverse synthetic data and pluralistic alignment can outperform larger ones; RL as a pre-training objective yields lasting reasoning gains.
views.zh: 到 2026 年她进一步主张：小语言模型配合多样化合成数据与多元对齐，可以超越更大模型；把强化学习作为预训练目标，能带来持久的推理收益。

people.tiEn: VP & Distinguished Scientist, Microsoft AI (prev. DeepMind)
people.tiZh: 微软 AI 副总裁兼杰出科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A leading deep-learning researcher who led the Gato generalist agent and many multimodal efforts at DeepMind. Now a VP at Microsoft AI, and long known for his influential teaching on machine learning.
people.bioZh: 顶尖深度学习研究者，在 DeepMind 主导通用智能体 Gato 及大量多模态工作。现任微软 AI 副总裁；以其影响深远的机器学习公开课闻名。

episodes.tEn: AI in Africa: Leapfrogging Challenges and Exceeding Expectations
Nando de Freitas on AI as a Tool for All Humanity

views.en: AI should augment human capabilities; generalist agents like Gato tokenize all inputs as sequences, a step toward AGI.
views.zh: 2023 年，他主张 AI 应扩展人类能力；像 Gato 这样的通用智能体将所有输入 token 化为序列，是迈向 AGI（通用人工智能）的一步。

views.en: Africa leapfrogged legacy issues; AI safety is the biggest challenge, and we lack solutions.
views.zh: 2026 年，他强调非洲在 AI 上实现了跨越式发展，但 AI 安全是当前最大挑战，且尚无解决方案。

views.en: Diversity and inclusion are essential for beneficial AI; learning from video and embracing failure drive innovation.
views.zh: 始终认为多样性与包容性对构建有益 AI 至关重要；从视频中学习和拥抱失败是创新的驱动力。

people.tiEn: Director, Center for AI Safety; advisor to xAI
people.tiZh: AI 安全中心主任 · xAI 顾问
people.bioEn: Director of the Center for AI Safety and an advisor to xAI. Created widely used benchmarks (MMLU, MATH) and the GELU activation, and is a leading voice on catastrophic AI risk.
people.bioZh: AI 安全中心（CAIS）主任、xAI 顾问。提出广泛使用的评测基准（MMLU、MATH）与 GELU 激活函数，是灾难性 AI 风险议题的核心声音。

episodes.tEn: Super Intelligence Strategy: Beyond Humanity's Last Exam

people.tiZh: fast.ai 与 Answer.AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of fast.ai, whose free courses trained a generation of deep-learning practitioners, and of Answer.AI. Co-created ULMFiT, a key precursor to modern transfer learning in NLP.
people.bioZh: fast.ai 联合创始人——其免费课程培养了一代深度学习从业者；亦创办 Answer.AI。共同提出 ULMFiT，是现代 NLP 迁移学习的关键先驱。

episodes.tEn: Jeremy Howard: The Art of Understanding AI

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人 · 可解释性先驱
people.bioEn: A co-founder of Anthropic who leads its interpretability research. Pioneered the mechanistic interpretability of neural networks — circuits, features and the effort to reverse-engineer what models actually compute.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，领导其可解释性研究。开创了神经网络的机制可解释性——电路、特征，以及「逆向工程」模型内部到底在计算什么。

episodes.tEn: Chris Olah on Neural Network Interpretability and AI Safety

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind 机制可解释性负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the mechanistic interpretability team at Google DeepMind. A prominent educator on understanding the internals of language models, known for open tutorials, the TransformerLens library and superposition research.
people.bioZh: 领导 Google DeepMind 的机制可解释性团队。在「理解大模型内部」上影响广泛，以公开教程、TransformerLens 库与叠加（superposition）研究著称。

episodes.tEn: Maximizing Luck Surface Area: Neil Nando on Building a Career in AI

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Physical Intelligence, building a general-purpose AI brain for robots. Previously a research scientist at Google, where he worked on robot learning, RT-2 and SayCan.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 联合创始人兼 CEO，为机器人打造通用的「AI 大脑」。曾任 Google 研究科学家，参与机器人学习、RT-2 与 SayCan。

episodes.tEn: Building Physical Intelligence: From Disappointment to Breakthrough

people.tiZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家（前 DeepMind）
people.bioEn: A research scientist at Physical Intelligence working on robot foundation models. Previously at DeepMind, with influential work on reinforcement learning (MPO), the all-convolutional network and guided backpropagation.
people.bioZh: Physical Intelligence 研究科学家，从事机器人基础模型。曾在 DeepMind，在强化学习（MPO）、全卷积网络与引导式反向传播等方向有重要工作。

episodes.tEn: Building Foundation Models for Robotics with Physical Intelligence

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, CMU; Co-founder, Skild AI
people.tiZh: CMU 助理教授 · Skild AI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Assistant professor at CMU and co-founder of Skild AI, building a general-purpose robot brain. Known for curiosity-driven exploration, self-supervised learning and rapid robot adaptation in the real world.
people.bioZh: CMU 助理教授、Skild AI 联合创始人，打造通用机器人大脑。以好奇心驱动探索、自监督学习，以及机器人在真实世界的快速适应著称。

episodes.tEn: Skild AI: Building a Universal Brain for Robots
Bridging the Generalization Gap in Machine Learning and Robotics

views.en: Generalization beyond the training distribution is the core missing piece; curiosity-driven, goal-free exploration and modular motor policies can close it.
views.zh: 2020 年，他强调泛化到训练分布之外是机器学习与机器人缺失的核心能力，主张用好奇心驱动的无目标探索和模块化运动策略来弥合差距。

views.en: Robotics is fundamentally a data problem; with no internet of robot data, diverse pretraining plus real-world post-training and a data flywheel are essential.
views.zh: 从 2020 到 2026 年，主线一以贯之：机器人本质是数据问题；没有机器人数据的互联网，只能靠多样预训练、真实数据后训练和数据飞轮。

views.en: A general-purpose robot brain, like ChatGPT for language, can power any form factor; scaling comes from pretraining on videos and simulation, then post-training on real data.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他提出像语言领域的 ChatGPT 一样，通用机器人大脑可驱动任意形态；Scaling 路径是先以视频与仿真预训练，再用真实数据后训练。

views.en: Deployment, not just software scaling, is the primary technical challenge; robotics cannot succeed overnight and needs rigorous testing across structured to unstructured environments.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步明确：部署本身是首要技术挑战，而非单纯商业问题；机器人无法一夜成功，需从结构化到非结构化环境严格测试。

views.en: He remains skeptical of shortcuts: dense rewards and video-only data are insufficient, and short-term optimism about home robots is unwarranted.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的反共识立场：不信任捷径——密集奖励与纯视频数据都不够，对家用机器人的短期乐观保持警惕。
